pairs.d4310: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai durya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa rgyun du 'brel pas lus kun ma lus khyab 'dod dang gti mug khro ba sel ba yi sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo
pairs.d4311: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bee durya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa yi nad rgyun du 'brel pas lus la kun tu khyab 'dod dang gti mug khro ba sel ba yi sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo
pairs.rgyud_text: ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai durya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad bcom ldan 'das mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal skyob dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai durya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo 'di skad bdag gis bshad pa'i dus gcig na drang

pairs.d4310: rgya skyegs dang ni karanydza na le sham dang byi dang ga shing kun bu ram pi pi ling
pairs.d4311: de'i 'og tu rgya skyegs dang ka ranydza dang na le sham dang byi dang ga dang shing kun dang pi pi ling dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur

pairs.d4310: ra ro dang po gnyis pa yis bag med pa yi gnas la gnas rnam rtog ngan bcom rmongs pa rnams bde ba yin snyam sems par 'gyur
pairs.d4311: de bas mang du 'thungs te ra ro ba ni rigs pa dang mi rigs pa cal col 'dren par byed pa dang bag med par gnas la rnam par rtog pa ngan pas bcos nas sems rmongs pa ste bde ba yin no snyam du bsams nas 'khrul bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: gnas la gnas rnam rtog ngan bcom bde ba yin snyam sems ra ro gnyis pa glang chen smyon pa ltar kha na ma tho tshul khrims 'chal ba'i gnas ra ro tha ma sems med ro ltar nyal gang yang mi shes mun pa'i gnas su 'gyur gsar pa lci zhing rnying pa yang ba yin gsar 'jam pho

pairs.d4310: byi dang ga dang pi pi ling pi pi ling rtsa na le sham na le sham ni dkar po dang
pairs.d4311: byi dang ga dang pi pi ling dang na le sham dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang na le sham dkar po dang swa rtsi ka'i thal ba rnams kyi phye mas btab pa blud par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi

pairs.d4310: pa phan gcin sri ba la gze ma phan pa yin lud pa lu la kanda ka ri phan rtsib logs gzer la pushkar mu la phan
pairs.d4311: rtsol ba drags pa la ni brtan par gnas pa phan no gcin sri ba la gze ma phan no lud pa lu ba la ni kanda ka ri phan no rtsib logs su zug pa la ni ma nu phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: nad la so phag bsregs khu mchog rtsib logs gzer la pushkar mu la mchog gzhang 'brum dar ba srin la byi tang ga glang thabs thang phrom khong 'bras 'bam po mchog dreg la sle tres grum bur bong khrag mchog chu ser dngul chu mdze la seng ldeng

pairs.d4310: de nas skyug sman gyi cho ga bshad par bya'o de yang rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis 'di ltar bshad de
pairs.d4311: de la thog mar skyug sman gtang ba'i cho ga bshad par bya ste de yang drang srong chen po rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pas bshad pa na re
pairs.rgyud_text: drang srong chen po rgyun shes kyi bu dang me bzhin 'jug dang mu khyud 'dzin dang 'gro ba skyong gi bu dang gshol 'gro skyes dang dka' gnyis spyod dang thang la 'bar dang nabs so skyes la

pairs.d4310: 'bras bu gsum dang 'u su dang tsi tra ka dang na le sham pi pi ling dang dug mo nyung zi ra ha ste pi pi ling ti mu sa dang lan tshwa lnga
pairs.d4311: byi dang ga dang pi pi ling mungga la dang 'bras bu gsum dang 'u su dang tsi tra ka dang na le sham dang dug mo nyung dang zi ra dang pi pi ling dang hasti pi pi ling dang ti mu sa dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis phye mar byas pa dang tri bi tsa srang brgyad kyi phye ma dang til mar srang brgyad dang skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu'i khu ba srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bu ram srang sum brgya lnga bcu dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo

pairs.d4310: pi pi ling rtsa byi dang ga 'bras bu gsum dang 'u su dang tsi tra ka dang na le sham pi pi ling dang dug mo nyung zi ra ha ste pi pi ling ti mu sa dang lan tshwa lnga
pairs.d4311: byi dang ga dang pi pi ling mungga la dang 'bras bu gsum dang 'u su dang tsi tra ka dang na le sham dang dug mo nyung dang zi ra dang pi pi ling dang hasti pi pi ling dang ti mu sa dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis phye mar byas pa dang tri bi tsa srang brgyad kyi phye ma dang til mar srang brgyad dang skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu'i khu ba srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bu ram srang sum brgya lnga bcu dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo

pairs.d4310: de nas mig zur dang mig gi 'bras bu dkar po dang nag po'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: de nas mig zur gnyis dang mig gi 'bras bu dkar po dang nag po rnams kyi gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: man ngag gi rgyud las 'or nad gso ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong

pairs.d4310: rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis 'di ltar bshad do tshe ni ring par 'dod pa yis chos dang nor dang bde ba bsgrub tshe yi rig byed lung bshad pa rab tu gus par bya bar gyis
pairs.d4311: sngon gyi drang srong rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pas bshad pa tshe ring ldan par 'dod pa na chos dang nor yang bde bar sgrub tshe yi rig byed lung bshad pa rab tu gus pas bya bar gyis
pairs.rgyud_text: bya'o chos dang nor dang bde ba sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o 'gro ba gang zhig nad kyi sdug bsngal las thar bar 'dod pa dang gzhan gyi spyi bos bkur bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i

pairs.d4310: dzi ban ti dang shing mngar dang rgun 'bru dug mo nyung 'bras bu ma nu zur pa pi pi ling
pairs.d4311: ji ban ti dang shing mngar dang rgun 'brum dang dug mo yungs kyi 'bras bu dang ma nu dang zur pa dang pi pi ling dang kanda ka ri dang gze ma dang ba bla dang utpal dang skyu ru ra dang kyi lce ba dang byi tsher ba dang 'di rnams phye mar byas te
pairs.rgyud_text: bya kri rgun 'brum dang ma nu zur pa usgranal byi tsher ba gze ma pa la go snyod pi pi ling kyi lce'i sman mar gcong nad sel bar byed bad kan tsha ba lnga dang ya baksha lde gu'i sman mar gcong nad dmu skran 'joms khyad par chang rnying dwangs ma mchog tu bsngags mdor na gcong chen me drod nyams pa

pairs.d4310: tshe ring ba dang nad med dang chos dang nor dang bde dang grags nges par 'thob par 'gyur ba yin
pairs.d4311: 'di 'don pa dang rtogs pa dang rjes su bsgrubs pa de ni nges par yun ring du 'tsho ba dang nad med pa dang chos dang nor dang bde ba dang grags pa yang thob par 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o chos dang nor dang bde ba sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o 'gro ba gang zhig nad kyi sdug bsngal las thar bar 'dod pa dang gzhan

pairs.d4310: dril phyis bad kan sel ba dang tshil ni rab tu zhu byed cing yan lag brtan par byed pa dang pags pa gsal bar byed pa'i mchog
pairs.d4311: de ltar lus mar gyis byugs pa'i rjes la lde gus byugs shing phyis te dril na bad kan sel ba dang tshil rab tu zhu bar byed pa dang lus dang yan lag brtan par byed pa dang pags pa'i mdog dri ma med cing shin tu gsal bar 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: bcag bsten par bya dril phyis bad kan sel zhing tshil 'ju byed lpags gsal yan lag brtan par byed pa'i mchog khrus ni ro tsa drod stobs tshe mdangs skyed g.ya' rngul dri nga snyom skom lus tsha sel chu dron mgo bkrus skra mig stobs 'phrog yin tshad 'khru lto sbos cham pa ma zhu dang sna mig

pairs.d4310: gzar bus dkrugs te bzhag gyur pa lud pa skyigs bu yi ga 'chus dbugs mi bde dang khrag mkhris dang glo 'grams zad byed 'joms par byed
pairs.d4311: de las ran par zos na lud pa dang skyigs bu dang rims dang dbugs mi bde ba dang khrag dang mkhris pa dang glo gcong zad byed dang glo 'grams pa sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: nam tshong spyir gnas skom dad skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde dang yid 'chus cham pa lnga spyi ru sdoms pas dbye ba bco brgyad bshad don snod nang la gnas pa'i nad bstan pa snying dang glo ba mchin mcher

pairs.d4310: skran dang dmu rdzing mcher pa dang pho nad skya rbab cham pa dang lud pa dbugs mi bde drod nyams
pairs.d4311: skran dang rims dang dmu rdzing dang mtsher pa dang pho ba'i nad dang skya rbab dang cham pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa dang me drod nyams pa dang skrang
pairs.rgyud_text: bu sel bad kan lto sbos dbugs mi bde ba dang cham pa rims gsar 'phral du zlog par byed bskol grang bad kan mi skyed mkhris pa sel zhag gcig lon nas dug 'dra nyes kun skyed chang ni mngar skyur

pairs.d4310: ldong ros dang ni pi pi ling na le sham ni skyur rtsi che ka pid ta yi khu ba dang
pairs.d4311: bza' ba ni yi gar 'ong ba rgun 'bru la sogs pa dang sbyar ba sman zhim thig le dang bu srin dang bcas par sbyin no ldong ros dang pi pi ling dang na le sham btags pa'i phye ma skyur rtsi chen po'am ka pid ta'i khu ba gang yang rung ba'i nang du btab ste sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i lde gu byin na bad kan las gyur pa'i skyugs pa'i nad sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa

pairs.d4310: rab tsha skyur dang rno ba dang lan tshwa shin tu dro ba'ang bsngags kha lung khu ba tsha ba gsum
pairs.d4311: gzhan yang shin tu tsha ba dang skyur ba dang rno ba dang lan tshwa dang shin tu dro ba rnams bsngags so kha lung gi khu ba tsha ba gsum dang sbyar ba'i lde gu bldag par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim

pairs.d4310: shing tsha na ga putpa dang pi pi ling dang na le sham go snyod pa ru sha ka dang
pairs.d4311: de la shing tsha dang na ga pushpa dang pi pi ling dang na le sham dang go snyod dang 'u su dang pa ru sha ka dang ma du sha ka dang sug smel dang thang shing dang kha ra dkar po dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma ka pid ta'i khu ba'i nang du btags te
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan

pairs.d4310: bu ram ri lur byas pas gzhang 'brum sel a ru ra dang dong gra pi pi ling ka ranydza dang tsi tra byi dang ga
pairs.d4311: yang na na le sham dang de'i nyis 'gyur gyi bca' sga dang de'i bzhi 'gyur gyi kru trug tres dang de'i nyis 'gyur gyi su ra na rnams btags pa'i nyis 'gyur gyi bu ram dang ri lur byas te zos na gzhang 'brum sel to a ru ra dang dong gra dang pi pi ling dang ka ranydza dang byi dang ga dang kru trug tres dang 'di rnams btags pa dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi

pairs.d4310: shing kun dang ni tsha ba gsum se 'bru ma nu go snyod dang zi ra 'u su la la phud star bu ya baksha ra dang
pairs.d4311: shing kun dang kha ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum dang rtsab ru tsha dang bal po se'u dang ma nu dang go snyod dang 'u su dang zi ra dang la la phud dang star bu dang ya baksha ra dang kru trug tres dang zur pa dang a dza gandha dang sug smel dang bye'u rug pa dang 'di rnams cham chom brdungs te
pairs.rgyud_text: ra nag po dbyi mong tsi tra ka la la phud dang sug smel kha ru tshwa bsdebs pa'i se 'bru bcu pas me drod nyams kha zas mi 'ju sbo sgreg grang skran 'joms dza ti ka ko la dang kha ru tshwa rgyam tshwa shing tsha dbyi mong tsi tra ka a ru ra dang la phug sa bon bsdebs se 'bru'i cur nis bad rlung ma zhu sbo pho mkhal bu

pairs.d4310: rtsabs ru tsha dang kha ru tsha se 'bru ma nu go snyod dang zi ra 'u su la la phud star bu ya baksha ra dang
pairs.d4311: shing kun dang kha ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum dang rtsab ru tsha dang bal po se'u dang ma nu dang go snyod dang 'u su dang zi ra dang la la phud dang star bu dang ya baksha ra dang kru trug tres dang zur pa dang a dza gandha dang sug smel dang bye'u rug pa dang 'di rnams cham chom brdungs te
pairs.rgyud_text: ra nag po dbyi mong tsi tra ka la la phud dang sug smel kha ru tshwa bsdebs pa'i se 'bru bcu pas me drod nyams kha zas mi 'ju sbo sgreg grang skran 'joms dza ti ka ko la dang kha ru tshwa rgyam tshwa shing tsha dbyi mong tsi tra ka a ru ra dang la phug sa bon bsdebs se 'bru'i cur nis bad rlung ma zhu sbo pho mkhal bu

pairs.d4310: mtshan bar rdol dang skya rbab dang snying dang pho ba'i nad dang ni mdze dang me drod nyams dang rims mche ba'i dug dang rtsa ba'i dug
pairs.d4311: 'dis mtshan bar rdol ba dang skya rbab kyi nad dang lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang ske 'gags pa dang snying nad dang pho ba'i nad dang mdze dang pho ba drod chung ba dang rims dang mche ba'i dug dang rtsa ba'i dug dang dug sbyar ma rnams la phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: bcu dgu'o smad nad gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol ba dang rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldags dang g.yan pa glang shu za rkong shu ba dang reg pa'i dug dang mdzer pa ngo khab dang nad gzhan lpags la gram dang bcu

pairs.d4310: dur byid shu dgas ta la rgyam tsha dang ni kha ru tsha pi pi ling ni phye mar btags se 'bru'i khu ba'am 'bras bu ni gsum gyi khu ba'am sha khu'am
pairs.d4311: spa ma'i 'bras bu dang khron bu dang 'bras bu gsum dang pu tse shel dang ni li ni dang kyi lce ba dang ta la dur byid dang shu dag dang rgyam tsha dang kha ru tsha dang pi pi ling rnams phye mar byas te 'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba 'am sha khu 'am ba gcin nam
pairs.rgyud_text: nyung tsan dan pi pi ling rnams phye mar sbyar de la mar phyungs sbrang sbyar mdze nad dang sha bkra me dbal khong 'bras mtshan bar rdol gzhang 'brum skya rbab skom dad mgo 'khor sel tig ta gser gyi me tog ba sha ka skyer pa'i rtsa ba brag zhun ba le ka kyi lce par pa ta dang sum cu tig byi tsher dug mo

pairs.d4310: blud na lpags nad thams cad 'joms dug mo nyung dang tsi tra ka nim pa thang shing seng ldeng dang
pairs.d4311: yang na ka ko u dum ba ra dang byi dang ga dang nim pa dang gla sgang dang tsha ba gsum dang de rnams kyi phye ma briksha bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na pags pa'i nad thams cad 'joms so dug mo yungs dang tsi tra ka dang nim pa dang thang shing dang seng ldeng dang a sa na dang lo ma bdun pa dang 'di rnams bskol ba'i nang du mar dang a ru ra'i phye ma dang sbrang rtsi dang ldan par zos na mdze nad 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba zla ba'i stobs dang ldan pa'i ri la tsan dan dang ga bur dang a ga ru dang nim pa la sogs pa tsha ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro kha ba dang mngar ba dang bska ba dang nus pa bsil ba dang

pairs.d4310: phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u bcu pa'o de nas mig zur dang mig gi 'bras bu dkar po dang nag po'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: de nas mig zur gnyis dang mig gi 'bras bu dkar po dang nag po rnams kyi gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: man ngag gi rgyud las 'or nad gso ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig

pairs.d4310: par pa ta dang dug mo nyung shun lpags 'bras bu mur ba dang shi kru mngar po'i 'bras bu dang shu dag skyer pa'i shun lpags dang shug pa dang ni pu shel tse
pairs.d4311: pa to la dang nim pa dang kyi lce ba dang pu tse shel dang tig ta dang par pa ta dang dug mo yungs kyi shun phrags dang 'bras bu dang mur ba dang shi kru mngar po'i 'bras bu dang shu dag dang skyer pa'i shun phrags dang shug pa dang pu shel tse dang la la phud dang gla sgang dang tsandan dkar po dang rgya tsha dang bong nga dang tsha ba gsum dang shing tsha dang sug smel dang gandha bha dra dang thang shing dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang lde gur byas te bza' ba'am
pairs.rgyud_text: gla sgang par pa ta dang dug mo nyung pa to la dang rtsa mkhris bsnan la btang zla gcig phar 'das rims rnying tsha ba rnams sle tres pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum thang mang btang rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar skabs su rngul dbyung mig chu ser na sbyang bshang gci phyen 'gags pa la bya kr i dang gze ma 'o ma bur rnying bskol ba phan mdog sngo sha skam dang ga bde ba na tsha ba phyi ru byer bas chu lcag phan rtsa khrid na 'phreng lci na cung zad gtar tshigs gzhi rus pa na skrangs chu lums bya rims rjes sna rtsa

pairs.d4310: blud nas 'khru ru gzhug par bya spa ma'i 'bras bu bya snu dang 'bras bu gsum dang ni li ni pu tse shel dang kyi lce ba
pairs.d4311: sngar snum bag gis brtas la de nas bkru sman gtang bar bya'o spa ma'i 'bras bu dang khron bu dang 'bras bu gsum dang pu tse shel dang ni li ni dang kyi lce ba dang ta la dur byid dang shu dag dang rgyam tsha dang kha ru tsha dang pi pi ling rnams phye mar byas te
pairs.rgyud_text: nyung tsan dan pi pi ling rnams phye mar sbyar de la mar phyungs sbrang sbyar mdze nad dang sha bkra me dbal khong 'bras mtshan bar rdol gzhang 'brum skya rbab skom dad mgo 'khor sel tig ta gser gyi me tog ba sha ka skyer pa'i rtsa ba brag zhun ba le ka kyi lce par pa ta dang sum cu tig byi tsher dug mo

pairs.d4310: bong nga thang shing byi dang ga dug mo nyung dang na le sham bskol ba'i chu dron blud par bya yang na a ru ra bca' sga thang shing ba spru bskol ba'am
pairs.d4311: dong gra dang bong nga dkar po dang thang shing dang byi dang ga dang dug mo yungs dang na le sham bskol ba'i chu dron po blud do yang na a ru ra dang bca' sga dang thang shing dang ba spru ba dang de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba blud pa'am
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang skrangs na skyugs btang

pairs.d4310: cha gcig sbyar ba 'di rtag tu 'thungs na mdze nad 'joms byed cing 'or nad skya rbab sha bkra can pho nad gzhang 'brum rgyu rlugs dang mtshan bar rdol dang 'brum phran dang
pairs.d4311: mdze 'joms pa'i sman rnams bskol ba'i khu ba dang bskyos te rtag tu 'thungs na mdze nad zlog par byed do de bzhin du 'or nad dang skya rbab kyi nad dang sha bkra dang pho ba'i nad dang gzhang 'brum dang rlig rlugs dang mtshan bar rdol ba dang 'brum bu phra mo dang 'brum bu dang 'brum chen gyi nad 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: sur ya rmen bu rlig rlugs dang rkang bam mtshan bar rdol dang le'u brgyad byis pa nyer spyod nad dang de'i gdon gsum mo nad spyi dang bye brag phal pa gsum 'byung po smyo brjed gza' dang klu gdon lnga rma la rma spyi mgo dang ske yi rma byang khog yan lag le'u lnga ru bshad dug la sbyar dug gyur pa dngos dang gsum rgas pa gso ba bcud

pairs.d4310: yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu pa'o de nas rlung nad gso ba bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: de la ni myur du ci 'dod pa'i bza' ba dang btung ba dang sman byin na de ma thag skom dad zhi bar gyur na nad gzhan yang gso bar nus so gso ba'i gnas las le'u drug pa rdzogs so de nas chang nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: man ngag gi rgyud las gso thabs kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o le'u drug pa dpe don gyi rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig gnas lugs ngos 'dzin gso ba'i rtsa ba la rnam gyur ma gyur blta

pairs.d4310: stan srab tsog pur 'dug pa dang mya ngan khro dang 'jigs dang skyo shugs dang sred pa dgag pa dang smyung ba lam 'gro rno dang tsha
pairs.d4311: rtsol ba drag po dang khur dang gos lci ba dang nub mo gnyid ma log pa dang nyin par gnyid log pa dang 'og gzhi mkhrang ba la 'dug pa dang stan med pa la 'dug pa dang mya ngan dang khro ba dang 'jigs pa dang skyo ba 'byung ba dang 'dod pa dgag pa dang smyung bar 'dug pa dang lam du 'gro ba dang shin tu tsha ba'i zas dang dro ba dang lci ba dang phyi sa 'gags par 'gyur ba'i zas dang gos dmar po dang g.yang sa dang khron par lta ba dang
pairs.rgyud_text: stobs 'phrog rlung 'phel 'gyur ba'i phyir nyin par gnyid log snum lcir 'gyur bas phan gzhan du nyin gnyid bad kan skyed cing skrangs rmongs bag mgo na sgyid skyur rims 'debs 'gyur gnyid 'phel skyugs dang smyung bya bud med bsten gnyid yer 'o ma zho chang sha khu btung mgo bo bsku zhing rna ba snum gyis dgang nyal po skye gnas mi mthun bdag po can mi sdug sbrum ma shugs zhan nyen pa dang zla mtshan ldan dus bkan byed 'khrig pa spang dgun dus ro tsas dregs tshe bkag pa med ston dpyid zhag gnyis dbyar sos zla phyed spyad gzhan du

pairs.d4310: sngar bshad chu tshan sbyar ba blud sug smel dang ni shing tsha dang na ga pus pa na le sham pi pi ling dang bca' sga rnams
pairs.d4311: yang na gong du bshad pa'i ha re nu ka dang pi pi ling la sogs pa'i phye ma chu dron po dang sbyar ba blud do sug smel dang shing tsha dang na ga pushpa dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang bca' sga dang 'di rnams yas kyi rim bzhin du cha res bskyed pa phye mar byas la spyi dang mnyam pa'i kha ra dang bcas pa zos na
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi

pairs.d4310: yid 'ong phyis 'gags pa dang lud pa snying ga rtsib logs na mcher pa gzhang 'brum pho nad sel bal bu'i lo man le sham dong gra dang ni pi pi ling bzhin du cha res bskyed shing tsha sug smel dang po'i phyed pi pi ling gi brgyad 'gyur gyi
pairs.d4311: phyi sa 'gags pa dang lud pa dang snying ga dang rtsib logs su zug pa dang mcher pa dang gzhang 'brum dang pho ba'i nad sel to bal bu'i lo ma dang na le sham dang dong gra dang pi pi ling dang de rnams bzhin du dang po'i cha res bskyed pa dang shing tsha dang sug smel dang bal bu'i phye ma dang pi pi ling gi brgyad 'gyur gyi kha ra dkar po dang de rnams kyi phye ma ni yi ga 'chus pa dang me drod skyes pa dang lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang zas yi gar mi 'ong ba dang skyug pa dang mcher pa na ba dang snying nad dang rtsib logs su zug pa dang skya rbab dang rims dang 'khru ba dang rlung 'khyil pa bde bar 'byung ste
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba zla ba'i stobs dang ldan pa'i ri la tsan dan dang ga bur dang a ga ru dang nim pa la sogs pa tsha ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro kha ba dang mngar ba dang bska ba dang nus

pairs.d4310: ma zhu ba la chu dron las mtshan bar rdol dang skya rbab dang lud pa dbugs mi bde skad 'gags snying dang pho ba'i nad dang ni mdze dang me drod nyams dang rims mche ba'i dug dang rtsa ba'i dug dbyig dug sbyar ba'i dug bcas la
pairs.d4311: ma zhu ba la ni chu dron po las btang ste 'dis mtshan bar rdol ba dang skya rbab kyi nad dang lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang ske 'gags pa dang snying nad dang pho ba'i nad dang mdze dang pho ba drod chung ba dang rims dang mche ba'i dug dang rtsa ba'i dug dang dug sbyar ma rnams la phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: bcu dgu'o smad nad gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol ba dang rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldags dang g.yan pa glang shu za rkong shu ba dang reg pa'i dug dang mdzer pa ngo khab dang nad gzhan lpags la gram dang bcu ru bshad sha yi nad la lba ba rmen bu gnyis

pairs.d4310: btab pa blud na skya rbab dang mig ser khrag mkhris 'joms par byed tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka 'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga
pairs.d4311: yang na ba sha ka dang kru trug tres dang 'bras bu gsum dang pu tse shel dang tig ta dang nim pa dang 'di rnams cham chom brdungs te bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa'i nang du sbrang rtsi btab pa 'thungs na skya rbab dang mig ser dang khrag mkhris 'joms par byed do yang na tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka dang byi dang ga dang 'bras bu gsum dang ga dur dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma spyi dang mnyam pa'i lcags nag po'i phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus ma zhu skyug pa sel bar byed dur thod sha ru spen ma'i thal ba gsum tsa bya

pairs.d4310: dug mo nyung dang pi pi ling tsandan zho ni gnyis gnyis dang zhun mar srang ni bcu gnyis bskol
pairs.d4311: brgyad cha lus pa'i nang du kyi lce ba dang gla sgang dang tig ta dang dug mo yungs dang pi pi ling dang tsandan dang de rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang mar srang bcu gnyis dang yang bskol la mar lus pa ni tig ta'i sman mar zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: gla sgang par pa ta dang dug mo nyung pa to la dang rtsa mkhris bsnan la btang zla gcig phar 'das rims rnying tsha ba rnams sle tres pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum thang mang btang rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar skabs su rngul dbyung mig chu ser na sbyang bshang gci phyen 'gags pa

pairs.d4310: pu tse shel dang pi pi ling sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin yang na dbyi mo a ru ra tsi tra ka dang thang shing dang
pairs.d4311: yang na 'bras bu gsum dang dbyi mo dang pu tse shel dang pi pi ling dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i lde gu'am yang na dbyi mo dang a ru ra dang tsi tra ka dang thang shing btags pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba bldag par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang

pairs.d4310: cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u ste dang po'o de nas bkru sman bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: cho ga grub pa'i gnas las le'u dang po rdzogs so de nas bkru sman gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: rgyud zhus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o de nas ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig dang po

pairs.d4310: 'bras bu gsum dang shwe ta dang nim pa'i lo ma ka ranydza shri sha gnyis dang sa bon dang thang shing dang ni tsha ba gsum
pairs.d4311: yungs kar dang shu dag dang shing kun dang pri yang ku dang ser po rnam gnyis dang btsod dang ka ni dkar po dang 'bras bu gsum dang shi ta ka ta bi dang nim pa'i lo ma dang ka ranydza ka dang shri ya'i sa bon dang thang shing dang tsha ba
pairs.rgyud_text: sman mar byin sle tres kabraspya ka ri shu dag dang btsod dang dza ti sug smel pi pi ling yung ba shu mo za dang ra mar gyi 'jam rtsi btang zhing long phugs g.yas g.yon bsreg mkhal rlung mgo tshod shu mo za btab btang rus sna'i khu ba bu ram sbyar bsdus sam bong sha sram sha bur chang

pairs.d4310: sug smel zho ni gnyis gnyis dang bu ram rnying pa srang lnga bcu bskol te ri lur byas pa ni zos na cham pa dbugs mi bde lud pa lu ba 'joms byed cing skad snyan yi ga 'byed mchog yin shu ti'i shun pa ba la dang so na ka dang e randa
pairs.d4311: tsha ba gsum dang bal bu'i lo ma dang dbyi mo dang da trig dang star bu dang tsi tra ka dang zi ra dang de rnams srang gnyis gnyis dang shing tsha dang sug smel dang gan dha bha dra de dag srang phyed phyed dang bu ram rnying pa srang lnga bcu dang tshul bzhin du bskol te ri lur byas pa zos na sna nad cham pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa lu ba rnams 'joms te yi ga 'bye ba dang skad snyan par byed pa'i mchog yin no shu ti'i shun pa dang ba la dang so na ka dang e randa dang bil ba dang dong ga de rnams kyi rtsa ba dang zhag dang mar dang spra tshil dang sbyar ba'i dud pas bdugs pa'am
pairs.rgyud_text: rgyas dang dbugs mi bde 'joms par byed cing skad snyan yi ga 'byed sna cham yos kyi rlangs pas bdugs na phan chu 'phrul chab tsha phye tshod zho dar bsten drag shul nyin gnyid drod bcud spang bar bya 'grams nas rims sam 'khrugs su shor ba na brtson pas rang rang gzhung bzhin bcos par bya zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las cham rims bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dum bu bzhi pa phyi ma'i rgyud ces bya ba bzhugs so de nas ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman gyi bla baidurya 'od kyi rgyal po des ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te thogs pa med

pairs.d4310: spang spos padma utpa la skyer khanda dang sug smel dang shing mngar na ga ge sar bcas dug dang nang gi tsha ba dang mkhris pa rgyas pa sel bar byed
pairs.d4311: gan dha pri yang ku dang spang spos dang me tog padma dang me tog utpa la dang skyer khan dang sug smel dang shing mngar dang na ga ge sar dang 'di rnams ni dug nad sel lus tsha ba dang mkhris pa rgyas pa'i nad sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: nang dag tu dza ti gur kum gla rtsi spang spos dang spang rgyan sbyar te lus kun bkrus rjes byug yang na gla rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang sdig srin mu zi ra khrag bse mar khur yang na ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dang gla rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra khrag byug

pairs.d4310: sa lu'i rtsa ba ka ko la ba la gnyis dang shing mngar dang bu ram shing dang bskol ba yi
pairs.d4311: yang na 'bras sa lu'i rtsa ba dang ka ko la dang ba la rnam gnyis dang shing mngar dang bu ram shing 'di rnams chu dang 'o ma dang bskol la
pairs.rgyud_text: gtar phye ma gur kum cu gang sug smel ka ko la ba le ka gser me tig ta ka ra bdun dang hong len dug nyung dang dgu pa sbyar mcher pa'i tsha ba gser gyi me tog tsan

pairs.d4310: lto ba la gsum brang la dgu rgyab la bcu bzhi nam tshong ni yan chad sum cu rtsa bdun yod
pairs.d4311: bzhi po de dag las gnad bcu gcig dang lto ba la gnad gsum dang brang la gnad dgu dang rgyab la gnad bcu bzhi dang nam tshong yan chad la gnad sum cu rtsa bdun no
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i sgo yin phyir mgo dang nam tshong yan chad nad la mchog khyad par gur kum zhun mar ka ra sbyar mgo rlung khrag 'thab gzer nad 'khyug pa 'joms shing mngar skyu ru ka ra zhun mar sbyar rna ba mig dang za

pairs.d4310: 'dres nad yal bar bor na ni khong 'bras mcher pa snying nad dang skran dang me drod nyams la sogs
pairs.d4311: de ltar 'dres pa'i nad de dag gso ba ma byas te yal bar bor na khong 'bras dang nad gzhi mcher pa'i nad dang snying nad dang skran dang me drod nyams pa la sogs pa bla brnan 'byung bar 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: ngal dub dbugs bkag skran dang snying nad 'byung myos 'gyur der ni ngal gso rlung sel phan gnyid bkag g.yal mang lus snyom mgo bo lci mig 'grib kha zas mi 'ju sha khu dang chang btung bsku mnye bya zhing gnyid log phan lud pa bkag pas lud 'phel

pairs.d4310: de bzhin pu tse shel dang ni ba sha ka dang pu shel tse kyi lce ba dang 'bras bu gsum sle tres dang ni pa to la bong nga dkar po nim pa dang mur ba byi tsher ba yang phan
pairs.d4311: yang na pu tse shel dang ba sha ka dang pu shel tse dang 'bras bu gsum dang sle tres dang pa to la dang bong nga dkar po dang nim pa dang mur ba dang byi tsher ba rnams bskol ba'i nang du sbrang rtsis btab pa 'thungs na yang bad kan dang mkhris pa'i rims la phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: ba 'bras bu'i sman mar sbyar kun la pa to la dang pu tse shel gla sgang shing mngar a ru ra dang lnga pa tol lnga 'di'i thang phye gang rigs phan rims gang cis kyang tsha ba mi chag na 'tsho dka' lag pa'i rtsa la lan 'ga' gtar nyin gcig mi gtar bzhi po rang rang rtsa gtar bas rims kyi tsha ba rtsad nas

pairs.d4310: sa ra la dang thang shing dang chu srin sen mo ra sna dang gu gul shu dag lca ba dang sug smel gnyis dang tsa rong dang
pairs.d4311: dro ba'i nus pa dang reg pa dang ldan pa'i sman rgya spos dang a ka ru dang ru rta dang ston dang rdo dreg dang ko nyon tse dang thang shing dang chu srin sen mo dang ra sna dang gu gul dang shu dag dang rtsa rong dang sug smel rnam gnyis dang tsandan dang sib dang shi kru dang bye'u rug pa dang spang spos dang bya ma
pairs.rgyud_text: shu dag gnyis tsan dan dmar po rdo dreg spang spos dang shu ti til mar ka ra sbyar ba'i mar rtsa 'dzin shing rengs sra 'theng la sogs pa'i rlung nad lhag ma ma lus 'joms par byed smyo brjed skran dang rlig rlugs sel bar 'gyur gnas kyi sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni sha lpags la zhugs bsku mnye byug dugs bya tshil zhugs brla rengs phyug po'i rlung ltar gso rus dang rkang zhugs

pairs.d4310: shi kru spang spos bya ma ka yungs kar rtsa ba bcu pa dang sle tres er nda gnyis dang ba ru ra dang ro hi sha ta ma la yi lo ma dang pu ti ka dang sa la ki
pairs.d4311: dro ba'i nus pa dang reg pa dang ldan pa'i sman rgya spos dang a ka ru dang ru rta dang ston dang rdo dreg dang ko nyon tse dang thang shing dang chu srin sen mo dang ra sna dang gu gul dang shu dag dang rtsa rong dang sug smel rnam gnyis dang tsandan dang sib dang shi kru dang bye'u rug pa dang spang spos dang bya ma ka dang yungs kar dang sle tres dang e randa rnam gnyis dang ba ru ra dang ro hi sha dang ta ma la'i lo ma dang bhu ti ka dang sa li ka dang 'u su dang ti mu sa dang shu ti dang rgya sran dang mon sran ma sha dang kru trug tres dang pu ti ka ranydza dang na gu la rnam gnyis dang gzhan yang bsil ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i sman rnams zhib tu btags la chang dang rtsabs skyur po dang til mar dang lhan cig bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: shu dag gnyis tsan dan dmar po rdo dreg spang spos dang shu ti til mar ka ra sbyar ba'i mar rtsa 'dzin shing rengs sra 'theng la sogs pa'i rlung nad lhag ma ma lus 'joms par byed smyo brjed skran dang rlig rlugs sel bar 'gyur gnas kyi sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni sha lpags la zhugs bsku mnye byug dugs bya tshil zhugs brla rengs phyug po'i rlung ltar gso rus dang rkang zhugs snum dugs bya ba dang snum bzhi bza' dang byug dang 'jam rtsi btang bcud la rlung zhugs da byid skyin gor sbyar rgyus pa tshigs dang rtsar zhugs snum dugs dkri chu ba 'khums la mon sran dre'u dang rgyam tshwa til mar sbyar te bskol ba byug khrag la rlung zhugs snum 'chos byas la gtar khrag zags rjes su tshor med gyur pa la dud pa rgyam tshwa til mar sbyar bas byug don babs snying rlung shing kun gsum thang btang 'bras bu'i mar dang sman chen sman mar sbyar glor zhugs

pairs.d4310: lde gu lud pa sel byed mchog de bzhin na le sham gyi phye mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas
pairs.d4311: yang na phye ma de mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i lde gu zos na lud pa sel ba'i mchog yin no de bzhin du na le sham phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i lde gu zos na phan yon gong ma dang 'dra'o
pairs.rgyud_text: 'brum bur chang sbyar bad kan na le sham gyi 'bru chang sbyar lgang pa'i grang ba rgya tshwa'i tshwa chang sbyar chu ser nad la seng ldeng drungs chang sbyar dug nad zungs zad gtso bo drug chang rnam par re ral 'om bu spang rtsi hong len tig ta sbyar gzhan yang nad dang

pairs.d4310: gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u gsum pa'o de nas skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o gang phyir skyigs bu dbugs mi bde
pairs.d4311: lud pa gso ba'i le'u gsum pa rdzogs so de nas skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste de la skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba'i nad gzhi gcig tu bstan pas gso ba'i dpyad kyang 'dra ste gcig tu bstan pa yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: pa dang skom dad skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba dang glang thabs srin nad skyug 'khru dri ma 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi tshad 'khru dreg nad dang grum bu chu ser rtsa dkar pags pa'i nad phran bu'i nad dang le'u bcu dgu'o lhan skyes rma la 'bras dang gzhang 'brum dang me dbal sur ya rmen bu

pairs.d4310: ldong ros dang ni pi pi ling na le sham ni skyur rtsi che ka pid ta yi khu ba dang
pairs.d4311: ldong ros dang pi pi ling dang na le sham btags pa'i phye ma skyur rtsi chen po'am ka pid ta'i khu ba gang yang rung ba'i nang du btab ste sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i lde gu byin na bad kan las gyur pa'i skyugs pa'i nad sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang

pairs.d4310: me drod skyed cing gzhang 'brum dang pho nad skya rbab mdze dmu rdzing dbyig dug rims skran mchin nad dang snying nad skran dang gcong chen dang slon dang srin bu'i nad rnams 'joms
pairs.d4311: de las ran par bsten na me'i drod skyed pa dang gzhang 'brum dang pho ba'i nad dang skya rbab dang mdze dang dmu rdzing dang dbyig dug dang rims dang skrangs pa dang mchin pa na ba dang snying nad dang skran dang gcong chen po dang skyugs pa'i nad dang srin bu'i nad rnams sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dus gcong nad ma zhu skran dang skya rbab dang 'or dang dmu chu gcong chen zad byed drug tsha ba spyi dang gal mdo ri thang mtshams ma smin rgyas stongs gab rnyings rnyogs pa dang 'grams 'khrugs rims dang 'brum pa rgyu gzer dang gag lhog cham pa le'u bcu drug go lus stod mgo bo mig dang rna ba dang sna dang kha

pairs.d4310: pi pi ling dang po son cha bil ba shu ti shing mngar dang shu dag ru rta kru trug tres
pairs.d4311: de yang pi pi ling dang po son cha dang bil ba dang shu ti dang shing mngar dang shu dag dang ru rta dang zur pa dang ma nu dang kru trug tres dang
pairs.rgyud_text: tra ka pi pi ling dang zur pa ma nu yi phye ma mar bskol thogs med 'gro nus 'gyur bi sha tse dang gzugs 'khums gar yod ngos mthe'u chung srin lag rgyab kyi rgyus pa la ser po snal ma 'dra

pairs.d4310: shu dag zi ra tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang khron bu dang 'bras bu gsum dang thal sman gnyis ma nu ru rta lan tshwa lnga
pairs.d4311: sha ta pushpa dang zi ra nag po dang ka ra bi ra dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang a dza gandha dang zur pa dang shu dag dang zi ra dang tsha ba gsum dang khron bu dang 'bras bu gsum dang thal ba rnam gnyis dang ma nu dang ru rta dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang phyi dang ga dang 'di rnams cha snyoms pa dang dan ti cha gsum dang dri bid ta dang bi sha la cha gnyis dang sa ta la cha bzhi dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma ni sred med kyi bu'i phye ma zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: tra ka pi pi ling dang zur pa ma nu yi phye ma mar bskol thogs med 'gro nus 'gyur bi sha tse dang gzugs 'khums gar yod ngos mthe'u chung srin lag rgyab kyi rgyus pa la ser po snal ma 'dra ba yod de bcad sra 'theng la sogs phyi ma'i rlung rnams kun rgyu las brtags la snum dugs gtar ba dang sbyang dang byug sogs ci rigs sbyar bar bya rgya spos ru rta sug smel shu dag gnyis tsan dan dmar po rdo dreg spang spos dang shu ti til mar ka ra sbyar ba'i mar rtsa 'dzin shing rengs sra 'theng la sogs pa'i rlung nad lhag ma ma lus

pairs.d4310: stod smad sbyangs nas a ru ra sbrang rtsi mar sbyar lde gu sbyin bi sha la dang pu tse shel gla sgang ru rta thang shing dang dug mo nyung ni zho gnyis gnyis mur ba srang phyed bong nga ni zho gcig de yi phyer btags chu
pairs.d4311: a ru ra dang sbrang rtsi dang mar sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin no byi sha la dang pu tse shel dang gla sgang dang ru rta dang thang shing dang dug mo yungs dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang mur ba srang phyed dang bong nga zho gcig dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma chu dro 'jam tsam dang 'thungs na
pairs.rgyud_text: gang shing tsha pi pi ling ka ra sbrang dang mar sbyar lde gu btang yang na cu gang a krong ru rta dang pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyar la btang 'gogs dka' star bu ru rta pi pi ling shing tsha skyu ru ra dang sbrang sbyar btang 'khru la tsha 'khru grang 'khru rnam pa gnyis dud khu dmar ser dri che chu gting 'bying tsha 'khru yin

pairs.d4310: bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi ni btab pa blud na skya rbab dang mig ser khrag mkhris 'joms par byed tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka
pairs.d4311: yang na ba sha ka dang kru trug tres dang 'bras bu gsum dang pu tse shel dang tig ta dang nim pa dang 'di rnams cham chom brdungs te bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa'i nang du sbrang rtsi btab pa 'thungs na skya rbab dang mig ser dang khrag mkhris 'joms par byed do yang na tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka dang byi dang ga dang 'bras bu gsum dang ga dur dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma spyi dang mnyam pa'i lcags nag po'i phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus ma zhu skyug pa sel bar byed dur thod sha ru spen ma'i thal ba gsum tsa bya

pairs.d4310: mkhris par nye shing pu tse shel pa to la rtsa'i 'bras bu gsum sle tres dang ni sman mngar kha
pairs.d4311: mkhris pa shas che ba'i dreg nad la ni nye'u shing dang pu tse shel dang pa to la'i rtsa ba dang 'bras bu gsum dang sle tres dang 'di rnams sam yang na sman kha ba dang mngar ba rnams dang 'di rnams gang yang rung ba mar ram 'o ma gang 'byor pa dang bskol ba 'thungs na phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: ba 'bras bu'i sman mar sbyar kun la pa to la dang pu tse shel gla sgang shing mngar a ru ra dang lnga pa tol lnga 'di'i thang phye gang rigs phan rims gang cis kyang tsha ba mi chag na 'tsho dka' lag pa'i rtsa la lan 'ga' gtar nyin gcig mi gtar bzhi po rang rang rtsa gtar bas rims kyi tsha ba rtsad nas 'don kun

pairs.d4310: rlung 'joms rlung gi snum chos bya slar yang bkru sman rnon pos sbyang nad gzhi che zhing khong rtsub la me drod chung dang sman chung ba
pairs.d4311: de nas rlung 'joms pa'i sman gyis snum chos byas la bkru sman rnon po gtang ngo nad gzhi stobs che zhing khong rtsub la me drod che ba la sman thun nyung ngu btang bas nad glongs la khong du 'khyil zhing nad gzhis lam bkag nas lte ba'i phyogs su shas cher sbo zhing
pairs.rgyud_text: bza' dang byug de yi rjes la skyugs sman rnon pos sbyang slar yang gong gi snum 'chos byas rting la bkru sman dur byid sgron shing lcags phye ba gcin sbyar bas sbyang de rjes 'bras bu gsum dang li ga dur byi tang ga dang tsi tra tsha ba gsum cha mnyam kun dang lcags phye mnyam byas te sbrang sbyar lde

pairs.d4310: de yis blo dang rnam shes dang dran pa 'khrul zhing lus kyi ni bde dang sdug bsngal las nyams te shing rta kha lo sgyur ba ni
pairs.d4311: des blo dang rnam par shes pa dran pa rnams 'khrugs shing lus kyi bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba yang mi tshor te nyams la shing rta kha lo sgyur ba dang bral ba bzhin du
pairs.rgyud_text: la don snod gsal bar smin de dus bde dang sdug bsngal shes par 'gyur rtsa lnga pa la rlung gi rgyu ba 'byung rtsa drug pa la sems kyi dran pa gsal de nas zla bdun bdun phrag rtsa bdun nas sum cu'i bar

pairs.d4310: dung dang rgya shug ka ta ka rgun 'brum shing mngar sbrang rtsi dang
pairs.d4311: yang na dung dang rgya shug tshi gu dang ka ta ka dang rgun 'bru dang shing mngar dang sbrang rtsi dang de rnams sbyar ba bsku ba'am
pairs.rgyud_text: ma'i ro gsum bsten nas rnying skam sa'i sha dang sbrang rtsi dang chu sol sga thang btang zhing rtsub pa bsten rtsol bas bcag dang dril phyis bad kan bsal dri zhim skyed mos tshal

pairs.d4310: rab rib myur du 'joms par byed pa yin na le sham dang skyu ru ra rgya mtsho'i lbu ba spangs ma dang
pairs.d4311: ring po mi thogs par rab rib 'joms par byed do yang na na le sham dang skyu ru ra dang rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dang spangs ma dang lig bu mig dang drub mar cang gi rdo dang de rnams gong ma'i bzhin du cha res bskyed de
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga

pairs.d4310: zhu ba'i gnas la gnas pa la bkru sman dang ni ni ru ha snum med dro bas sbyang bar bya nas dang rgya shug rgya sran gyi khu ba snum ni med pa dang nas thug kha zas bza' ba dang
pairs.d4311: shu ba'i gnas long kar khrag byung ba la ni bkru sman dang ni ha ru gnyis snum med cing dro bas sbyar bar bya'o kha zas ni nas dang rgya shug dang rgya sran gyi khu ba snum med cing nas thug rgyam tshwa dang bcas pa bza'o
pairs.rgyud_text: zhu'i gnas la skyugs kyis sbyang zhu ba'i gnas la ni ru ha yis drang lus spyir bshal la rtsa nad rtsa sbyongs bya zhi sbyang nyam dmad phan yon dbang po gsal lus yang yi ga bde la bya byed brtson bkres skom dus 'byung bshang rlung bde bar rgyu drags na zungs 'dzad sha skem

pairs.d4310: de ni slon bro mdze nad dang dug dang rims dang bad kan dang g.yan pa dang ni gcin snyi dang rma red pa rnams sbyong bar byed
pairs.d4311: mdze dang dug dang rims dang bad kan rgyas pa dang g.yan pa dang gcin snyi ba dang rma de ba 'byang ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: zhu snum zos brla rengs nad rims dang gcin snyi khong 'bras dreg grum mcher lkog klad snying nad tshad 'khru skyug pa dang lus lci dang ga mi bde bshang gci 'gags 'tsho ches chu

pairs.d4310: lte ba kha dang sna reg dang skra dang spu dang sen mo so mtshan rgyab nu ma mgrin pa dang lto dang srin lag dag dang ni
pairs.d4311: de yang lte ba lag pas nom pa dang de bzhin du sna dang kha dang skra dang ba spu dang sen mo dang so dang pho mtshan dang rgyab dang nu ma dang mgrin pa dang lto ba dang mthe'u chung
pairs.rgyud_text: mgo bo mig dang rna ba dang sna dang kha dang lba ba le'u drug don snod snying dang glo mchin mcher mkhal dang pho ba rgyu ma long dang le'u brgyad gsang ba'i nad la pho mo tha dad gnyis thor nad skad 'gags yi ga 'chus pa dang

pairs.d4310: rus pa dang ldan reg na tsha btsir na mngon par dga' ba dang khab kyis rab tu gtsags snyam byed yan lag na zhing zug pa yin
pairs.d4311: reg na shin tu tsha ba dang btsir na mngon par dga' ba dang khab kyis gtsags pa snyam byed pa dang yan lag rnams na zhing zug pa yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: bzhin sdud kha chu 'dzag lan tshwa reg na tsha zhing mchil ma 'du kha ba kha yi dri sbyong yi ga ldog tsha ba kha lce bsreg cing mig chu 'dzag bska ba lce rkan la chags rtsub

pairs.d4310: 'o mas bad kan mkhris pa dag mjug to rgyab dang rked pa na me drod che la rtug 'gags pa 'jam rtsi mas gtong sbyar bar bya nim pa pa to la'i lo ma pu tse shel dang dong ga dang sthi ra ba la po son cha
pairs.d4311: bad kan dang mkhris pa zad pa'i nad la mjug to dang rgyab dang rked pa na ba dang me drod che ba dang rtug pa 'gags pa la ni 'jam rtsi mas gtong bar bya'o pa to la dang nim pa'i lo ma dang pu tse shel dang dong ga dang ti ra dang ba la dang gze ma dang po son cha dang pu shel tse dang ba la ka dang 'di rnams chu dang sman spyi dang mnyam pa'i 'o ma dang lhan cig bskol la
pairs.rgyud_text: ba 'bras bu'i sman mar sbyar kun la pa to la dang pu tse shel gla sgang shing mngar a ru ra dang lnga pa tol lnga 'di'i thang phye gang rigs phan rims gang cis kyang tsha ba mi chag na 'tsho dka' lag pa'i rtsa la lan 'ga' gtar nyin gcig mi gtar bzhi po rang rang rtsa gtar bas rims kyi tsha ba rtsad nas 'don kun la ri thang mtshams su gzab pa gces gnyan rims bcos thabs spyi dang bye brag gnyis spyi bcos dang po rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang bsdam gnyis

pairs.d4310: sbrang rtsi na le sham btab blud yang na skyu ru ra'i phye ma 'o mar bskol ba mar btab blud yang na bcud kyis len cho gas
pairs.d4311: yang na bu ram chu bskol ba dang bsgrangs pa'i nang du na le sham dang sbrang rtsi btab pa blud pa'am yang na skyu ru ra'i phye ma dang 'o ma dang bskol ba mar dang ldan pa blud pa'am yang na bcud kyis len gyi skabs su pi pi ling gi cho ga bstan pa bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: gser gyi me tog mchog bad kan na le sham dang sbrang rtsi mchog khrag la ba sha ka dang hong len mchog bad kan smug po'i nad la cong zhi mchog ma zhu ba la kha ru tshwa nyid mchog skran gyi nad la rdo thal bsregs khu mchog dmu rdzings nad la dar ya kan nyid mchog skya rbab nad la da lis lcags phye mchog 'or gyi

pairs.d4310: lcam pa'i khu ba tsha ba gsum mar dang 'o mar sbyar ba dang 'bras chan zos la 'o ma blud
pairs.d4311: yang na lcam pa'i khu ba dang tsha ba gsum dang mar dang sbyar ba'i 'bras chan zos la skom du 'o ma 'thungs na
pairs.rgyud_text: zal chu dang lci ba dang 'o ma zho dang mar la sbrang rtsi sbyar ba yi rnam lnga'i sman mar mchin nad rnying tsha ba rlung ldan chu ser skya rbab 'joms

pairs.d4310: seng phrom gnyis dang mon cha ra se 'bru gzhon nu'i shun lpags dang bil ba gzhon nu gla sgang dang btsod dang da ta ka'i 'bras bu
pairs.d4311: seng phrom rnam pa gnyis dang mon cha ra dang se'u gzhon nu'i shun pa dang bil ba gzhon nu dang gla sgang dang btsod dang da ta ka'i 'bras bu dang 'di rnams srang re re dang dug mo yungs kyi shun phrags srang bcu btags pa'i phye ma dang mar srang nyi shu dang
pairs.rgyud_text: dang tsi tra ka ka ped mon cha ra dang da trig dang se 'bru tshad ldan bu ram ril bu byas gu ling 'bras kyi ril bus bad rlung rgyas stod tsha smad grang 'khru ba gsar rnying gcod da lis dbyi mong ganngha pa tra dang na ga pushpe ge sar pu shel rtse dwa tsha ya baksha ra bzang po gsum

pairs.d4310: 'u su zi ra ba le ka kha ru tsha rnams cha mnyam dang da trig dang ni da ta ki bil ba dang ni pi pi ling
pairs.d4311: pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang dri rnam bzhi dang dong ga dang na le sham dang kru trug tres dang ba la ka dang zi ra dang 'u su dang kha ru tsha dang 'di rnams cha mnyam pa dang da trig dang da ta ki dang pi pi ling dang bil ba dang bal po se'u dang ti mu sa dang 'di rnams la la phud kyi sum 'gyur dang kha ra dkar po la la phud kyi drug 'gyur dang ka pid ta la la phud kyi brgyad 'gyur dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma byas pa ni ka pid ta'i cha brgyad pa'i phye ma zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba zla ba'i stobs dang ldan pa'i ri la tsan dan dang ga bur

pairs.d4310: myur du lud pa dbugs mi bde gzhang 'brum gsung dang cham pa dang snying nad des ni zhi bar byed kha lud zur pa ra sna dang tsha ba gsum dang a ru ra
pairs.d4311: kha zas kyi gong du yang dang yang du zos na zas myur du 'ju zhing khyad par du lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang gzhang 'brum dang gsud pa dang cham pa dang snying nad rnams zhi bar byed cing 'joms so yang na kha lud dang zur pa dang ra sna dang tsha ba gsum dang
pairs.rgyud_text: bu sel bad kan lto sbos dbugs mi bde ba dang cham pa rims gsar 'phral du zlog par byed bskol grang bad kan mi skyed mkhris pa sel zhag gcig lon nas dug 'dra nyes kun skyed chang ni mngar skyur kha la zhu rjes skyur rno dro rtsub phra cung zad thur du 'khru drod 'bar spobs skyed gnyid 'phel bad rlung sel thal drags sems

pairs.d4310: 'brum phran dug dang skya rbab dang khong 'bras skran dang gzhang 'brum dang 'or nad skem dang dbyig dug dang dmu rdzing lud pa dbugs mi bde
pairs.d4311: khyad par du skya rbab dang khong 'bras dang skran dang gzhang 'brum dang skrang pa dang skem pa dang dbyig dug dang dmu rdzing dang lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang skyugs pa dang tshil rgyas pa dang mcher pa na ba dang dreg dang mdze dang smyo byed dang brjed byed las rgyal bar 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dus gcong nad ma zhu skran dang skya rbab dang 'or dang dmu chu gcong chen zad byed drug tsha ba spyi dang gal mdo ri thang mtshams ma smin rgyas stongs gab rnyings rnyogs pa dang 'grams 'khrugs rims dang 'brum pa rgyu gzer dang gag lhog cham pa le'u bcu drug go lus stod mgo bo mig dang rna ba dang sna dang kha dang lba

pairs.d4310: me dbal skom dad can la ni byi tsher ba dang par ba ta sle tres bca' sga bskol ba ni khu ba bsgrangs par blud par bya
pairs.d4311: me dbal gyi nad skom dad che ba la ni byi tsher ba dang bar pa ta dang sle tres dang bca' sga dang de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba'am yang na grangs pa blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang

pairs.d4310: snu ha arka'i 'o mar bskol nas ni ska bar gyur pa lcags snod nang du gzhag de ni thur mas bskus na mdze nad dang sha bkra sme ba nag por gyur pa dang
pairs.d4311: go bye dang tsi tra ka dang shing su dha kshi ra dang arka'i rtsa ba dang 'ol ma se dang tsha ba gsum dang dung dang spangs ma dang ru rta dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang thal ba rnam gnyis dang lang ga li dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma su dha kshi ra dang a rga'i 'o ma dang bskol te ska bar gyur pa dang lcags snod kyi nang du bcug ste de las thur mas bskus na mdze dang sha bkra dang sme ba dang pags pa'i mdog snag tsha 'dra bar gyur pa dang gzhang 'brum dang pags pa'i sha mdzer dang de rnams 'joms par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: tang ga shu dag rgya tshwa 'o mar bskol ba blud shi kru bskol bar rgyam tshwa pi pi ling tsi tra ka btab mcher zags dmu chu skem glo zags se 'bru lnga pas pho ba bzung zangs thal skems bsten rjes la drug bdun bsreg pho long zags dang 'khyims chu zas drod dang thal sbyor bi sha'i skems sbyor bsten par bya shing kun tsa bya sgog skya rtsa ba lnga sman mar 'jam rtsi btang bas skems grogs 'gyur skran zags 'bras gsum tsha ba gsum po dang byi tang ga dang lcags phye tsi tra ka thal sman sbrang dang sbyar te btang bar bya thal sbyor rus sbyor bshig skems dus gcig byed rgyu rdol mi 'tsho

pairs.d4310: de dag sman ming rnam grangs yin yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o
pairs.d4311: sman pa chen po pha gol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las gso ba'i gnas zhes bya ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa rdzogs
pairs.rgyud_text: man ngag gi rgyud las gso thabs kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o le'u drug pa dpe don gyi rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so

pairs.d4310: yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u ste dang po'o de nas bkru sman bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: cho ga grub pa'i gnas las le'u dang po rdzogs so de nas bkru sman gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: rgyud zhus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o de nas ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig dang po nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs bstan pa

pairs.d4310: zos na mdze dang gzhang 'brum dang mig ser za khu skran dang ni dmu rdzing mtshan bar rdol ba dang pho ba'i nad dang skya rbab rnams
pairs.d4311: cho ga bsrung mi dgos par 'di las ran par 'thungs na mdze dang gzhang 'brum dang mig ser dang gcin nad dang skran dang dmu rdzing dang mtshan bar rdol ba dang pho ba'i nad dang skya rbab kyi nad rnams 'joms shing bud med bu med pa la bu yang skye bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: bcu dgu'o smad nad gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol ba dang rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldags dang g.yan pa glang shu za rkong shu ba dang reg pa'i dug dang mdzer pa ngo khab dang nad gzhan lpags la gram dang bcu ru

pairs.d4310: zla mtshan nad dang smyo byed dang 'or nad lud pa rde'u chags dang gcin 'khyil ba yi nad rnams 'joms
pairs.d4311: de bzhin du brla phrag dang brla dang rked pa dang dku dang gnya' rengs dang rna ba dang mgo bo rnams su na zhing zug pa dang zla mtshan gyi nad dang smyo byed dang skrang pa dang lud pa dang rde'u chags pa dang rlung 'khyil ba rnams sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: nas brtag pa ni dang po rlung rims brla dang rked pa na mgo lus yan lag lus kun brdungs snyam byed g.yal mang mgo 'khor rna ba sgra dang bcas gnyid yer mu 'gram mgo bo zug cing gzer spu ldang pags pa brtse la rngul mi 'byung rkang lag mgo bo 'dar zhing bla 'chol smra kha zas

pairs.d4310: gnod sbyin gdon la 'o ma zho mar dang 'bras chan bsres pa dang gu gul padma thang shing dang
pairs.d4311: gnod sbyin gyi gdon la ni 'o ma dang zho dang mar dang 'bras chan bsres pa'i zas dang gu gul dang sgron shing dang padma dang pu shel tsi dang gos dang gser rgyan du byas pa 'am
pairs.rgyud_text: zal chu dang lci ba dang 'o ma zho dang mar la sbrang rtsi sbyar ba yi rnam lnga'i sman mar mchin nad rnying tsha ba rlung ldan chu ser skya rbab 'joms a gar tsan dan gu gul snying zho sha rgun 'brum mar la ka

pairs.d4310: rgyam tsha bca' sga zho re dang skyer pa'i khanda srang phyed dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i mig sman gyis bad kan las gyur rab rib dang chu ser gyis gang ling tog dang mig mdzer bcas pa'i sha lhag sel
pairs.d4311: tsha mchog rgyam tshwa dang bca' sga dang de rnams zho re re dang skyer khanda srang phyed dang 'di rnams sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba mig tu bskus na bad kan las gyur pa'i rab rib dang mig chu ser gyis gang ba dang ling tog dang mig mdzer bcas pa'i lhag ma lus pa la phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: gu gul brag zhun skyer pa'i khanda dang sbrang sbyar 'tsho ches nad kun sel bar byed 'bras bu gsum dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'am bca' sga ya baksha ra byi tang ga skyu ru nas phye sbrang sbyar 'tsho nad sel 'tsho bas skem bzang brta ba tshod zin bya smyung bar bya la yul dang gang gis dmad phan yon drags skyon de yi bcos

pairs.d4310: khu ba mnyam med ces bya ste rab rib 'joms pa'i mchog yin no ba ru ra yi tshi gu na le sham skyu ru ra dang spangs ma shing mngar ni
pairs.d4311: du ba ma shor bar byas nas bsregs pa'i phye mas mig la bskus na gzhan dang mi 'dra bar khyad par du rab rib 'joms pa'i mchog yin te zla med do yang na ba ru ra'i tshi gu dang na le sham dang skyu ru ra dang spangs ma dang shing mngar dang de rnams chu thags su byas te
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri

pairs.d4310: slar bskol ska bar gyur pa ni ra gan dud pa srang bcu dang na le sham phye zho gnyis gzhug
pairs.d4311: pra punda ri ka dang shing mngar dang skyer pa dang de gsum srang brgyad brgyad chu srang lnga brgya rtsa bcu gnyis kyi nang du bskol te bzhi cha lus pa dang tshigs ma bor ba'i dngas ma de yang bskol te ska bar gyur pa'i nang du ra gan gyi dud pa srang bcu dang na le sham zho gnyis kyi phye ma btab ste
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug

pairs.d4310: skyer pa gla sgang sar pakshi bca' sga pi pi ling rtsa ba pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka ba ru na dang a ka ru bil ba nim pa pa ta li
pairs.d4311: yang na skyer ba dang 'bras gang dang sarba lo tsa na dang pi pi ling dang bca' sga dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang tsi tra ka dang ba ra na dang a ka ru dang bil ba dang pa ta li dang nim pa dang ru rta dang she lu dang na ga ge sar dang de rnams lhan cig sbyar ba 'am
pairs.rgyud_text: lugs star bu na ga ge sar dang ru rta tsha la dud pa bya bal ma ka ra sbyar la thun skyungs grangs mang btang gzer steng mtshan dkar tshar bong dro 'jam bdug des ma thon na man ngag star bu ru rta tsha la rgyal blon bshal gyis sbyang dug thabs rgyal blon gsum sbyar rtse chung bsnol nad dang sman dpyad srog la thob sha bya skyed med ga bur se

pairs.d4310: lud pa dbugs mi bde rims dang skems dang snying nad dreg nad dang gcin dang khu chu la gnas dang skad 'gags pa yang sel bar byed
pairs.d4311: drang srong de sngon rgas 'khogs par gyur pa las bud med rnams kyi mig zim par byed pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang rims dang glo snying gi nad dang dreg nad dang gcin dang khu chu la gnas pa'i nad dang skad 'gags pa dang de bzhin du nyams stobs skye ba dang glo 'grams pa dang glo nyams pa dang gcong zad byed kyis lus skams shing nyam chung ba dang 'phel ba byed pa dang dran pa dang yid gzhungs pa dang gzi mdangs skyed pa dang nad med cing tshe rab tu 'phel ba dang rlung lugs su 'byung ba dang bud med rnams la shin tu dga' ba skyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa dang stobs skyed pa dang dbang po rnams gsal bar byed pa dang cho ga bzhin du byas na me'i drod kyang skyed par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: de bzhin tsha bas gdungs nas grang ba spong cho ga bzhin byas nad la skyed med cing cho ga log pas bde bar gnas snyam byed de dag 'chi ba'i ltas su bshad pa yin shin tu nye ba 'byung ba rnam pa lnga dbang po lnga po rim pas thim pa ste sa nus chu la thim pas gzugs mi mthong chu nus me la thim pas bu ga skam me nus rlung la thim pas drod rnams sdud rlung nus mkha' la thim pas phyi dbugs chad mig gi dbang po nyams par gyur pa yis gzugs mi gsal zhing sgra la thim par 'gyur rna ba'i dbang po nyams par gyur pa yis sgra mi gsal zhing dri la thim par 'gyur sna yi dbang po nyams par gyur pa yis dri mi gsal zhing ro la thim par 'gyur lce yi dbang po nyams par gyur pa yis ro mi gsal

pairs.d4310: gla sgang par pa ta ni rims la phan skom dad che la bong pa bsregs pa ni chu yi nang du gsur pa'i dngas ma phan
pairs.d4311: rims la ni gla sgang dang par pa ta phan no skom dad che ba la ni bong ba tshig pa bsregs pa chu'i nang du gsur ba sbyin na phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: skam mcher pa zags pa g.yon nas 'phel ba la chu yi nang na mcher pa rdo ltar sra pho ba sbo 'khrog 'ju stobs chung ba yin glo ba zags pa glo mang glo snying sprug zos rjes pho

pairs.d4310: zur gsum srid du sor gsum pas sha chung pa dang rus tshigs na rma yod pa la srid sor gnyis
pairs.d4311: khab kyi srid sor gsum pa la mgo zlum po mig gi zabs cher btod pa kha srab par byas pa de lta bu gsum dgos te mi sha chen po sar ni mgo zur gsum pa srid sor gsum yod par bya'o sha chung ba dang rus pa dang tshigs kyi bar na rma yod pa rnams la srid sor gnyis par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: sog le zheng du sor gnyis so zhib pa srid sor bcu pas rus pa lhag pa 'breg chan pa rno bas rma yi rtsa rgyus bcad sbubs can sor lnga sog le'i kha 'dra ba 'khor lo ldan pa rus pa 'bugs pa'i gsor sor bcu be le kha 'dra rtse gug pa rna ba sna dang gre ba'i 'brum pa bcad mngal thur mtho gang rtse gug bu shi dbyung

pairs.d4310: tshor ba zhi phyir zhag gsum ni pu tse shel dang bong nga dkar ba sha ka yi shun pa dang shing kun te dzo ba ti rnams
pairs.d4311: yang na pu tse shel dang bong nga dkar po dang ka ta ga dang shing kun dang te dzo ba ti dang 'di rnams btags te phye mar byas pa'am
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram

pairs.d4310: chu yi gnas dang sprin yang mthong ba yin tshangs pa drag po dbang po chu lha dang nam mkha' lding dang ngang pa glang po mchog de bzhin seng ge dang ni khyu mchog dang
pairs.d4311: dang ngo tsha shes pa dang bla ma la gus pa dang snying nye ba dang mdza' ba brtan pa dang rtag tu glo ba dang rmi lam gyi nang na me tog padma dang nam mkha' la bya mang po phreng ba ltar brgyus pa 'phur ba dang mtsho dang sprin mthong ba dang tshangs pa dang drag po dang dbang po dang chu lha dang nam mkha' lding dang ngang pa dang glang po che'i mchog dang seng ge dang rta dang khyu mchog dang de rnams dang 'dra bar mthong na bad kan gyi rang bzhin can du shes par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: nyi ma me long chu dang nam mkha' la gzugs brnyan mgo bcad yan lag med na 'chi de nas nye ba'i ltas la rnam gnyis te nye ba dang ni shin tu nye ba'o nye ba'i ltas la dug mtshon ma phog par bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag smras 'phral brjed mje nub rlig pa 'phyang ngam go ldog dang lud pa sbrid pa sngon med sgra 'byung dang mar me shi ba'i dri ma mi tshor dang skra phyis tshor med spyi bor snum bcas snang skra smin gsar du mtshams bye rtsub 'khyil dang dpral ba chu sor zla tshes rtsa ris snang dbang po yul lnga tha

pairs.d4310: yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las lus kyi gnas kyi le'u drug pa'o yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las
pairs.d4311: yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las lus kyi gnas zhes bya ba'i le'u drug pa rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i gnas gnyis pa'o
pairs.rgyud_text: rlung gi nad gso ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig mkhris pa'i nad la

pairs.d4310: shing tsha sug smel tsha ba gsum rgun 'brum pi pi ling rtsa ba ma nu 'bras yos gla sgang dang zur pa dkar dang ra sna dang skyu ru ra dang ba ru ra
pairs.d4311: byo sha zhes bya ba'i tsha ba gsum dang rgun 'brum dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang ma nu dang 'bras yos dang gla sgang dang zur pa dkar po dang ra sna dang skyu ru ra dang sha kha ra 'di rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i lde gu zos na snying nad dang lud pa'i nad sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: tra ka pi pi ling dang zur pa ma nu yi phye ma mar bskol thogs med 'gro nus 'gyur bi sha tse dang gzugs 'khums gar yod ngos mthe'u chung srin lag rgyab kyi rgyus pa la ser po snal ma 'dra ba yod de bcad sra 'theng la sogs phyi ma'i rlung rnams kun rgyu las brtags la snum dugs gtar ba dang sbyang dang byug sogs ci rigs sbyar bar bya rgya

pairs.d4310: rlung mkhris snying 'dzag gzer nad sel gcin sri ba dang gcin snyi ba gzhang 'brum lud pa lus skem dang zad byed rims ni sel byed cing
pairs.d4311: gzhan yang gcin sri ba dang gcin nad dang gzhang 'brum dang lud pa dang lus skem pa dang zad byed rnams la phan zhing gzhu 'dren pas dub pa dang bud med kyis dub pa dang khur chen pos dub pa dang chang gis dub pa dang lam gyis dub pa rnams la phan te stobs dang sha skyed par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: sel lan tshwas rlung dang bad kan sel byed cing lce myang rgyam tsha ma gtogs mkhris pa skyed ha cang thal drags lci bas bad kan skyed kha bas mkhris sel bad rlung skyed na yang ka da dang sle tres bad rlung sel tsha bas rlung dang bad kan sel byed la sgog skya pi pi ling min mkhris pa skyed ha cang thal drags yang rtsub rlung yang

pairs.d4310: de las ran par 'thungs na ni zad byed lud pas nyen pa sel ka sa mar da a ru ra gla sgang pa ta kad pa la dong gra pi pi ling tang pal
pairs.d4311: ya baksha ra dang sardzi ka'i thal ba dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang 'di rnams btab ste de las ci ran par 'thungs na zad byed dang lud pas nyam thag pa sel to ka sa mar da dang a ru ra dang gla sgang dang pa tha dang kad pa la dang dong gra dang pi pi ling dang pu tse shel dang tang pa la dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis tshul bzhin du bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus ma zhu skyug pa sel bar byed dur thod

pairs.d4310: zad byed lud pas nyen pa sel ka sa mar da a ru ra gla sgang pa ta kad pa la dong gra pi pi ling tang pal
pairs.d4311: ya baksha ra dang sardzi ka'i thal ba dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang 'di rnams btab ste de las ci ran par 'thungs na ka sa mar da dang a ru ra dang gla sgang dang pa tha dang kad pa la dang dong gra dang pi pi ling dang pu tse shel dang tang pa la dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis tshul bzhin du bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril

pairs.d4310: skyu ru ra ni bre gang dang ka pid ta ni srang bcu dang pi sha la ni srang lnga dang seng phrom shing tsha na le sham pi pi ling dang byi dang ga
pairs.d4311: yang na chu srang nyis stong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi nang du a ru ra'i phyi shun skam po srang brgyad dang skyu ru ra skam po srang bcu drug dang ka pid ta srang bcu dang bi sha la srang lnga dang seng phrom dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang byi dang ga dang shing tsha dang de rnams srang gnyis gnyis dang 'di rnams cham chom brdungs te bskol la bzhi cha srang lnga brgya rtsa bcu gnyis lus pa dang btsags pa'i khu ba'i nang du 'bru mar srang nyis brgya dang da ta
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba zla

pairs.d4310: bad kan bcas khrag bca' sga dang dug mo nyung shun bskol ba blud yang na rtsa mkhris bca' sga dang byi tsher tsandan dmar po'am
pairs.d4311: bad kan las gyur pa'i khrag 'dzag pa la ni bca' sga dang dug mo yungs kyi shun phrags bskol ba'i khu ba blud do yang na rtsa mkhris dang bca' sga dang byi tshor ba dang tsandan dmar po dang 'di rnams bskol ba'i khu ba blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang

pairs.d4310: gzar bur chags pa'i bu ram lde gu yis skran dang mcher nang gzhang 'brum mdze nad dang gcin nad me drod nyams pa 'joms par byed
pairs.d4311: de las ran par zos na skran dang mcher pa'i nad dang gzhang 'brum dang mdze dang gcin nad dang me'i drod nyams pa 'joms par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: nad dang le'u bcu dgu'o lhan skyes rma la 'bras dang gzhang 'brum dang me dbal sur ya rmen bu rlig rlugs dang rkang bam mtshan bar rdol dang le'u brgyad byis pa nyer spyod nad

pairs.d4310: kun dang dug dang dbyig dug 'joms rtswa mkhris dang ni pu tse shel pa to nim pa par pa ta
pairs.d4311: snga ma'i mar dang lhan cig lag pa'i nang du lde gur byas te zho gnyis tsam 'thungs la de zhu ba'i tshod tsam na sbrang rtsi la sogs pa mngar ba'i zas zos na rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i nad thams cad las grol te khyad par du dug dang dbyig dug 'joms so tig ta dang pu tse shel dang pa to la dang nim pa dang par pa ta dang 'di rnams gong ma ltar bsregs pa'i thal ba dang ma he'i gcin dang bsres te 'thungs na me drod skyed par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: gla sgang par pa ta dang dug mo nyung pa to la dang rtsa mkhris bsnan la btang zla gcig phar 'das rims rnying tsha ba rnams sle tres pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum thang mang btang rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar skabs su rngul dbyung mig chu ser na sbyang bshang gci phyen 'gags pa la bya kr i dang gze ma 'o ma bur rnying bskol ba phan mdog sngo sha skam dang ga bde ba na tsha ba phyi ru byer bas chu lcag phan rtsa khrid na 'phreng lci na cung zad gtar tshigs gzhi rus pa na skrangs chu

pairs.d4310: sru sru'i rtsa ba 'jag zlum dang bi da ri dang ba ra hi 'bras kyi rtsa ba gze ma dang ba lu ka dang pa ta li
pairs.d4311: dar ba dang bi da ri dang ba ri hi dang 'bras kyi rtsa ba dang gze ma dang ba lu ka dang ba ta ka dang lcags phye dang ku ru ta ka dang ba spru ba dang shi ri sha dang de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba mar dang lhan cig bskol ba'i nang du ga gon la sogs pa'i sa bon dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i mchog ra mnye nye shing lca ba ba spru ba gze ma 'bri mar rtsa ba lnga yi mar tshwa sna gsum dang sle tres bzang po gsum bca' sga pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar mkhal ma'i grang nad rlung tshabs sel bar byed 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres pa 'ba' sam zhes bya stod smad kun la bsngags 'ba' sam de nang da byid lug thug

pairs.d4310: bad kan rlung las gyur pa'i nad gso dka' skran dang 'phyen dang ni gcin dang phyi sa 'gags pa dang lkog ma 'gags shing snying nad dang skya rbab yi ga 'chus pa dang mcher pa gzhang 'brum skyigs bu dang rgyu rlugs lto sbos me drod nyams lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel
pairs.d4311: snying ga dang rtsib logs dang chu so dang mjug to dang mngal dang 'jang dang 'di rnams su zug cing na ba dang rlung dang bad kan dang ma zhu ba las byung ba'i nad dang gso dka' ba'i skran dang rlung dang gcin dang phyi sa 'gags pa dang ske 'gags pa dang stod 'dzings pa dang skya rbab dang yi ga 'chus pa dang mcher pa na ba dang gzhang 'brum dang skyigs bu dang rlig rlugs dang lto sbo ba dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa dang me'i drod nyams pa rnams 'joms par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: mngal rtsa skran bcu gcig bad rlung las gyur pa'i grang ba'i skran la thur ma mchog yin te khrag mkhris las gyur tsha ba'i skran rnams kyang bcos brdugs tshad chogs rnyings nas thur mas bshig dmu chu grang ba'i zag chu 'khyims chu gtsag rlangs 'khyims mgo la bad kan rlangs 'khyims dang byang khog stod du bad rlung rlangs 'khyims dang glo snying pho bar rlangs 'khyims thur mas gsang sha la chu ser bems dang skrangs pa dang mgo dang byang khog yan lag chu ser dang rnag khrag zhugs pa thur mas dbyung bar bya mi rung shin tu rgas dang byis pa dang sman

pairs.d4310: tsha ba gsum dang bil ba dang ser po gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum ba spru ba gnyis gla sgang dang lcags phye ba ta byi dang ga thang shing breshtsi ka li dang ga bra'i rtsa ba 'o ma mar
pairs.d4311: 'dus pa las gyur pa la ni de rnams bsres pa sbyar ro tsha ba gsum dang bil ba dang ser po rnam gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum dang ba spru ba rnam gnyis dang gla sgang dang lcags phye dang byi dang ga dang thang shing dang brishtsi ka li dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang 'di rnams cham chom brdungs te
pairs.rgyud_text: bu rnam pa bzhi tsha gsum thal ba gnyis dang bu ram sbyar chu tshan 'phul bas grang nad ma lus sel mtha' 'khob yul gyi sngo sbyor man ngag 'di sems la long la byams pas 'gro don gyis zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sngo sbyor gyi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o de

pairs.d4310: ba gcin sbyar blud dmu rdzing dang mdze dang skya rbab srin bu'i nad gcin nad bad kan za khu dang rlung ni stod du 'byams pa sel
pairs.d4311: skrang pa dang dmu rdzing dang mdze dang skya rbab dang srin bu'i nad dang bad kan dang gcin nad dang rlung stod du zhugs pa rnams 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dus gcong nad ma zhu skran dang skya rbab dang 'or dang dmu chu gcong chen zad byed drug tsha ba spyi dang gal mdo ri thang mtshams ma smin rgyas stongs gab rnyings rnyogs pa dang

pairs.d4310: bad kan las gyur nim pa dang lo ma bdun pa tsi tra ka ru rta dong gra tsha ba gsum
pairs.d4311: mdze nad bad kan las gyur pa la ni nim pa dang lo ma bdun pa dang tsi tra ka dang ru rta dang tsha ba gsum dang
pairs.rgyud_text: tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab

pairs.d4310: tig ta nim pa 'bras bu gsum shug pa bong nga pi pi ling mur ba dang ni pa to la ser po rnam gnyis pu tse shel
pairs.d4311: ril bu 'di'i ming yang nor bu bzang po zhes grags pa yin no tig ta dang nim pa dang 'bras bu gsum dang shug pa dang bong nga dkar po dang pi pi ling dang mur ba dang pa to la dang ser po rnam gnyis dang pu tse shel dang in dra ba ru ni dang dug mo yungs dang shu dag dang 'di rnams cha snyoms pa dang dan ti dang de'i nyis 'gyur gyi dur byid dang de'i nyis 'gyur gyi bramhi dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang lde gur byas pa ran par zos na mdze dang gcin nad dang rmongs bag tu 'dug pa rnams la phan pa'i mchog yin no

pairs.rgyud_text: dang rus khu rgyam tshwa'i phye btab btso de rnams gang yang rlung nad ma lus 'joms lus kyi stobs skyed dbang shes gsal bar byed ri thang mtshams kyi rlung la bdud rtsi 'dra phye ma dza ti shing kun kha ru tshwa tsabs ru tshwa dang rgyam tshwa tsha ba
