pairs.d4311: 'o ma lus pa dang 'o ma'i bzhi cha'i srog chags thang la gnas pa'i sha khu dang mar dang sbrang rtsi dang rgyam tshwa dang shing mngar dang shu ti dang pi pi ling dang dug mo yungs dang skyer khanda dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma btab ste bsres pa'i 'jam rtsi dro 'jam tsam mas gtong na
pairs.rgyud_text: ma'i ro gsum bsten nas rnying skam sa'i sha dang sbrang rtsi dang chu sol sga thang btang zhing rtsub pa bsten rtsol bas bcag dang dril phyis bad kan bsal dri zhim skyed mos tshal gyi nyi grib 'dug so ga nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha bas stobs 'phrog phyir na mngar yang snum bsil bza' lan tshwa tsha skyur rtsol ba nyi 'od spang bsil chus

pairs.d4310: kha zas mngar dang yid 'ong sbyin de 'og skyur dang lan tshwar bcas de nas mngar dang kha ba sbyin de 'og bska dang tsha ba sbyin
pairs.d4311: de ltar slon khrus kyis lus dag pa'i nad pa de la ni thog mar kha zas mngar ba dang yi gar 'ong ba sbyin no de'i 'og tu skyur ba dang lan tshwar bcas pa sbyin no de'i 'og tu mngar ba dang kha ba sbyin no de'i 'og tu bska ba dang tsha ba sbyin no
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i sman ro kha ba dang mngar ba dang bska ba dang nus pa bsil ba dang rtul ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su tsha ba'i nad mi 'byung

pairs.d4310: sbrang rtsi mar sbyar lde gu ni pho ba'i me drod skyed pa'i mchog rlung ni bde bar rgyu bar byed 'khru ba'i rims dang dbugs mi bde
pairs.d4311: skyer pa dang sre ya ni dang bri ha ti dang kr ishna parni dang shu ti dang de rnams sbrang rtsi dang mar dang lhan cig lde gur byas te bldag tu bcug na pho ba'i me drod skyed pa'i mchog yin te rlung nad lugs bzhin 'byung zhing tshad par 'khru ba dang rims dang dbugs mi bde ba dang
pairs.rgyud_text: zho bzhi bur srang gcig mar rnying srang bdun lde gur byas te btang mi rus bsdus khur sgog skya shing kun bran mthil bzhi tshigs pa rlung gsang sku mnye dang rlung gsang bzhi bsro mar rnying 'jam rtsi bya sha chang mar rnying bu ram drod bcud bsten byis pa bad kan grang shas che ba dang bad kan yul du tsha ba babs pa dang ma smin

pairs.d4310: nub mo rgyu ba'i sems can gyi rus pa rkang gis gang ba dang lig bu mig dang bcas pa ni 'bab chu'i nang du zla gcig gam

pairs.rgyud_text: mchin rtsa tshad sel lig bu mig dang btsag yug rnam la sogs mig nad rus tshad sel zhing chu ser skem cong zhis 'khru gcod bad kan tsha ba sel rdo thal pho ba'i bad kan 'dril ba gcod ha shig

pairs.d4310: skyer pa'i khanda sra rtsi pog ra gan dud pa ldong ros dang rgya mtsho'i lbu ba rgyam tsha dang
pairs.d4311: skyer khanda dang sra rtsi phog dang ra gan gyi dud pa dang ldong ros dang rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dang rgyam tsha dang btsag yug snam dang na le sham dang 'di rnams sbrang rtsi las btags pa mig sman du bskus na
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang

pairs.d4310: shing mngar dang ni da ta ki utpa la yi lo ma dang btsod dang seng phrom rgya skyegs dang ka pid ta yi khu ba dang
pairs.d4311: pri yang ku dang shing mngar dang am pastha dang da ta ki dang utpa la dang 'dab ma rnam bzhi dang btsod dang seng phrom dang rgya skyegs dang de rnams ka pid ta'i rang gi khu ba dang til mar lhan cig bskol te rna bar blugs na rnag khrag zag pa zhi bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra ga dur ka ra cha mnyam

pairs.d4310: 'di la srin bu snum zhing ring dkar zhing phra ba 'byung bar bshad de smin mtshan ma lus yang zhing
pairs.d4311: srin bu de yang snum zhing ring ba dang dkar zhing phra ba rnams yin te de nyid smin pa'i mtshan ma ni lus yang ba dang sbrid pa zhi ba dang 'dzag pa yang 'jam zhing ser ba dang dri dang ro mi tshor ba rnams yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: khar gdags de ltar bcos pas sos pa'i mtshan ma ni rtsa bying khar thon phra ba sbom du song drag pa dal la grims pa lhod pa dang stongs pa mkhrang la spun pa ring du song chu mdog dwangs la dri chung ku ya srab zug chogs snying rtsa seng la zas ro rnyed dbugs

pairs.d4310: nam tshod yan chad gtogs pa'i nad nyis brgya sum cu rtsa gcig yin de dag phan tshun ma 'dres par rgya cher rab tu bshad pa yin
pairs.d4311: de ltar nam tshong yan chad kyi nad nyis brgya sum cu so gcig po phan tshun ma 'dres par rgya cher bza' ba yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i sgo yin phyir mgo dang nam tshong yan chad nad la mchog khyad par gur kum zhun mar ka ra sbyar mgo rlung khrag 'thab gzer nad 'khyug pa 'joms shing mngar skyu ru ka

pairs.d4310: so ma ra dza dang ni ba spru ba de bzhin dro na ma ha dro na dang sbrul la yod pa'i nor bu ma na si
pairs.d4311: rin po che ke ke ru dang margad dang mu tig dang rdo rje dang bai durya dang garbha ma ni dang pi tsu ka dang byi ba'i dug dang de bzhin du ri kha ba can na skyes pa'i sman so ma ra dza dang ba spru ba dang dro na dang ma ha dro na zhes bya ba dang sbrul la yod pa'i nor bu dang ma na si dang dug zhi bar bya bar 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: rnam pa sna tshogs pas brgyan pa ste nor bu rin po che des ni rlung gi nad dang mkhris pa'i nad dang bad kan gyi nad dang ldan pa'i nad dang 'dus pa'i nad las gyur pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sel bar byed pa tsha ba'i nad la bsil du gyur pa grang ba'i nad la drod du gyur pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi bar byed pa dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du grub par byed pa yod do grong

pairs.d4310: shu dag shing kun byi dang ga rgyam tsha ha ti pi pi ling ba tha bong nga tsha ba gsum
pairs.d4311: shu dag dang shing kun dang byi dang ga dang rgyam tsha dang ha ti pi pi ling dang pa tha dang bong nga dkar po dang tsha ba gsum dang de rnams lhan cig sbyar ba la ni yan lag bcu pa zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: mgo lta bu srid sor bcu pa tel pa zhes bya ste 'bras dang lhog pa skrangs pa bsreg par bya dbal ldan phra 'jam gug po sha yi khab sha dang pags pa ral ba btsem la sbyar de ltar cha byad nad dang gang mkho spyad ces gsungs so bdud rtsi snying

pairs.d4310: seng phrom shug pa padma ge sar dang tsandan dmar ser pri yang ku'i me tog
pairs.d4311: seng phrom dang pu shel tsi dang shug pa dang padma ge sar dang tsandan ser po dang tsandan dmar po dang pri yang ku'i me tog dang pa ya sya dang padma'i rtsa lag dang de rnams sbyor ba thams cad sbyor ba las sbyar na srog chags lu ta'i dug thams cad 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: sel na ga pushpa na ga ge sar dang padma ge sar glo mchin snying tshad sel zi ra dkar pos glo yi tshad pa sel zi ra nag pos mchin pa'i grang ba sel la la phud kyis pho nad grang ba sel so ma ra dzas lpags nad chu ser sel thal ka rdo rje dag kyang de bzhin no gser gyi

pairs.d4310: dha du ra yi 'bras bu dang gi ri kar ni ba spru ba bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya til btags lde gu arka lcags
pairs.d4311: yang na lang tang rtse'i 'bras bu dang ge ri karni dang ba spru ba rnams bskol ba'i khu ba blud do til btags pa'i lde gu dang ru sha dang lcags phye dang 'o ma dang bu ram bsres pa blud na
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna

pairs.rgyud_text: lug sha 'bri yi 'o ma mar ru rta de ba da ru pi pi ling rgyam tshwa a ru ra sbyar sle 'jam yin gnyis pa chur gnas sha khu ba 'o mar gong sman dur byid sbyar ba bkru 'jam mo gsum pa skam

pairs.d4310: lig bu mig dang stang zil dang lcim rtsa padma ge sar dang btsod dang ya ba sha ka dang shal ma li dang de'i khu ba
pairs.d4311: gandha pri yang ku dang mig sman ra gan gyi dud pa dang lig bu mig dang stang zil dang me tog padma'i ze ba dang lcim rtsa dang btsod dang ya ba sha ka dang shing shal ma shi li dang shing shal ma li'i khu ba dang pu na na ga dang sa mang ga dang tsandan dkar po dang me tog dha ta ki dang am pa shtha dang shing mngar dang nam ska ri dang nam ti bri ga sha dang rgya skyegs shing dang ro dha seng phrom dang da ta ki dang shing bil ba dang pe shing ka dang ka tang ga dang padma'i ge sar ze ba dang sman 'di rnams ni sman sde rnam gnyis te
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung gla sgang bong nga dkar po ba le ka re skon ka ra sbyar ba'i mkhris phye bdun rgyu long bsnad 'grams khrag mkhris tsha 'khru gcod cong zhi se 'bru sug smel pi pi ling ma nu gur kum ka ra cong zhi drug bad

pairs.d4311: chang las nad du gyur pa lta bu dang mig rab rib za ba dang dmu rdzing du gyur te lto cher skyes pa dang shu ba mched pa dang mdze nad dang 'or nad skrang bag dang tsha ba mkhris pa'i nad yod pa dang 'o ma dang zho dang mar 'thungs pa dang sbrang rtsi 'thungs pa dang bkru sman btang ba dang lus snad pa dang gzhang 'brum khrag tshad 'ong ba dang sems 'khrugs pa dang mya ngan gyis btab pa dang 'jigs shing bag tsha ba lta bu yod pa dang bkres pa dang skom pa'am mig ser gyis btab pa 'am

pairs.rgyud_text: sog le zheng du sor gnyis so zhib pa srid sor bcu pas rus pa lhag pa 'breg chan pa rno bas rma yi rtsa rgyus bcad sbubs can sor lnga sog le'i kha 'dra ba 'khor lo ldan pa rus pa 'bugs pa'i gsor sor bcu be le kha 'dra rtse gug pa rna ba sna dang gre ba'i 'brum pa bcad mngal thur mtho gang rtse gug bu shi dbyung

pairs.d4310: btsir na mngon par dga' ba dang khab kyis rab tu gtsags snyam byed yan lag na zhing zug pa yin
pairs.d4311: reg na shin tu tsha ba dang btsir na mngon par dga' ba dang khab kyis gtsags pa snyam byed pa dang yan lag rnams na zhing zug pa yin no

pairs.d4310: bsku dang dugs dang mnye ba bya rims der rlung nad zhi bya dang khyad par du ni 'jam rtsi bya
pairs.d4311: rims de rus pa dang rkang la gnas na ni dugs dang mnye ba dang bsku byug dang rlung nad zhi ba'i sman rnams bya ste khyad par du 'jam rtsi mas gtong na phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: 'byung de sman reng bu mas btang lus bcing dang bsku byug dugs dang sman mar bsten par bya khu ba bkag pas de 'dzag pho mtshan na chu 'gag rde 'u 'phel dang ma ning 'gyur mas btang lus bcing bud med spyad

pairs.d4311: brgyad cha lus pa dang tshigs ma bor ba'i nang du mar srang brgyad dang ba sha ka'i me tog srang gnyis phye mar byas te btab pa yang bskol te bsgrangs pa'i nang du sbrang rtsi dang ldan par 'thungs na khrag mkhris dang mkhris pa'i skran dang rims dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa dang snying nad dang mig ser dang rab rib dang mgo 'khor ba dang me dbal dang skad 'gags pa rnams 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: mdze skran khrag mkhris nad dang mig ser dang rnyil nad bskyod dka' mig dang gcin lpags dmar sha 'phel lba ba rmen bu sha rgyas 'gyur tshil 'phel ngal dang nu ma gsus tshil skye rus pa 'phel bas rus lhag so lhag 'byung rkang 'phel lus lci mig g.yung tshigs kha sbom khu 'phel khu ba'i rde 'gyur bud med dad bshang 'phel lus lci lto sbo rgyu ma 'khrug gcin 'phel chu sor zug cing ma gcis sems rngul 'phel rngul che dri ldog lpags nad

pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid

pairs.d4310: tshim byed brtas byed stobs skyed cing rlung gi snying nad 'joms pa yin snying nad drod che 'phar ba dang
pairs.d4311: tshim par byed pa dang lus 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa dang stobs skyed cing rlung las gyur pa'i snying nad 'joms so rlung las gyur pa'i snying nad me drod che ba dang snying 'dzag pa dang 'phar ba la ni 'o ma dang zho dang bu ram dang mar dang chu na gnas pa dang khyim na gnas pa'i phyugs kyi sha rnams zos shing 'thungs na phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong rngam pa bde sna rdog mnyen zhing

pairs.d4310: tsha ba lnga dang ya ru ra ya baksha ra la la phud lce myang tsha dang kha ru tsha pa ta 'u su na le sham
pairs.d4311: tsha ba rnam lnga dang a ru ra dang ya baksha ra dang lce myang tsha dang pa tha dang 'u su dang na le sham dang bil ba dang mar dang de'i bzhi 'gyur gyi zho dang chu dang tshul bzhin bskol ba 'thungs na gzhang 'brum dang brla brag tu na ba dang gzhang phyir byung ba dang gcin sri zhing 'dzag pa rnams las myur du rgyal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman

pairs.d4310: da ta ki dang rgun 'bru 'bra go dang skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu srang gnyis gnyis pa ta bong nga dkar po byi tsher ba star bu tsha ba gsum dang shing tsha dang sug smel 'u su spra ki ka ko la
pairs.d4311: snod snum can gyi nang du bcug ste de'i nang du da ta ki dang rgun 'brum srang gnyis gnyis dang 'bra go dang skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu dang 'di gnyis srang gnyis gnyis dang pa tha dang bong nga dkar po dang byi tsher ba dang star bu dang tsha ba gsum dang shing tsha dang sug smel dang 'u su dang 'bu su hang dang bu tshang rdo dang li shi dang byi dang ga dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang kru trug tres dang 'di rnams srang re re btags pa'i phye ma dang bu ram srang brgya bcug ste
pairs.rgyud_text: le sham dang shing tsha dang sug smel bca' sga pi pi ling dang drug tshad ldan sbyar bas 'khru skyug dbugs mi bde gzhang 'brum skran dang skya rbab glo nad sel zi ra bsdebs pas stod tsha smad grang 'joms kha ru tshwa bsdebs grang rlung spyi la phan dza ti bsdebs pas snying rlung 'joms par byed star bu bsdebs pas lud pa 'gogs dka' 'dren da trig bsdebs pas grang bas 'khru ba gcod da lis shing tsha sug smel ka ko la zi ra pi pi ling dang na le sham 'khru skyug ma zhu lcags dreg lhen skran 'joms pho ba'i zug gzer 'joms shing yi ga 'byed

pairs.d4310: zho dang 'o ma mar til mar bca' sga bu ram bcas pa blud yang na rgya shug 'bras bu spangs
pairs.d4311: yang na phyi sa btsir yang mi 'byung ba la ni zho dang 'o ma dang mar dang bca' sga dang bu ram dang sbyar ba btung ngo yang na rgya shug gi 'bras bu sbangs pa bu ram dang til mar du bcas pa bza'o
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil

pairs.d4310: smin dang drod skyed byed mchog yin bal bu'i lo ma dbyi mo dang pi pi ling ni srang re dang pi pi ling dang de rtsa srang gnyis gnyis bca' sga srang gsum dang dri sna gsum dang pu shel tse zho ni gnyis gnyis phyir zhib btags
pairs.d4311: rgya shug gang yang rung ba'i khu ba las ri lur byas te zos na 'khru ba smin pa dang drod skyed pa'i mchog yin no bal bu'i lo ma dang dbyi mo dang na le sham srang re re dang pi pi ling mu la srang gnyis dang bca' sga srang gsum dang dri sna bzhi dang pu shel tsi zho gnyis gnyis dang de rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma'i sum 'gyur gyi bu ram dang ri lur byas pa la ni bal bu'i ri lu zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs

pairs.d4310: me drod skyed pa'i dam pa yin gzer dang skran dang dmu rdzing dang lud pa dbugs mi bde ba dang rlung dang bad kan 'joms par byed yang na skyur rtsi chen po yi khu bar bskol ba'i mar blud bya
pairs.d4311: zug gzer dang skran dang dmu rdzing dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa dang rlung dang bad kan rnams 'joms so yang na skyur rtsi chen po'i khu ba dang gong ma'i sman lhan cig bza'o
pairs.rgyud_text: zi grang shum byed 'khrugs tshad gzer dang lud pa dbugs la gsal 'grams kyi tsha ba spyod lam drag rjes na dug tshad ma nges khol bur nad sna mang 'di dag mi 'khrul so so'i ngos 'dzin yin spang blang mu bzhir kha dmar gdags pa ni rtsa

pairs.d4310: tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum 'u su dbyi mong byi dang ga tsi tra ka ni lde gur byas
pairs.d4311: yang na tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum dang 'u su dang dbyi mo dang byi dang ga dang tsi tra ka dang 'di rnams mar dang 'o ma dang bcas pa bskol ba 'thungs na rlung las gyur pa'i skran sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags

pairs.d4310: skran dang snying nad gzhang 'brum dang glo nad lto sbos sbyar ba'i dug mdze dang dmu rdzing nad slong dang yi ga 'chus dang mcher pa'i nad
pairs.d4311: de yang skran dang snying nad dang gzhang 'brum dang skrangs pa dang lto sbos pa dang bcos pa'i dug dang mdze dang dmu rdzing dang ud kle sha'i nad dang yi ga 'chus pa dang mcher pa na ba dang pho ba na ba dang rims mi bzad pa dang skya rbab dang mig ser rnams 'joms par byed de
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dus gcong nad ma zhu skran dang skya rbab dang 'or dang dmu chu gcong chen zad byed drug tsha ba spyi dang gal mdo ri thang mtshams ma smin rgyas stongs gab rnyings rnyogs pa dang 'grams 'khrugs rims dang 'brum pa rgyu gzer dang gag lhog cham pa le'u bcu drug go lus stod mgo bo mig dang rna ba dang sna dang kha dang lba ba

pairs.d4310: skya rbab mig ser 'joms par byed 'di ni dan da tsi tra ka a ru ra yi lde gu yin
pairs.d4311: de yang skran dang snying nad dang gzhang 'brum dang skrangs pa dang lto sbos pa dang bcos pa'i dug dang mdze dang dmu rdzing dang ud kle sha'i nad dang yi ga 'chus pa dang mcher pa na ba dang pho ba na ba dang rims mi bzad pa dang skya rbab dang mig ser rnams 'joms par byed de 'di ni dan ti dang tsi tra ka dang a ru ra'i lde gu zhes bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dus gcong nad ma zhu skran dang skya rbab dang 'or dang dmu chu gcong chen zad byed drug tsha ba spyi dang gal mdo ri thang mtshams ma smin rgyas stongs gab rnyings rnyogs pa dang 'grams 'khrugs rims dang 'brum pa rgyu gzer dang gag lhog cham pa le'u bcu drug go lus stod mgo bo mig dang rna ba dang sna dang kha dang lba ba le'u drug don snod snying dang glo mchin mcher mkhal dang pho ba rgyu ma long

pairs.d4310: lto sbos tsha bas nyam thag cing skom dang brgyal bas non pa la rnga mo'i 'o ma blud par bya rtsub cing rlung shas che ba yi
pairs.d4311: khyad par du lus tsha ba dang lto sbo bas nyam thag pa dang skom dad che ba dang brgyal ba zil gyis non pa la yang rnga mo'i 'o ma sbyar ro rtsub cing rlung shas cher g.yo ba las gyur pa'i dmu rdzing gi nad dag par 'dod na ni
pairs.rgyud_text: ba rlung 'bud bcas rkyen gyis stongs pa rlung shas che ba yi tsha ba bsil thang phye ma rtsub mo dang gtar bshal rngul dang zas skom yen la gtad tshad gnya' chogs nas rlung skyes tshad gzhug 'bud gnas kyis stongs pa srog rtsar rlung gnas babs gnas kyi dbang gis tsha ba rlung gis 'bud rkyen des

pairs.d4310: me la bzhus nas gzar bu yis dkrugs nas nas kyi sbun pa'i nang zla gcig bzhag nas de rjes la phyung ste legs par bzhus nas ni a ru ra bskol khu ba dang zho ni skyur po bcas pa bskol
pairs.d4311: mar srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi nang du a ru ra srang sum cu rtsa gnyis btags pa dang lhan cig me la bzhus pa dang kha gzar gyis dkrug cing nas kyi sbun pa'i nang du zla ba gcig bzhag la de nas phyung la yang bzhus te yang a ru ra bskol ba'i chu dang zho skyur bo dang ldan par bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing skyed 'dra de yang bdun phrag sum cu rtsa brgyad kyi rlung gis bsgyur nas zla dgur 'phel 'gyur te zla ba dang po bdun phrag dang po'i dus 'o mar ru ma blug 'dra khu khrag 'dres bdun phrag gnyis pa nur nur po ru 'gyur bdun phrag gsum pa zho chags lta bur snang skyes bu 'dod pas dus 'dir thabs bsten te mtshan ma gsal bar ma gyur gong du bya

pairs.d4310: shing kun dang ni pi pi ling 'bras bu gsum dang thang shing dang ser po rnam gnyis go bye dang na le sham dkar pu tse shel seng phrom shu dag bca' sga dang bong nga gla sgang ru rta dang sa ra na dang lan tshwa dang
pairs.d4311: bad kan las gyur pa'i dmu rdzing 'bur ba dang brtan pa dang rlongs bag tu 'dug pa dang yi ga 'chus pa dang snying na ba dang me drod chung ba dang chang nad che ba la ni a rishta'i chang dang nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba chu dang sbyar ba ras kyis btsags la btung bar sbyin no shing kun dang pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum dang thang shing dang ser po rnam gnyis dang bse shing gi 'bras bu dang na le sham dkar po dang pu tse shel dang seng phrom dang shu dag dang ⋯ nyon tse dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang 'di rnams zhib tu btags la zho dang snum rnam bzhis sbrus la rdza ma kha sbyar gyi nang du du ba ma shor bar bsregs pa'i thal ba phyung la de la zho gnyis gnyis chang gi dngas ma dang zho ga chu dang chu dron dang a rishta dang a sa ba'i chang dang nas chang dang 'di rnams gang yang rung ba dang lhan cig sbyar ba 'thungs na dmu rdzing dang skran dang gtun lta bu'i nad dang tu ni dang skrang ba dang gsus pa dang mcher pa na ba dang
pairs.rgyud_text: til mar zhag dang zho mar gyis sbrus la rdza ma kha sbyar bsreg de nyid rgyal po rgod ma kha dang sbyar se 'bru brgyad dang nang nub ltag pa sprad de yis drod skyed dang ga 'byed par byed de rjes rgyam tshwa tsha la la la phud tsha ba lnga dang a ru'i thal sman sbyar bya rgod go bo spyang brun pho ba dang zi ra nag po kha ru tsabs ru tshwa tsha ba gsum dang sbyar la ltag pa sprad yang na za byed che chung thal sman sbyar se 'bru bzhi dang nang nub ltag pa sprad de yis drod skyed dang ga 'byed pa dang grang skran ma lus thal bar rlog par byed zhig nas snyir mngon zug che rtsa chu tsha gcod byed bshal gyis sbyangs rjes me yis bsreg bar gnas grang skran sgron shing 'bras bu gsum tshwa sna tshogs tshad se 'bru pi pi ling bzang po gsum dang tsha la spos dkar dang dur byid sngo yi tsha gsum rgod g.yag rwa phye ma chang sbrus sla ngar nus ldan bsreg thal ba bu ram sbyar ba chu skol dbul zhig nas sbyongs btang ma zhig thur ma brdeg thur rjes skran ro bshal gyis sbyang bar bya brang dang rtsib

pairs.d4310: snying nad mcher pa gzhang 'brum dang rtug 'gags nad rnams 'joms par byed bad kan dmu rdzing nyam chung la
pairs.d4311: snying na ba dang gzhang 'brum dang rtug pa 'gags pa rnams zhi bar byed do bad kan las gyur pa'i dmu rdzing nyam chung ba la ni ha ri sta'i chang dang ba gcin gyi btung ba dang sman gyi phye ma dang lcags las byas pa'i btung ba dang til mar thal sman
pairs.rgyud_text: bcu dgu'o smad nad gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol ba dang rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldags dang g.yan pa glang shu za rkong shu ba dang reg pa'i dug dang mdzer pa ngo khab dang nad gzhan lpags la gram dang bcu

pairs.d4310: bad kan las gyur la la phud rgyam tsha zi ra sbrang rtsi dang
pairs.d4311: bad kan las gyur pa la ni la la phud dang rgyam tsha dang zi ra dang sbrang rtsi dang tsha ba gsum 'di rnams kyis btab pa sbyin no
pairs.rgyud_text: 'o mar btsos sga dang rgyam tshwa btab pa dkar 'don yin lug sha'i khu bar sbyar ba dmar 'don no skyur 'don khugs pa'i glum la nye 'u byas mar rnying bu ram sga btab btsos pa'o

pairs.d4310: ta bya skyer pa'i shun pa dang dbyi mong pi pi ling rtsa ba thang shing rtsa ba gsum dgu
pairs.d4311: yang na ta bya dang skyer pa'i shun pa dang dbyi mo dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang thang shing dang tsha ba gsum la sogs pa sbyor ba gong ma'i
pairs.rgyud_text: byed bil ba mon cha ra dang da trig dang skyer pa'i me tog dar bar btab byas te tse gur btang na 'khru ba gcod par byed so ma ra dza bong nga dkar po yi bsdus thang dug gis

pairs.d4310: la la phud dang tsha ba lnga na le sham dang se 'bru dang pa ta 'u su star bu dang
pairs.d4311: ti mu sa dang nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang la la phud dang tsha ba rnam lnga dang na le sham dang se'u 'bru dang pa tha dang 'u su dang star bu dang ba la dang bil ba dang de rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang chu srang lnga brgya rtsa bcu gnyis dang mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bskol te mar lus pa dang de las ran par 'thungs na 'or nad dang gzhang 'brum dang skran dang gcin nad rnams 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong

pairs.d4310: bskus na sha bkra sel bar byed ka ka dzang gi rtsa ba dang ras bal sa bon 'dab ma dang la phug sa bon dar bar sbyar
pairs.d4311: lan bdun btsags la pri yang ku'i mar dang sbyar la bskol bas lus bsku byug byas na sha bkra sel to ka ka dzang ga'i rtsa ba dang ras bal gyi 'dab ma dang la phug gi sa bon dang de rnams dar ba dang btags te sbyar ba
pairs.rgyud_text: 'o sbyar btang rgyam tshwa tsha la la phug sa bon dang cong zhi tsha gsum sbrang la ril bu sbyar ru thung snod ka gung srin bar rtsa gtar rjes la pho gsang mdun rgyab rim pas bsro long 'grams shing kun kha ru tshwa dang ni pi pi ling gi bskol grang thang du btang yang

pairs.d4310: bu ga'i rma dang lba ba dang mtshan par rdol dang 'bras kyi phreng nam tshong yan chad nad kun dang skran dang gzhang 'brum za khu dang gcong chen dbugs mi bde ba dang yi ga 'chus dang cham pa dang
pairs.d4311: gzhan yang rma'i sbubs 'grams pa dang lba ba dang mtshan par rdol ba dang 'bras kyi phreng ba dang nam tshong yan chad kyi nad thams cad dang skran dang gzhang 'brum dang gcin nad dang gcong chen po dang dbugs mi bde ba dang yi ga 'chus pa dang sna chu 'dzag pa dang lud pa dang skrangs pa dang snying nad dang skya rbab dang myos pa dang khong 'bras dang rlung nad dang khrag nad rnams sel te
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i sgo yin phyir mgo dang nam tshong yan chad nad la mchog khyad par gur kum zhun mar ka ra sbyar mgo rlung khrag 'thab gzer nad 'khyug pa 'joms shing mngar skyu ru ka ra zhun mar sbyar rna ba mig dang za 'gram klad nad sel la phug khu bas rna ba mgo nad sel rta sbangs sna khrag klad khrag so srin sel zhun mar nam tshong yan chad rlung nad 'joms btang thabs snga dro dgong dus gan rkyal nyal sngas smad mgo dpyangs thigs

pairs.d4310: rlung nad 'khyil dang smyo byed dang skran dang rlig rlugs la sogs sel ba la srang brgya sle tres ni
pairs.d4311: de las ran par 'thungs na rlung nad gso dka' ba dang rlung nad khong du 'khyil pa dang smyo byed dang skran dang rlig rlugs las rgyal bar byed do ba la srang brgya dang sle tres srang nyi shu rtsa lnga dang
pairs.rgyud_text: skran rnying pa gso ba sla zhes bya gso dka' ba ni sla ba de dag 'dres thabs mang yun ring gso ba dgos pa'o de las go ldog gyur la goms phan nyid tshe yi lhag ma lus srid gso ba tsam spang bar bya la gso thabs yod med gnyis

pairs.d4310: rims tsha nad gzir sel mchog yin til mar btsod dang spra tshil dang sra rtsi pog dang thal tres bcas til mar skabs lus bskus na
pairs.d4311: yang na til mar btsod dang spra tshil dang bcas pa gong bur byas pa'am sra rtsi pog dang thal tres dang til mar dang gong bur byas pas lus la bskus na dreg nad 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung

pairs.d4310: lud pa sha skem mgo 'khor dang zad byed lus tsha skya rbab dang me drod chung dang dug nad sbyong dur byid dug mo nyung sa bon bi pi ling dang bca' sga rnams sbrang rtsi rgun 'bru chur sbyar ba dbyar gyi dus kyi bkru sman yin
pairs.d4311: tsha ba gsum dang dri sna gsum dang gla sgang dang byi dang ga dang skyu ru ra dang de spyi dang mnyam pa'i dur byid dang de dang mnyam pa'i kha ra dkar po btags pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang ri lur byas pa zos na gcin sri ba dang rims dang skyug pa'i nad dang lud pa dang skem byed dang mgo 'khor ba dang zad byed kyi nad dang lus tsha ba dang skya rbab kyi nad dang me drod chung ba dang dug thams cad la rab tu bsngags so dur byid dang dug mo yungs dang pi pi ling dang bca' sga 'di rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang rgun 'bru'i khu ba dang sbyar te dbyar gyi dus su bkru sman btang bar bzang ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: pi pi ling dang sga rnams rim pas bskyed kun dang mnyam pa'i a ru'i thal sman sbyar me ni mngon sum nyid de drod skyed mchog shing kun kha ru tshwa dang tsha ba gsum sgog skya mar rnying reng bus me drod skyed bcu gnyis me mnyam gsang la me thur bya bad kan mgul 'gags nad la tsha ba lnga bzang po bzhi dang shing kun byi tang ga rgyam tshwas sna drangs tshwa sna tshogs tshad dang srub ka lce tsha'i phye ma sbrang rgod sbyar cong zhi rgod btul thal sman rnon po dang nang nub ltag pa sprad la chu skol dbul nya sha ol gong tsha ba khong du bsten sman rjes bshal skyugs sbrags la sbyang bar bya lhen gsang ske stong tshigs pa bzhi pa bsreg bad kan grum bu dkar po

pairs.d4310: sbyor drags sel ba'i dam pa yin slon sman sbyor ba drags pa la chu grang dag ni blugs par bya rgun 'bru la sogs khu ba mar sbrang rtsi kha ra'i skyo ma blud
pairs.d4311: sbyor ba drags pa gcod cing phan pa'i mchog yin no slon sman gyi sbyor ba drags pa la ni chu grang mos blugs pa dang rgun 'bru la sogs pa'i khu ba mar dang sbrang rtsi dang kha ra dang ldan pa'i skyo ma blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: 'bras yos phye mar dang sbyar ba'i skyo ma blud par bya thur du ral ba zungs yod gong ma bzhin byas la 'khrur gzhug gal te zungs ngan na bcad dgos tha rams bya rkang rgya skyegs bsdus khu bar da trig dom mkhris pri yangku re skon ka ra btab la btang ba'am

pairs.d4310: cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u gsum pa'o de nas sman mas gtong ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: cho ga grub pa'i gnas las le'u dang po rdzogs so de nas bkru sman gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: ni lud pa bsal ba'i cho ga bya mchi ma bkag pas snying dang mgo bo na sna chu 'dzag cing mgo 'khor yi ga 'chus de la chang btung gnyid log

pairs.d4310: seng phrom kha sral phre'u shing mngar dang na ga ge sar munydza ta ka dang tsandan rnam gnyis btags pa mar dang ni sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha dang ni ldan byas pa bsgrangs pa'i ni ru ha ni gtang bar bya
pairs.d4311: rtswa'i rtsa ba lnga zhes bya ba dur byid dang ku sha dang bu ram shing dang 'dam bu dang 'bras sa lu dang 'di rnams kyi rtsa ba dang rtsa ba lnga chung ngu dang thal tres dang tsan dan dang shug pa rnam gnyis dang shing mngar dang seng phrom rnam gnyis dang 'di rnams srang phyed phyed chu dang tshul bzhin bskol ba'i khu ba dang 'o ma srang drug cu rtsa bzhi dang yang bskol te 'o ma nyi tshe lus pa dang de'i nang du dzi ban ti dang me da rnam gnyis dang nye'u shing dang bi da ri dang ra mnye ba rnam gnyis dang rgun 'bru dang kha ra dkar po dang dzi ba ka dang padma ge sar dang pra punda ri ka dang utpa la dang punda ri ka dang seng phrom dang kha sral phre'u dang shing mngar dang na ga ge sar dang mun dza ta ka dang tsandan rnam gnyis dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma btags pa dang mar dang sbrang rtsi dang rgyam tshwa dang ldan par bya ste bsgrangs pa'i ni ru ha mas gtang ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: sel na ga pushpa na ga ge sar dang padma ge sar glo mchin snying tshad sel zi ra dkar pos glo yi tshad pa sel zi ra nag pos mchin pa'i grang ba sel la la phud kyis pho nad grang ba sel so ma ra dzas lpags nad chu ser sel thal ka rdo rje dag kyang de bzhin no gser gyi me tog snod tshad mkhris tshad sel gser gyi phud bus mkhris pa gyen du 'dren dug mo nyung gis mkhris sel tsha 'khru gcod rgun 'brum glo nad sel zhing tshad pa sbyong 'u sus pho ba'i bad kan tsha ba sel star bus glo brko khrag 'ju bad kan gcod bse yab bad kan tsha ba sel bar byed se 'brus pho ba'i nad rnams ma lus sel me drod skyed cing bad kan grang nad 'joms na le sham gyis bad kan grang ba sel pi pi ling gis grang nad ma lus sel sman sgas drod skyed zas len bad rlung 'joms sga skyas bad rlung sel zhing khrag 'khyags 'ju tsi tra ka stobs me 'dra me drod skyed 'or nad gzhang 'brum srin nad mdze nad sel shing tshas pho

pairs.d4310: snum gyi 'jam rtsi bshad bya ste rtsa ba bcu pa ba la dang ra sna a shwa gandha dang ba spru ba dang e ran dang
pairs.d4311: de yang rtsa ba bcu pa dang ba la dang ra sna dang a shwa gan dha dang ba spru ba dang sle tres dang e randa dang tig ta dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang ba sha ka dang bhu ti ka dang nye'u shing dang
pairs.rgyud_text: spa 'bru gze ma lcam pa ba spru ba ra'i mar la sdig srin gur kum bu ram pa'i mar sbyar dugs lums bya rjes la zas skom drod bsten mkhal gsang bsreg pho bar 'grams na spyang tsher chig skyugs bya mcher 'grams 'ol se so cha 'o sbyar btang rgyam tshwa tsha la

pairs.d4310: sti ra bil ba ni li ni ti mu sa dang pi pi ling dan da ra sna cha mnyam pa e randa yi mar ram ni til mar bskol ba'i 'jam rtsi yis
pairs.d4311: yang na rgyam tsha dang po son cha dang ru rta dang shu ti dang lcang ma dang shu dag dang ba la ka dang shing mngar dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang thang shing dang kad pa la dang dong gra dang ma nu dang med dang dbyi mo dang tsi tra ka dang zur pa dang byi dang ga dang bong nga dkar po dang tri bi tsa dang ha re nu ka dang ni li ni dang thi ra dang bil ba dang ti mu sa dang pi pi ling dang dan ti dang ra sna dang 'di rnams cha mnyam ste e randa'i mar ram til mar dang bskol ba las 'jam rtsi byas na
pairs.rgyud_text: myang tshwa dang kha ru tshwa ti mu sa dang bur dkar srang brgyad sbyar shing kun cur nis lto sbos yi ga 'chus kha zas mi 'ju gdong skrangs dbugs mi bde stod rgyangs lud pa mchin mcher rtsib logs gzer mkhal rked rkang lag skrangs dang dri chu sri skran dang skya rbab dmu rdzing skyug pa sel byi tang ga dang shing kun ma ru tse bca' sga gla rtsi phur thal pi pi ling bur dkar sbyar ba'i byi tang bdun pa ste pho long srin nad gzhang 'brum ma lus 'joms da trig se 'bru shing tsha pi pi ling bca' sga ka ped tha rams mon cha ra na rams bur dkar sbyar ba'i da trig dgu 'ur 'khrog sgreg cing

pairs.d4310: mas gtong drag po sbyar bar bya sle tres smyug ma'i lo ma dang pu ti ka ranydza'i shun pa 'o ma zur pa thang shing dang
pairs.d4311: yang na sle tres dang smyug ma'i lo ma dang bu ta ka ranydza'i shun pa dang lo ma dang zur ba dang thang shing dang bhu dhi ka dang 'di rnams ba gcin dang bskol la
pairs.rgyud_text: tra ka pi pi ling dang zur pa ma nu yi phye ma mar bskol thogs med 'gro nus 'gyur bi sha tse dang gzugs 'khums gar yod ngos mthe'u chung srin lag rgyab kyi rgyus pa la ser po snal ma 'dra ba yod

pairs.d4310: 'dus dug las gyur pa drug smyo byed ces bya lus dang ni sems kyi nad lam log pa ru
pairs.d4311: de la smyo byed kyi nad ni nad gzhi gsum re re las gyur pa dang sems gdungs pa las gyur pa dang dug las gyur pa ste drug yod do de la smyo byed ces bya ba ni lus dang sems kyi rgyu srang nad gzhis log par bsgyur te
pairs.rgyud_text: bad kan dang bsnad dang dug las byung ba drug tu bshad rtags la spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis spyi rtags rtsa rnams thams cad tsha zhing 'khyug lus dang yan lag snyom la ngal ba ste drod chung kha zas mi 'ju dang ga 'gag de rjes lus kun g.yo zhing skrangs pa ste khyad par

pairs.d4310: brjed byed rims dang dmu rdzing dang mtshan par rdol ba sel mchog yin 'or nad gzhang 'brum mig ser dang skya rbab skran dang lud pa dang gdon rnams 'joms par byed pa yin bramhi shu dag ru rta dang shang ka pushpa mar rnying bcas
pairs.d4311: brjed byed dang rims dang dmu rdzing dang mtshan par rdol ba 'phrog pa'i mchog yin te skran nad dang gzhang 'brum dang mig ser dang skya rbab dang skran dang lud pa dang gdon rnams 'joms par byed do shu dag dang ru rta dang da shang kha pushpa dang mar rnying pa dang mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi sman bramhi rang gi khu ba dang de rnams lhan cig bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dus gcong nad ma zhu skran dang skya rbab dang 'or dang dmu chu gcong chen zad byed drug tsha ba spyi dang gal mdo ri thang mtshams ma smin rgyas stongs gab rnyings rnyogs pa dang 'grams 'khrugs rims dang 'brum pa rgyu gzer dang gag lhog cham pa le'u bcu drug go lus stod mgo bo mig dang rna ba dang sna dang kha dang lba ba le'u drug don snod snying dang glo mchin mcher mkhal dang pho

pairs.d4310: spangs ma srang gcig na le sham dkar po srang ni nyi shu dang skyur rtsabs srang ni sum cu dag btags te zangs ma'i snod du gzhug
pairs.d4311: mig mchu mtshon gyis bzhar ba byas na mig nad thams cad dag par 'gyur ro spangs ma srang gcig dang na le sham dkar po srang nyi shu rtsab mo srang sum cu'i nang du btags te zangs ma'i snod kyi nang du bcug ste blugs na
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal

pairs.d4310: phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u bcu bdun pa'o de nas rna ba'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o rlung las gyur pa'i rna nad la
pairs.d4311: de nas rna ba'i nad gso bar bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste de la rlung las gyur pa'i rna ba'i nad la ni thog mar sha khu blud la de'i nub mo rlung 'joms pa'i sman dang sbyar ba'i mar blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags

pairs.d4310: pri yangku dang am pashtha shing mngar dang ni da ta ki utpa la yi lo ma dang btsod dang seng phrom rgya skyegs dang ka pid ta yi khu ba dang til mar bskol te de blugs na
pairs.d4311: pri yang ku dang shing mngar dang am pastha dang da ta ki dang utpa la dang 'dab ma rnam bzhi dang btsod dang seng phrom dang rgya skyegs dang de rnams ka pid ta'i rang gi khu ba dang til mar lhan cig bskol te rna bar blugs na rnag khrag zag pa zhi bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra ga dur ka ra cha mnyam

pairs.d4310: mchu dang mkhur tshos so rtsa dang lce dang rkan dang mgul pa dang kha dang thams cad dag gi ni nad ni bdun cu rtsa dgu yin bcu gcig gcig dang bcu dang ni bcu gsum de bzhin drug dang brgyad bcu gnyis bco brgyad dag dang ni
pairs.d4311: de ltar kha nad rnam pa brgyad du bshad pa yin no mchu dang mkhur tshos dang so dang so'i rtsa ba dang lce dang rkan dang mgul pa dang kha dang 'di rnams kun la spyir nad bdun cu rtsa lngar bshad de de yang bcu gcig dang gcig dang bcu dang bcu gsum dang drug dang brgyad dang bco brgyad dang brgyad de mchu la sogs pa'i nad dang bzhin du sbyar ro
pairs.rgyud_text: gcig gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bzhi gcig dang lnga dang drug dang brgyad gnyis bcu drug gcig bcu dgu gcig dang zhus pas dgu bcu gnyis rtsa chu thang phye ril bu lde gu dang sman mar thal sman khanda sman chang dang rin po che dang sngo sbyor snum 'chos dang bshal skyugs sna sman 'jam rtsi ni ru ha rtsa sbyong gtar bsreg dugs lums byug pa dang thur dpyad phyi ma'i rgyud la mdo bzhi ste gnyis bcu bdun drug

pairs.d4310: so gogs so ni chag pa dang smin pa'i nye ba'i lce dang ni lkog ma'i lba ba skad nyams dang dbugs mi thon pa lo gcig lon
pairs.d4311: khrag las gyur pa dang ro hi na'i nad thams cad dang so 'gas pa'i nad dang so chag pa dang smin pa'i nad dang lce lhag dang lba ba dang skad nyams pa dang dbugs dka' bas thon pa dang kha nad smin pa dang so brtse ba'i nad dang
pairs.rgyud_text: mgo bo mig dang rna ba dang sna dang kha dang lba ba le'u drug don snod snying dang glo mchin mcher mkhal dang pho ba rgyu ma long dang le'u brgyad gsang ba'i nad la pho mo tha dad gnyis thor nad skad 'gags yi ga 'chus pa dang skom dad skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba dang

pairs.d4310: phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o de nas mgo bo'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad la
pairs.d4311: mgo nad kyi dmigs shes par bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa rdzogs so de nas mgo nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste de la rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad la ni rlung gi cho ga rnams spyad par bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med

pairs.d4310: nam tshong yan chad nad kun sel rma bya'i sgro mkhris rgyu ma dang rkang pa rtug pa chu bor ba'i
pairs.d4311: nam tshong yan chad kyi nad sel bar byed do rma bya'i sgro dang mkhris pa dang rgyu ma dang rkang pa dang rtug pa dang mchu dang de dag bor ba'i sha nyi tshe dang rtsa ba bcu pa dang ba la dang ra sna dang shing mngar dang sman de rnams srang gsum gsum rnams chu dang bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i sgo yin phyir mgo dang nam tshong yan chad nad la mchog khyad par gur kum zhun mar ka ra sbyar mgo rlung khrag 'thab gzer nad 'khyug pa 'joms shing mngar skyu ru ka ra zhun mar sbyar rna ba mig dang za 'gram klad nad sel la phug khu bas rna ba mgo nad sel rta sbangs sna khrag klad khrag so srin sel zhun mar

pairs.d4310: dngul rdo rgya spos ru rta dang ba bla ldong ros pri yang ku tsha ba gsum dang 'bu su hang na ga pushpa ge sar bcas
pairs.d4311: de bzhin du shing mngar dang shing tog ma du ka dang padma ge sar dang tsandan dang stang zil dang rgya spos dang ru rta dang ba bla dang ldong ros dang pri yang ku dang tsha ba gsum dang 'bu su hang dang na ga pushpa dang ge sar dang ha re nya ka dang chu'i shing mngar dang spang spos dang gi wang dang ka la ma ka dang shri beshta ka dang sra rtsi pog dang shu ti dang gur gum dang ba la dang ta ma la'i lo ma dang bal bu'i lo ma dang stag pa'i lo ma dang pu tse shel dang
pairs.rgyud_text: sel na ga pushpa na ga ge sar dang padma ge sar glo mchin snying tshad sel zi ra dkar pos glo yi tshad pa sel zi ra nag pos mchin pa'i grang ba sel la la phud kyis pho nad grang ba sel so ma ra dzas lpags nad chu ser sel thal ka rdo rje dag kyang de bzhin no gser gyi me tog snod tshad mkhris tshad sel gser gyi phud bus mkhris pa gyen du 'dren dug mo nyung gis mkhris sel tsha 'khru gcod rgun 'brum glo nad sel zhing tshad pa sbyong 'u sus pho ba'i bad kan tsha ba sel star bus glo brko khrag 'ju bad kan gcod bse

pairs.d4310: sbrang rtsi sbyar te lde gu sbyin pi pi ling dang bya ma ka spang spos seng phrom sug smel dang ku tan na ta sardzi ka ru rta shing mngar tsandan dang yug snam btsag dang sbyar ba'i sman
pairs.d4311: de yang pi pi ling dang bya ma ka dang spang spos dang seng phrom dang sug smel dang swardzi ka dang ku tan na ta dang ru rta dang shing mngar dang tsandan dang btsag yug snam dang de rnams ni dug 'joms pa'i sman zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: nang dag tu dza ti gur kum gla rtsi spang spos dang spang rgyan sbyar te lus kun bkrus rjes byug yang na gla rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang sdig srin mu zi ra khrag bse mar khur yang na ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dang gla rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra khrag byug

pairs.d4310: bra nye smin drug mchu dang skag sa ga chu stod khrums stod dang snubs dang bra nye yud tsam la
pairs.d4311: rgyu skar bra nye dang smin drug dang mchu dang skag dang sa ga dang gre dang chu stod dang khrums stod dang snubs dang gzhan yang ne re ta zhes bya ba'i yud tsam gyi dus dang dus de dag tu gnad du bsnun par zin na ni spang bar bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: bzhin skad cig la sogs thang cig yud tsam la nyin zhag zla ba dus dang lor 'gyur te nyi ma brgyad gsum dbyar dgun dbus su'ang ldog gsum ni lho dang byang du 'gro zhes bya nam dang nyi ma phyed na mnyam pa yin brgyad dang bcu na sgra sgrogs chad par 'gyur de la dgun zla tha

pairs.d4310: lo ma lnga dang 'bras bu gsum shing mngar na ga pushpa dang e la ba lu dzi ba ka zangs rtsi ba dang pu shel tse
pairs.d4311: shing 'o ma can lnga'i shun pa dang 'bras bu gsum dang shing mngar dang na ga pushpa dang e la ba lu dang dzi ba ka dang zangs rtsi ba dang pu shel tse dang kha ra dkar po dang shug pa dang
pairs.rgyud_text: spos a ru ra shug pa lca ba tang kun ba lu dang shu dag ru rta ba chur sbyar ba'am yang na sngon bu srub ka zho sbyar byug des ma sos na zo mar sgog skya tsha chu dron bkrus rjes byugs la nyi mar bsreg sen mos brad pas

pairs.d4310: kha ba can gyi ri las skyes pa yi so ma ra dza dang ni ba spru ba de bzhin dro na ma ha dro na dang sbrul la yod pa'i nor bu ma na si
pairs.d4311: rin po che ke ke ru dang margad dang mu tig dang rdo rje dang bai durya dang garbha ma ni dang pi tsu ka dang byi ba'i dug dang de bzhin du ri kha ba can na skyes pa'i sman so ma ra dza dang ba spru ba dang dro na dang ma ha dro na zhes bya ba dang sbrul la yod pa'i nor bu dang ma na si dang dug zhi bar bya bar 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: rnam pa sna tshogs pas brgyan pa ste nor bu rin po che des ni rlung gi nad dang mkhris pa'i nad dang bad kan gyi nad dang ldan pa'i nad dang 'dus pa'i nad las gyur pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sel bar byed pa tsha ba'i nad la bsil du gyur pa grang ba'i nad la drod du gyur pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi bar byed pa dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du grub par byed pa yod do grong

pairs.d4310: dpal dang gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur khyad par du ni mdze nad sha bkra skran dug dang dbyig dug rims dang smyo byed dang
pairs.d4311: dpal dang gzi brjid dang mdangs dang ldan pa dang lhag par mdze dang sha bkra dang skran dang dug dang rims dang smyo byed dang dbyig dug dang dmu rdzing rnams las zlog par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: pi ling bskol thang ma zhu gsar dang rims nad dang lhag par pho mchin nad rnams sbyong ba'i mchog a ru mchu ring ba ru skyu ru ra lcum rtsa dur byid spos dkar ba chur bsdus rgyun sbyongs dreg dang grum bu chu

pairs.d4310: ra sna gze ma dzi ban ti shing mngar sa la parni rnams re re'ang srang ni gsum gsum cha mon sran gre'u bre bzhi dang
pairs.d4311: 'dam bu mda' rgyu dang bu ram shing dang ku sha dang ka sha la sogs pa'i rtswa'i rtsa ba dang bid ri dang pu shel tse'i rtsa ba dang kanda ka ri dang dzi ba ka dang zangs rtsi ba dang ba la dang me da rnam gnyis dang ra mnye ba rnam gnyis dang nye'u shing dang par na rnam pa gnyis dang a shwa gandha dang a ti ba la dang kha sral phre'u dang ba spru ba dang bi da ri dang pa ya sya dang dzi banti dang rid di dang ra sna dang gze ma dang shing mngar dang sa la parni dang de rnams re re yang srang gsum gsum dang mon sran gre'u srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang chu srang stong nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang lhan cig bskol te khu ba srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad lus pa'i nang du mar dang bi da ri dang skyu ru ra dang bu ram shing dang de rnams re re yang srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang 'o ma srang lnga brgya rtsa gnyis dang sman bi da ri dang kha sral dang ra mnye ba rnam gnyis dang shing mngar dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i mchog ra mnye nye shing lca ba ba spru ba gze ma 'bri mar rtsa ba lnga yi mar tshwa sna gsum dang sle tres bzang po gsum bca' sga pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar mkhal ma'i grang nad rlung tshabs sel bar byed 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres pa 'ba' sam zhes bya stod smad kun la bsngags 'ba' sam de nang da byid lug thug 'bras mar la cong zhi bca' sga pi pi ling sle tres rgyam tshwa sug smel bre ga dang bu ram sbyar ba da byid skyin gor te ro tsa mkhal nad za khu 'dod nyams sel sgog skya a ru sga yi sman mar la rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa dang pi pi ling sug smel bu ram btab pas da rgan dang rgyu long mkhal rked nad dang rlig rlugs sel sgog skya srang brgyad 'bri mar cha mnyam sbyar bcu gnyis nas kyi gseb tu nus pa bskyed rlung nad ma lus kun sel bcud len 'gyur ba spru pi pi ling rtsa 'bri mar sbyar mo gsham bu rnyed mchog tu skyigs bu sel se 'bru 'u su dong gra tsi tra ka pi pi ling gi mar dang bu ram sbyar bzang po

pairs.d4310: mig ser gyi ni nad rnams 'joms sle tres dang ni shug pa dang nim pa 'u su'i 'bras bu dang tsandan dmar po zhes bya rnams mkhris pa dang ni bad kan dang rims dang skyug bro lus tsha dang skom dad che sel me drod skyed
pairs.d4311: yang gu ru tse sle tres dang shug pa dang shing nim pa dang 'u su'i 'bras bu dang tsandan dmar po dang 'di rnams ni mkhris pa dang bad kan rgyas pa dang rims kyis btab pa dang skyug bro ba dang lus tsha ba dang skom dad che ba dang nad 'di rnams kyang sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: sman la se 'bru shing tsha dang skyu ru ra dang nim pa star bu dang phag ril thal ba bur dkar chu skol dbul des ma zhi na cha mnyam bzhi pa'i steng tig ta bsnan la kar sbyar chu skol dbul de yis mkhris pa bad kan sdud dang 'drul de nas gser gyi phud bu ri sho ba rgyam tshwa pi pi ling

pairs.d4310: de nas skyugs sman dang bkru sman gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o bad kan nad dam 'dres pa yi bad kan rgyas la skyugs sman gtang
pairs.d4311: dugs dang lums kyi cho ga ste le'u bcu bdun pa rdzogs so skyug sman dang bkru sman gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u bco brgyad pa bshad par bya'o bad kan rgyas pa'i nad dam bad kan rgyas pa rlung ngam mkhris pa dang 'dres kyang rung ste
pairs.rgyud_text: snod tshad dang tshil ches ma zhu bad kan rgyas la spang sbyor ba sle 'jam bkru 'jam bkru ma slen rlung rkyang mkhris pa bad kan ldan la sbyar dang po lug sha 'bri yi 'o ma mar ru rta de ba da ru pi pi ling rgyam tshwa a ru ra sbyar sle 'jam

pairs.d4310: rnon po dzo ti sma ti dang skyer pa dang ni rtsa ba bcu ldong ros ba bla rgya skyegs dang
pairs.d4311: dang seng phrom dang shing tsha dang li kar dkar po dang shing mngar dang rngub rna shi ri'i shun pa dang shug pa dang btsod dang spod ru rta dang rgya spos dang bad kan la sman rnon po'i dud pa btang ba ni dzo ti sma ti dang skyer ba dang yung ba sman gyi rtsa ba bcu dang ldong ros dang ba bla dang rgya skyegs dang tsandan dkar po dang 'bras bu gsum dang sman spos dri zhim po'i nang na ro rno ba'i grangs su gtogs pa rnams dang 'di rnams kyi dud pa sna nas btang zhing mgo bo'i nad bkru bar bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung gla sgang bong nga dkar po ba le ka re skon ka ra sbyar ba'i mkhris phye bdun rgyu long bsnad 'grams khrag mkhris tsha 'khru gcod cong zhi se

pairs.d4310: me ni rab tu 'bar ba dang bza' btung yid du 'ong ba dang mi yis shing rta legs gang dang ba ni be'u dang bcas pa dang
pairs.d4311: me 'bar ba dang bza' btung yid du 'ong ba dang shing rta gang ba dang ba drus ma be'u dang bcas pa gsum dang rgod ma rte'u dang bcas pa gsum dang bud med bu dang bcas pa mthong ba dang shang shang te'u dang ri dwags dang bzhad dang khu byug dang ngang pa dang
pairs.rgyud_text: lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba zla ba'i stobs dang ldan pa'i ri la tsan dan dang ga bur dang a ga ru dang nim pa la sogs pa tsha ba sel bar byed pa'i

pairs.d4310: rlung mkhris las gyur rims la ni rgun 'brum shing mngar ma du ka seng phrom tang pal thal tres dang gla sgang skyu ru ba la ke padma ge sar shug pa dang pad rtsa tsandan urshir
pairs.d4311: rlung dang mkhris pa 'dres pa'i rims la ni rgun 'brum dang shing mngar dang shing tog ma ru ka dang seng phrom dang tang pal dang thal tres dang gla sgang dang skyu ru ra dang bal ka dang padma'i ge sar dang shug pa dang padma'i rtsa ba dang tsandan dang pu shel tse dang utpal sngon po dang pa ru sha ka dang 'di rnams phye mar btags pa chu dang bskol ba skan ter gyur pa'am
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung gla

pairs.d4310: legs par byas te blud par bya ldong ros rgyam tsha pi pi ling til mar dang sbyar mig sman gzhug shing kun stag tshil cha mnyam bya
pairs.d4311: rims kyis btab pa'i zhag btung ngo ldong ros dang rgyam tsha dang pi pi ling dang til mar dang lhan cig sbyar ba'i mig sman yang gzhug go shing kun dang stag gi tshil cha mnyam pa rgyam tsha dang sbyar ba'i sna sman gtang ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing

pairs.d4310: ya baksha ra mar dang sbyar zas zos pa yi 'og tu blud pi pi ling dang bu ram bskol
pairs.d4311: yang na ya baksha ra dang mar sbyar ba zas zos pa'i 'og tu blud do yang na pi pi ling dang bu ram dang mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi ra'i 'o ma dang 'thungs na
pairs.rgyud_text: tshwa thal tshwa dang shing tsha ya baksha ra bul tog rnams de dang de 'dra la sogs lan tshwa'i sde nim pa tig ta bong nga dkar po dang hong len gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung gla rtsi mkhris pa skyer

pairs.d4310: thug pa blud na lud pa dang skyigs bu dbugs mi bde nad sel rtsa ba bcu par sna dang zur pa ga bra'i rtsa ba dang bil ba gnyis dang ma nu dang kar ka ta sring pi pi ling lca ba sle tres bca' sga ni bskol ba'i khu ba blud zhu nas
pairs.d4311: lud pa dang skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba rnams la phan no rtsa ba bcu pa dang ra sna dang zur pa dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang bil ba rnam gnyis kyi rkang dang pushkar mu la dang kar ka ta sring gi dang pi pi ling dang lca ba'i rtsa ba dang sle tres dang bca' sga dang de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba blud la
pairs.rgyud_text: pa dang skom dad skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba dang glang thabs srin nad skyug 'khru dri ma 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi tshad 'khru dreg nad dang grum bu chu ser rtsa dkar pags pa'i nad phran bu'i nad dang le'u bcu dgu'o lhan skyes rma la 'bras dang gzhang 'brum dang me dbal sur ya rmen bu rlig rlugs dang rkang bam mtshan bar rdol dang le'u brgyad byis pa nyer spyod nad dang de'i

pairs.d4310: thug pa blud na lud pa dang rtsa ba bcu par sna dang zur pa ga bra'i rtsa ba dang bil ba gnyis dang ma nu dang kar ka ta sring pi pi ling lca ba sle tres bca' sga ni bskol ba'i khu ba blud zhu nas
pairs.d4311: bde ba rnams la phan no rtsa ba bcu pa dang ra sna dang zur pa dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang bil ba rnam gnyis kyi rkang dang pushkar mu la dang kar ka ta sring gi dang pi pi ling dang lca ba'i rtsa ba dang sle tres dang bca' sga dang de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba blud la
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang skrangs na skyugs btang dmar tsha gtar ga gdab brla rengs ma zhu

pairs.d4310: zur pa lan tshwa rnam gnyis dang dzi ban ti dang bil ba'i rkang shu dag bal bu'i lo ma rnams de dag zho ni gnyis gnyis bskol shing kun zho phyed mar bre gang
pairs.d4311: dang pu tse shel dang bhu ti ka dang ma nu'i rtsa ba dang pa la sha dang tsi tra ka dang zur pa dang lan tshwa rnam gnyis dang ta ma li ka dang dzi ban ti dang bil ba'i snying po dang shu dag dang bal bu'i lo ma dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang shing kun zho phyed dang 'di rnams mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang bskol te mar 'ba' zhig lus par 'thungs na
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus

pairs.d4310: de nas slon pa'i nad dang snying nad dang skom dad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o slon nad phal cher ma zhu ba'i
pairs.d4311: de nas rtag tu slon pa'i nad dang snying nad gso ba dang skom pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o slon pa'i nad ni ma zhu ba'i gnas nas phal cher 'byung ste
pairs.rgyud_text: ngal dub dbugs bkag skran dang snying nad 'byung myos 'gyur der ni ngal gso rlung sel phan gnyid bkag g.yal mang lus snyom mgo bo lci mig 'grib kha zas mi 'ju sha khu dang chang btung bsku mnye bya zhing gnyid

pairs.d4310: pi pi ling dang brag zhun ni bcud kyis len gyi cho ga sbyin yang na 'bras bu gsum mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas pa sbyin
pairs.d4311: yang na pi pi ling dang brag zhun yang bcud kyis len gyi cho ga bzhin du sbyar ba'am yang na 'bras bu gsum mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sha kha ras btab pa'am
pairs.rgyud_text: de bzhin tsha bas gdungs nas grang ba spong cho ga bzhin byas nad la skyed med cing cho ga log pas bde bar gnas snyam byed de dag 'chi ba'i ltas su bshad pa yin shin tu nye ba 'byung ba

pairs.d4310: rtag tu 'khru dang gzhang 'brum dang gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad rnams dang bad kan rlung ni 'joms par byed rma bya sreg pa 'ur bya yi
pairs.d4311: lto sbos pa dang gcin sri ba dang 'phyen preg preg por 'byung ba dang gzhang 'byung ba'i nad dang gzhang 'brum dang pho ba'i nad dang bad kan dang rlung nad 'joms par byed do rma bya dang sreg pa dang la ban zhes bya ba'i sha khu skyur dang legs par sbyar ba'am
pairs.rgyud_text: nad dang le'u bcu dgu'o lhan skyes rma la 'bras dang gzhang 'brum dang me dbal sur ya rmen bu rlig rlugs dang rkang bam mtshan bar rdol dang le'u brgyad byis pa nyer spyod nad dang de'i gdon gsum mo nad spyi dang bye brag phal pa gsum 'byung po smyo brjed gza' dang klu gdon lnga rma la rma spyi mgo

pairs.d4310: thug pa blud na rlung dang ni bad kan las gyur slon bro dang pho ba rtsib logs snying ga na rims dang 'or nad skya rbab dang skran dang chang nad gzhang 'brum dang cham pa mchil ma dbugs mi bde
pairs.d4311: de ltar rtag tu bstan na rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i skyug pa dang pho ba na ba dang rtsib logs dang snying na ba dang rims dang skrang pa dang skya rbab dang skran dang chang nad dang gzhang 'brum dang cham pa dang sna chu 'dzag pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa lu ba rnams las zlog par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: 'khyil gyen du 'gro zhing rtsib logs snying ga na gcin zad mdog 'gyur sri dang nyung ngur 'gyur rngul zad lpags 'gas ba spu 'greng dang 'byi phran bu rang gnas stongs dang yang las shes lus zungs dri ma la ni brten pa'i phyir 'phel bskyed zad pas stobs la gnod pa yin mdangs ni sems la sdug bsngal gyis zad de dngangs rid nyam chung mi dga' gzi mdangs nyams 'tsho byed

pairs.d4310: gandha bha dra'i phye ma ni sbrang rtsi'i lde gur byas bza' ba'am chang ngam chu dang sbyar 'thungs na snying nad skya rbab pho ba'i nad
pairs.d4311: shu dag dang skyer pa'i shun phrags dang shug pa dang pu shel tse dang la la phud dang gla sgang dang tsandan dkar po dang rgya tsha dang bong nga dang tsha ba gsum dang shing tsha dang sug smel dang gandha bha dra dang thang shing dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang lde gur byas te bza' ba'am yang na chang ngam chu dang bskol te 'thungs na snying nad dang skya rbab kyi nad dang pho ba'i nad dang skran dang zug gzer dang ma zhu ba dang rims dang mig ser gyi nad dang 'dus pa'i nad dang kha'i nad dang 'di rnams 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: ra nag po dbyi mong tsi tra ka la la phud dang sug smel kha ru tshwa bsdebs pa'i se 'bru bcu pas me drod nyams kha zas mi 'ju sbo sgreg grang skran 'joms dza ti ka ko la dang kha ru tshwa rgyam tshwa shing tsha dbyi mong tsi tra ka a ru ra dang la phug sa bon bsdebs se 'bru'i cur nis bad rlung ma zhu sbo pho mkhal bu btsas grang ba rgyas pa 'joms grang nad ma lus se 'bru'i phye mas sel pho ba'i bad kan sbyong zhing me drod skyed dang ga 'byed cing kha zas len par byed de phyir phye ma kun gyi rgyal por bshad gnyis pa da lis

pairs.d4310: pho ba'i nad dang skran sel zhing mig ser skya rbab rims kyi nad yi ga 'chus dang 'khru ba 'joms
pairs.d4311: tsha ba gsum dang dug mo yungs rnams cha mnyam la tsi tra ka sman sna gcig gi cha gnyis dug mo yungs kyi shun lpags sman sna gcig gi bcu drug 'gyur 'di rnams zhib tu btags te bu ram dang sbyar nas chu grang mo dang sbyar te 'thungs na pho ba'i nad dang skran dang mig ser dang rims dang skya rbab dang gcin nad dang yi ga 'chus pa dang 'khru ba rnams sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: ka ra la sbyor zhib tu btags la gdab 'ju tshod lon tsam khyi'u sus bsten par bya zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las lde gu'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig sman mar sde tshan tsha sel grang sel gnyis tsha sel tig ta hong len ba sha ka spang

pairs.d4310: sru sru'i rtsa ba 'jag zlum dang bi da ri dang ba ra hi 'bras kyi rtsa ba gze ma dang ba lu ka dang pa ta li
pairs.d4311: mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rde'u chags pa la ni ku sha dang ka sha dang 'dam bu dang gu tha dang ing ka tha dang nye'u shing dang sru sru'i rtsa ba dang dar ba dang bi da ri dang ba ri hi dang 'bras kyi rtsa ba dang gze ma dang ba lu ka dang ba ta ka dang lcags phye dang ku ru ta ka dang ba spru ba dang shi ri sha dang de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba mar dang lhan cig bskol ba'i nang du ga gon la sogs pa'i sa bon dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i mchog ra mnye nye shing lca ba ba spru ba gze ma 'bri mar rtsa ba lnga yi mar tshwa sna gsum dang sle tres bzang po gsum bca' sga pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar mkhal ma'i grang nad rlung tshabs sel bar byed 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres pa 'ba' sam zhes bya stod smad kun la bsngags 'ba' sam de nang da byid lug thug 'bras mar la cong zhi bca' sga pi pi ling sle tres rgyam tshwa sug smel bre ga dang bu ram sbyar ba da byid skyin gor te ro tsa mkhal nad za khu

pairs.d4310: chu shing til gyi sdong po dang bu ram shing bsregs thal ba ni til mar bskol ba blud gyur na
pairs.d4311: yang na chu shing dang til gyi sdong bu dang gze ma rnams bsregs pa'i thal ba til mar dang bskol ba las ran par 'thungs na bad kan dang rlung las gyur pa'i mcher pa'i dmu rdzing las rgyal lo
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags

pairs.d4310: mkhris par kar tsha ba gsum bad kan las gyur la la phud rgyam tsha zi ra sbrang rtsi dang tsha ba gsum dang ldan pa sbyin
pairs.d4311: bad kan las gyur pa la ni la la phud dang rgyam tsha dang zi ra dang sbrang rtsi dang tsha ba gsum 'di rnams kyis btab pa sbyin no
pairs.rgyud_text: 'o mar btsos sga dang rgyam tshwa btab pa dkar 'don yin lug sha'i khu bar sbyar ba dmar 'don no skyur 'don khugs pa'i glum la nye 'u byas mar rnying bu ram sga btab btsos pa'o

pairs.d4310: sgregs skyur kha dog mi sdug dang gcin nad rlung gi khu chu'i nad dbugs mi bde dang yi ga 'chus mcher pa'i nad dang sbyar ba'i dug dmu rdzing gi ni nad rnams sel
pairs.d4311: 'or nad tshabs che ba dang rims dang skran dang gcin nad dang lus skem zhing rid pa dang ma zhu ba dang khrag mkhris dang rlung dang sgregs pa skyur por 'byung ba dang mdog 'gyur ba dang gcin dang rlung dang khu chu'i nad dang dbugs mi bde ba dang yi ga 'chus pa dang mcher pa na ba dang sbyar ba'i dug dang dmu rdzing rnams sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: btang mi rung dmu 'or nad dang yi ga 'chus dug nad mchin pa rgyu long snod tshad dang tshil ches ma zhu bad kan rgyas la spang sbyor ba sle 'jam bkru 'jam bkru ma slen rlung rkyang mkhris pa bad kan ldan la sbyar dang po lug sha 'bri yi 'o ma mar ru rta de ba da ru pi pi ling rgyam tshwa a ru ra sbyar sle 'jam yin gnyis pa chur gnas sha khu

pairs.d4310: dmu rdzing zla mtshan mi chod dang sbyar dug gzhang 'brum khrag mkhris sel gzhan yang mkhris pa las gyur nad shin tu gso dka' rnams la phan lo ma bdun pa par pa ta dong ga shu dag pu tse shel
pairs.d4311: rma 'grams pa dang 'brum bu dang khong 'bras dang skran dang skem byed kyi nad dang smyo byed dang myos pa dang snying nad dang rab rib dang ngo shig dang pho ba'i nad dang sha bkra dang mig ser dang mtshan par rdol ba dang brjed byed dang bud med kyi zla mtshan gyi nad dang sbyar ba'i dug dang gzhang 'brum dang khrag mkhris rnams la phan no gzhan yang mkhris pa las gyur pa'i nad shin tu gso dka' ba yang 'byang bar byed do lo ma bdun pa dang par pa t ⋯ hug pa dang pa tha dang ser po rnam gnyis dang thal tres rnam gnyis dang pi pi ling dang nim pa dang tsandan dang shing mngar dang bi sha la dang dug mo yungs dang sle tres dang tig ta dang pu shel tse dang ba sha ka dang mur ba dang nye'u shing dang pa to la dang bong nga dkar po dang gla sgang dang kyi lce ba dang byi tsher ba dang de rnams kyi phye ma dang mar dang mar gyi brgyad 'gyur gyi chu dang skyu ru ra'i khu ba mar gyi nyes 'gyur dang
pairs.rgyud_text: gla sgang par pa ta dang dug mo nyung pa to la dang rtsa mkhris bsnan la btang zla gcig phar 'das rims rnying tsha ba rnams sle tres pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum thang mang btang rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar skabs su rngul dbyung mig chu ser na sbyang bshang gci phyen 'gags pa la bya kr i dang gze ma 'o ma bur rnying bskol ba phan mdog sngo sha skam dang ga bde ba na tsha ba phyi ru byer bas chu lcag phan rtsa khrid na 'phreng lci na cung zad gtar tshigs gzhi rus pa na skrangs chu lums bya rims rjes sna rtsa skrangs na gang nye gtar gur kum ka ra mar gsar sna sman btang brag zhun stag sha hong len dri chu byug ko ler na zhing gzer na tshan dugs bya shed med smad tshad skyes na smad 'dren btang zungs zad ro smad drod bral 'jam rtsi bya stobs med gting tshad ma thon rlung skyes na tig ta'i sman mar sbrang rtsi sbyar la bsten mdor na tsha ba nad zungs kun 'brel phyir thor bu sna tshogs ma nges 'byung bas na tsha ba spyi dang 'phrul te nad sna

pairs.d4310: byin na mi bzad mdze yang 'joms tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum til dang go bye'i phye ma ni mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar
pairs.d4311: mdze nad shin tu mi bzad pa rnams kyang 'joms so tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum dang til dang go bye dang de rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang kha ra dkar po dang sbyar ba'i ri lu ni
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar

pairs.d4310: bskus na mdze 'joms grub pa yin shri sha'i shun lpags ras bal gyi me tog dong ga'i lo ma dang mon sne'u dme ru bzhi po ni
pairs.d4311: yungs dang ka ra nydza'i 'bras bu dang skyer pa'i shun pa dang su ma na'i lo ma dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma lde gur byas pas bskus na yang mdze nad 'joms par kun gyis mngon sum du mthong zhing grags pa yin no shri sha'i shun pa dang ras bal gyi me tog dang dong ga'i lo ma dang mon sran sde'u dme ru'i rtsa ba dang lo mar bcas pa dang 'di bzhi btags pa'i phye ma'i lde gus bskus na yang phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba zla ba'i stobs dang ldan pa'i ri la tsan dan dang ga bur dang a ga ru dang nim pa la sogs pa tsha ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro kha ba dang mngar ba

pairs.d4310: go bye tsi tra ka dang snu ha dang arka'i rtsa ba dang ni 'ol ma se de bzhin tsha ba gsum dang dung dang ni spangs ma ru rtar bcas dang lan tshwa lngar thal ba gnyis dang lang ga li btags phye
pairs.d4311: go bye dang tsi tra ka dang shing su dha kshi ra dang arka'i rtsa ba dang 'ol ma se dang tsha ba gsum dang dung dang spangs ma dang ru rta dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang thal ba rnam gnyis dang lang ga li dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma su dha kshi ra dang a rga'i 'o ma dang bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: bu rnam pa bzhi tsha gsum thal ba gnyis dang bu ram sbyar chu tshan 'phul bas grang nad ma lus sel mtha' 'khob yul gyi sngo sbyor man ngag 'di sems la long la byams pas 'gro don gyis zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sngo sbyor gyi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o de nas yang

pairs.d4310: cho ga bzhin du bcug pa des lud pa dbugs mi bde dang rims brgyal dang slon skran zad byed dang glo 'grams mcher nad skem pa dang brjed byed bkra mi shis pa sel
pairs.d4311: lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang rims dang brgyal ba dang skyugs pa dang skran dang zad byed dang glo 'grams pa dang mcher pa na ba dang skem byed dang brjed byed dang bkra mi shis pa rnams 'jig par byed de
pairs.rgyud_text: ga 'chus dang srin skom dug mdze dang brgyal dang rims rlon mkhris pa 'joms 'drul dang tshil zhag rkang mar bshang gci skem yid gzhungs nu ma'i nad dang skad 'gags sel bsten drags zungs 'dzad rlung dang bad kan skyed tsha bas lkog nad gag pa mdze 'or sel rma 'jig

pairs.d4310: dzi ba ka dang bi sha ba shing tsha ganda bha dra dang chu srin sin mo ba le ka
pairs.d4311: sle tres dang ra mnye ba rnam gnyis dang 'tsho byed dang dzi ba ka dang zangs rtsi ba dang shing tsha dang gandha bha dra dang chu srin sen mo dang ba la ka dang pra punda ri ka dang btsod dang thal tres dang in dra ba ru ni dang ku tan na ta dang 'di rnams srang re re btags pa'i phye ma btab ste bskol la mar 'ba' zhig lus pa las sbyor ba rnam pa bzhi po btung ba dang snar blugs pa dang bsku byug dang 'jam rtsi mas gtong ba rnams byas na
pairs.rgyud_text: sman mar byin sle tres kabraspya ka ri shu dag dang btsod dang dza ti sug smel pi pi ling yung ba shu mo za dang ra mar gyi 'jam rtsi btang zhing long phugs g.yas g.yon bsreg mkhal rlung mgo tshod shu mo za btab btang rus sna'i khu ba bu ram sbyar bsdus sam bong sha sram sha bur chang zan chang dang rtsa ba lnga yi mar sbyar bcu bzhi bsreg de la sogs te rlung nad du ma yang nad gzhan 'dres na de yi kha 'dzin gces rkyang pa rnams la spyi bcos khog phub la rang rang nad kyi gso thabs mde

pairs.d4310: po son cha dang dzi mu ta ku ba kha bo dzi ban ti dzi ba ka ni bskol ba yi
pairs.d4311: bskams la btags pa'i phye ma po son cha dang dzi mu ta dang ku ba kha bo dang dzi ban ti dang dzi ba ka dang de rnams gang yang rung ba cig bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du btab ste blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar

pairs.d4310: kha ra dang sbrang rtsi'i ri lu byas zos na gcin sri rims dang slon bro dang lud pa sha skem mgo 'khor dang zad byed lus tsha skya rbab dang me drod chung dang dug nad sbyong dur byid dug mo nyung sa bon bi pi ling dang bca' sga rnams sbrang rtsi rgun 'bru chur sbyar ba dbyar gyi dus kyi bkru sman yin
pairs.d4311: tsha ba gsum dang dri sna gsum dang gla sgang dang byi dang ga dang skyu ru ra dang de spyi dang mnyam pa'i dur byid dang de dang mnyam pa'i kha ra dkar po btags pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang ri lur byas pa zos na gcin sri ba dang rims dang skyug pa'i nad dang lud pa dang skem byed dang mgo 'khor ba dang zad byed kyi nad dang lus tsha ba dang skya rbab kyi nad dang me drod chung ba dang dug thams cad la rab tu bsngags so dur byid dang dug mo yungs dang pi pi ling dang bca' sga 'di rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang rgun 'bru'i khu ba dang sbyar te dbyar gyi dus su bkru sman btang bar bzang ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: pi pi ling dang sga rnams rim pas bskyed kun dang mnyam pa'i a ru'i thal sman sbyar me ni mngon sum nyid de drod skyed mchog shing kun kha ru tshwa dang tsha ba gsum sgog skya mar rnying reng bus me drod skyed bcu gnyis me mnyam gsang la me thur bya bad kan mgul 'gags nad la tsha ba lnga bzang po bzhi dang shing kun byi tang ga rgyam tshwas sna drangs tshwa sna tshogs tshad dang srub ka lce tsha'i phye ma sbrang rgod sbyar cong zhi rgod btul thal sman rnon po dang nang nub ltag pa sprad la chu skol dbul nya sha ol gong tsha ba khong du bsten sman rjes bshal skyugs sbrags la sbyang bar bya lhen gsang ske stong tshigs pa bzhi pa bsreg bad kan grum bu dkar po

pairs.d4310: shing tsha na ga ge sar dang a mra ta ka se 'bru dang sug smel kha ra sbrang rtsi dang kha lung chang sogs de dang de
pairs.d4311: de ltar gong du bshad pa'i bkru sman de dag kyang yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i sman shing tsha dang na ga ge sar dang a mra ta ka dang se'u 'bru dang sug smel dang kha ra dkar po dang sbrang rtsi dang kha lung dang chang la sogs pa dri zhim pos bsgos shing btab la ldan par byas la blud par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: sbrang dang sha mar sogs de dang de 'dra mngar ba'i sman sde yin se 'bru star bu bse yab skyu ru ra rgya shug da trig zho dar chang dang rtsabs de dang de 'dra la sogs skyur ba'i sde rgyam tshwa rgya tshwa lce myang tshwa dang ni rwa tshwa kha ru tshwa dang tsabs ru tshwa ze tshwa lba tshwa mdze tshwa thal tshwa dang shing tsha ya baksha ra bul

pairs.d4310: cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u gsum pa'o de nas sman mas gtong ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o ba la sle tres ra sna 'bras bu gsum
pairs.d4311: skyug sman dang bkru sman de grub par bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u gsum pa rdzogs so de nas sman mas gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya ste ba la dang sle tres dang 'bras bu gsum dang ra sna dang rtsa ba bcu pa dang 'di rnams srang re re dang po son cha'i rdog ma brgyad dang ra'i sha srang lnga bcu dang sman de rnams kyi bcu drug 'gyur gyi chu srang nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug dang bskol te btsags la
pairs.rgyud_text: par bya'o le'u brgya dang lnga bcu drug la bslab par bya ste gang zhe na 'di lta ste gleng gzhi gleng slong gzhi dang ngos 'dzin dang gso ba'i thabs dang rtsis kyi le'u drug mdo gnas rtsa ba'i rgyud du shes par bya bshad pa'i sdom dang chags tshul 'dra dpe dang gnas lugs mtshan nyid dbye ba 'jig ltas dang nad kyi rgyu rkyen zhugs tshul mtshan nyid dang dbye ba rgyun dus gnas skabs spyod pa dang zas tshul zas bsdam zas tshod ran par bza' sman gyi ro nus sbyar thabs

pairs.d4310: sle tres ba la ba spru ba ra sna btsod dang dong ga dang pu shel tse dang kyi lce ba ba ru ra dang pu tse shel rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu rnams
pairs.d4311: gla sgang dang pa tha dang sle tres dang e randa dang ba la dang ra sna dang ba spru ba dang btsod dang dong ga dang pu tse shel dang kyi lce ba dang ba ru ra dang rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu dang de rnams srang re re dang de rnams chu srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang tshul bzhin bskol te bzhi cha lus pa dang btsags te tshigs ma bor ba'i dngas ma 'o ma srang drug cu rtsa bzhi dang yang bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus ma zhu skyug pa sel bar byed dur thod

pairs.d4310: ka ka na se srang re dang nas dang ma sha zar ma dang rgya shug rgya sran khyor re'i tshad
pairs.d4311: sa ha tsa ra dang ka ka na se dang de rnams srang re re dang nas dang mon sran gre'u dang zar ma dang rgya shug dang rgya sran dang 'di rnams srang gnyis gnyis chu srang nyis stong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang tshul bzhin bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: khong nad spyir sdoms bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad do rma la lhan cig skyes dang glo bur ba lhan skyes 'bras dang rmen bu sur ya dang me dbal gzhang 'brum rkang bam mtshan bar rdol glo bur rma la gnas dang rigs kyis dbye gnas ni mgo ske byang khog yan lag la rma rigs bshus

pairs.d4310: khrag dang khu ba'i nad sel byed bu skyed par yang byed pa yin rgyam tsha ru rta po son cha shu ti lcang ma shu dag dang ba le ka dang shing mngar dang ga bra'i rtsa ba kad pha la thang shing dong gra ma nu dang me da dpyi mo tsi tra ka zur pa bong dbyi dang ga
pairs.d4311: nyams brta ba dang rlung dang mkhris pa 'joms shing nyams stobs dang me drod dang khu chu 'phel bar byed de khrag dang khu ba'i nad 'phrog cing bu skyed par byed do yang na rgyam tsha dang po son cha dang ru rta dang shu ti dang lcang ma dang shu dag dang ba la ka dang shing mngar dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang thang shing dang kad pa la dang dong gra dang ma nu dang med dang dbyi mo dang tsi tra ka dang zur pa dang byi dang ga dang bong nga dkar po dang tri bi tsa dang ha re nu ka dang ni li ni dang thi ra dang bil ba dang ti mu sa dang pi pi ling dang dan ti dang ra sna dang 'di rnams cha mnyam ste e randa'i mar ram
pairs.rgyud_text: myang tshwa dang kha ru tshwa ti mu sa dang bur dkar srang brgyad sbyar shing kun cur nis lto sbos yi ga 'chus kha zas mi 'ju gdong skrangs dbugs mi bde stod rgyangs lud pa mchin mcher rtsib logs gzer mkhal rked rkang lag skrangs dang dri chu sri skran dang skya rbab dmu rdzing skyug pa sel byi tang ga dang shing kun ma ru tse bca' sga gla rtsi phur thal pi pi ling bur dkar sbyar ba'i byi tang bdun pa ste pho long srin nad gzhang 'brum ma lus 'joms da trig se 'bru shing tsha pi pi ling bca' sga ka ped tha rams mon cha ra na rams bur dkar sbyar ba'i da trig dgu 'ur 'khrog sgreg cing 'khru ba gcod par byed da trig smag dang tha rams lo tsan spod gtsod khrag lug mur da trig bdun pa ste tsha

pairs.d4310: sbrum ma la yang bsngags pa yin bong nga kar ka ta sring gi pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir sbyar
pairs.d4311: gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po rnams 'joms te bud med sbrum ma la yang bsngags so bong nga dkar po dang kar ta sring gi dang pi pi ling dang de rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang lde gur byas te bldag go
pairs.rgyud_text: zho bzhi bur srang gcig mar rnying srang bdun lde gur byas te btang mi rus bsdus khur sgog skya shing kun bran mthil bzhi tshigs pa rlung gsang sku mnye dang rlung gsang bzhi bsro mar rnying 'jam rtsi bya sha chang mar rnying bu ram drod bcud bsten byis pa bad kan grang

pairs.d4310: sman gyis ji bzhin gso bar bya yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las gnas drug pa ste tha ma rdzogs so
pairs.rgyud_text: gnas lugs nad gzhi'i le'u ste gsum pa'o le'u bzhi pa ngos 'dzin rtags de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig nad la blta reg dri bas yongs shes bya mig gis blta ba lce dang chu la brtag brtag pa 'di ni mthong

pairs.d4310: me tog sman ma bri ha ti shing tsha spang spos po son cha byi la'i rtug pa phub ma dang shu dag mi skra sbrul lpags dang
