pairs.d4311: ras bal gyi sa bon dang rma bya'i sgro dang bri ha ti dang ma ha de ba la phul ba'i me tog rnying pa dang po son cha dang shing tsha dang spang spos dang byi la'i rtug pa dang 'bras kyi phub ma dang shu dag dang mi'i skra dang sbrul gyi pags pa brjes pa dang glang po che'i so dang glang gi rwa dang shing kun dang na le sham dang 'di rnams cha mnyam ste btags pa bsregs pa'i dud pas bdugs na skem byed kyi gdon dang smyo ba dang sha za dang lha'i
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba

pairs.d4310: dbyig ni gtor mar sbyin par bya mar dang 'o ma ba gcin ni cha mnyam bskol ba btung ba dang snar blugs lus la bskus na phan
pairs.d4311: ma byas pa'ang rung ba'i gtor ma sbyin no mar dang 'o ma dang ba gcin dang cha snyoms te bskol ba las btung ba dang snar blugs pa dang bsku byug byas na gnod sbyin gyi gdon la phan
pairs.rgyud_text: tshwa til mar sbyar te bskol ba byug khrag la rlung zhugs snum 'chos byas la gtar khrag zags rjes su tshor med gyur pa la dud pa rgyam tshwa til mar sbyar bas byug don babs snying rlung shing kun gsum thang btang 'bras bu'i mar dang

pairs.d4310: skad snyan tshig gsal dran pa dang yid gzhungs dpal ni skyed par byed 'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga pa tra e la thang shing dang e la ba lu ka dang ni thal tres rnam gnyis ser po gnyis sthi ra rnam gnyis pri yang ku rgya spos ru rta bri ha ti
pairs.d4311: bud med bu med pa la bu ster bar byed cing skad snyan pa dang tshig gsal ba dang dran pa dang yid gzhungs par byed cing dpal skyed par byed do 'bras bu gsum dang bi sha la dang ha re nu ka dang thang shing dang e la ba lu ka dang thal tres rnam gnyis dang ser po rnam gnyis dang sthi ra rnam gnyis dang pri yang ku dang rgya spos dang bri ha ti dang ru rta dang btsod dang dong ga dang na ga ge sar dang se'u 'bru dang byi dang ga dang bal bu'i lo ma dang sna ma'i me tog kha ma phye ba dang utpa la dang dan ti dang shug pa dang tsandan dkar po dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang btags te
pairs.rgyud_text: rbab 'joms gur kum ma nu ka ped byi tang ga pa tra sbrang sbyar ril bus skya rbab dang sha ser mchin nad rlan grang sbos pa 'joms da lis dbyi mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus ma zhu skyug pa sel bar byed dur thod sha ru spen ma'i thal ba gsum tsa bya a ru'i ril bus

pairs.d4310: wa dang reg 'jam 'ug pa dang byi ba ra thug dza ti ka'i gcin dang rtug pa spu dang ni pags pa mkhris pa sen mo dang
pairs.d4311: wa dang sha lya ka dang 'ug pa dang dza du ka dang byi ba dang ra thug dang 'di rnams kyi gcin dang rtug pa dang spu dang pags pa dang mkhris pa dang sen mo dang 'di rnams kyi dud pas sna dang lus la byug pa dang mig la bsku ba dang lus bkru ba dang blugs pa la sogs pa smyo byed can la spyad do
pairs.rgyud_text: rlag ne le bya rog dang 'ug pa bye'u khra rtsal mthus za ba'i sde mdzo g.yag rnga mo rta bong ba lang dang skom po ra lug khyi dang phag pa bya byi la la sogs mi yis bdag byed sde 'phyi ba byi thur sbal sbrul grum pa dang rmigs pa rtsangs pa sdig pa khung gnas sde khrung khrung ngang ngur so bya skyar mo dang sram dang nya sogs rlan la gnas pa'i sde

pairs.d4310: de steng rgyam tsha gdab par bya shing mngar dang ni skyu ru ra pa to la bskol chu blugs bya
pairs.d4311: de'i steng du rgyam tsha'i phye mas gdab par bya'o shing mngar dang skyu ru ra dang pa to la rnams bskol ba'i chus kyang blugs so
pairs.rgyud_text: gser me mtshon cha pa to la chibs su ka ra bcas pas nad yul 'don tsha ba smin dus ga bur gi wam bsnan snod du babs na brag zhun dug mo nyung bcos

pairs.d4310: snum blud gtar ga bkru sman sna sman dang mig sman mgo bo'i bkru sman mas gtong dang nyams brtas byugs dang blugs pas ci rigs gso
pairs.d4311: snum gyi btung ba dang khrag 'dzag pa dang bkru sman dang sna sman dang mig sman bsku ba dang mgo bo'i bkru sman dang sman mas gtong ba dang nyams brta bar bya ba dang byugs pa dang blugs pa la sogs pa ci rigs par mig nad can la sbyar ro
pairs.rgyud_text: dom mkhris btab btang sna khrag 'dzag pa gcod nag mtshur seng phrom a ru'i grang thang gis mkhur bkang kha yi khrag nad zug gzer 'joms bong nga shing mngar spang rgyan dkar bsdus khur cu gang kar sbyar skad 'gags tsha skams sel so phag bsdus khur 'u su ka ra btab mkhur bkang kha lce gre ba skams

pairs.d4310: phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u bcu bdun pa'o de nas rna ba'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o rlung las gyur pa'i rna nad la
pairs.d4311: rna nad kyi dmigs brtags pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa rdzogs so de nas rna ba'i nad gso bar bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste de la rlung las gyur pa'i rna ba'i nad la ni thog mar sha khu blud la de'i nub mo rlung 'joms pa'i sman dang sbyar ba'i mar blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung

pairs.d4310: shi ri parni pri yadku shing mngar seng phrom til mar gyi bcu 'gyur 'o ma skyer bar bcas
pairs.d4311: 'bras bu gsum dang khre dang shing parni dang shing mngar dang seng phrom dang til mar dang de'i bcu 'gyur gyi 'o ma dang skyer pa dang de rnams lhan cig bskol te mar lus pa las sna sman gtang bar bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la

pairs.d4310: khu ba bstan pa la sogs gang gzhan ni bad kan sel bar byed pa phan pa yin srog ni rlung gi lam la gnas pas na
pairs.d4311: khu bcud dang khur ba la sogs pa gang yang bad kan 'joms par byed pa'i zas bza'o srog gi rlung gi lam la gnas pa yin te
pairs.rgyud_text: drod de yis kha zas 'ju tshul ni zas skom srog gi rlung gis lto bar bcug skom gyis bshig cing snum gyis mnyen par byed me mnyam rlung gis mkhris pa 'ju byed bus pho

pairs.d4310: ra sna sthi ra lca ba dang sug smel zur ba ma nu dang ba spru ba dang cu gang dang ra mnye ba dang byi tsher ba
pairs.d4311: bri ha ti dang thal tres rnam gnyis dang bu ram shing dang mur ba dang gze ma dang zangs rtsi dang shing ga ta la ka dang rgun 'bru go stan dang ra sna dang nyi ra dang lca ba dang sug smel dang zur ba dang ma nu dang ba spru ba dang nu gang dang bu tshang rdo dang byi tsher ba dang me tog ma tu ka dang star ka dang ba ta ma dang munydza ta ka dang shri shi da dang de rnams zho gnyis gnyis btags pa'i phye ma btab la bskol te mar lus pa ni rma bya chen po'i sman mar zhes bya ste yon tan gong ma bas che ste
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i mchog ra mnye nye shing lca ba ba spru ba gze ma 'bri mar rtsa ba lnga yi mar tshwa sna gsum dang sle tres bzang po gsum bca' sga pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar mkhal ma'i grang nad rlung tshabs sel bar byed 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres pa 'ba' sam zhes bya stod smad kun la bsngags 'ba' sam de nang da byid lug thug 'bras mar la cong zhi bca' sga pi pi ling sle tres rgyam tshwa sug smel bre ga dang bu ram sbyar ba da byid skyin gor te ro tsa mkhal nad za khu 'dod nyams sel sgog skya a ru sga yi sman mar la rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa dang pi pi ling

pairs.d4310: bskus na 'brum bu mdze dang rma gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra ba 'joms byi dang ka snying 'bras bu gsum pi pi ling rtsa pi pi ling sbrang rtsi til mar sbyar ba yi lde gu zos na srin bu'i nad mtshan bar rdol dang mdze nad dang
pairs.d4311: mar lus pa las bsku byug byas na 'brum chen dang mdze dang gcin nad sbrang rtsi lta bu dang du ma 'joms par byed do byi dang ga'i snying po dang 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling dang pi pi ling mu la dang de rnams sbrang rtsi dang til mar sbyar ba'i lde gu zos na srin bu'i nad dang mtshan bar rdol ba dang mdze nad dang gcin snyi ba dang smas pa dang rma 'khyims pa dang de rnams 'joms shing 'tsho bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: bcu dgu'o smad nad gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol ba dang rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldags dang g.yan pa glang shu za rkong shu ba dang reg pa'i dug dang mdzer pa ngo khab dang nad gzhan lpags la gram dang bcu ru bshad sha yi nad la lba ba rmen bu gnyis nad gzhan sha la rgyas dang rnam pa gsum rtsa yi nad la rtsa dkar rtsa nag gnyis nad gzhan rtsa ru rgyug dang

pairs.d4310: byi dang ka snying 'bras bu gsum sbrang rtsi til mar sbyar ba yi lde gu zos na srin bu'i nad mtshan bar rdol dang mdze nad dang gcin snyi ba dang smas pa dang rma 'khyims 'tsho bar byed pa yin sle tres sug smel byi dang ka dug mo nyung dang ba ru ra skyu ru ra dang a ru ra
pairs.d4311: byi dang ga'i snying po dang 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling dang pi pi ling mu la dang de rnams sbrang rtsi dang til mar sbyar ba'i lde gu zos na srin bu'i nad dang mtshan bar rdol ba dang mdze nad dang gcin snyi ba dang smas pa dang rma 'khyims pa dang de rnams 'joms shing 'tsho bar byed do sle tres dang sug smel dang byi dang ga dang dug mo yungs dang ba ru ra dang a ru ra dang skyu ru ra dang gu gul dang de rnams kyi phye ma rim bzhin du cha res bskyed pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang lde gur byas te zos na 'brum bu dang tsho zhing sbom pa dang mtshan bar rdol gyi nad rnams las rgyal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: sur ya rmen bu rlig rlugs dang rkang bam mtshan bar rdol dang le'u brgyad byis pa nyer spyod nad dang de'i gdon gsum mo nad spyi dang bye brag phal pa gsum 'byung po smyo brjed gza' dang klu gdon lnga rma la rma spyi mgo dang ske yi rma byang khog yan lag le'u lnga ru bshad dug la sbyar dug gyur pa dngos dang gsum rgas pa gso ba bcud kyis len pa dang ro tsa khu ba gso dang bud med btsal de ltar man ngag rgyud la bco lnga'i skabs gcig gcig gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bzhi gcig dang lnga dang drug dang brgyad gnyis bcu drug gcig bcu dgu gcig dang zhus pas dgu bcu gnyis rtsa chu thang phye ril bu lde gu dang sman mar thal sman khanda sman chang dang rin po che dang

pairs.d4310: gcin snyi ba dang smas pa dang rma 'khyims 'tsho bar byed pa yin sle tres sug smel byi dang ka dug mo nyung dang ba ru ra skyu ru ra dang a ru ra
pairs.d4311: byi dang ga'i snying po dang 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling dang pi pi ling mu la dang de rnams sbrang rtsi dang til mar sbyar ba'i lde gu zos na srin bu'i nad dang mtshan bar rdol ba dang mdze nad dang gcin snyi ba dang smas pa dang rma 'khyims pa dang de rnams 'joms shing 'tsho bar byed do sle tres dang sug smel dang byi dang ga dang dug mo yungs dang ba ru ra dang a ru ra dang skyu ru ra dang gu gul dang de rnams kyi phye ma rim bzhin du cha res bskyed pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang lde gur byas te zos na 'brum bu dang tsho zhing sbom pa dang mtshan bar rdol gyi nad rnams las rgyal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: bcu dgu'o smad nad gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol ba dang rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldags dang g.yan pa glang shu za rkong shu ba dang reg pa'i dug dang mdzer pa ngo khab dang nad gzhan lpags la gram dang bcu ru bshad sha yi nad la lba ba rmen bu gnyis nad gzhan sha la rgyas dang rnam pa gsum rtsa yi nad la rtsa dkar rtsa nag gnyis nad gzhan rtsa ru rgyug dang rnam pa gsum rus pa'i nad la dreg dang rkang bam gnyis nad gzhan rus la zhen dang rnam pa gsum sha rus kun la gnas pa grum bu'i nad spyi ru sdoms pas nyi shu tham pa'o phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad

pairs.d4310: gcin snyi lto ba mchin pa dang mcher pa na zhing skad gsang dma' nyam chung sgyid ni zhan pa dang skrangs shing rtag tu sbo ba dang rkang pa lag pa skam zhing zad
pairs.d4311: rgyal po dang 'khon pa'i dgras rgyal po'i 'khor nye bar gnas pa la gla rngan byin te kha zas kyi nang du dbyig dug byin na dbyig dug gis zin pa'i mtshan ma ni mdog skya ba dang lus skem zhing rjud pa dang me'i drod chung ba dang lud pa lu ba dang dbugs mi bde ba dang rims kyis nyam thag pa dang rlung lam gzhan du zhugs pa dang rtag tu gnyid 'ong ba dang sems las che zhing yid mi bde bar 'gyur ba dang lto ba dang mchin pa dang mcher pa cher skyes te skad gsang dma' ba dang nyam chung ba dang sgyid zhan pa dang skrang ba dang rtag tu lto sbo ba dang rkang pa dang lag pa skem zhing na ba dang phal cher rmi lam gyi nang du ce spyang dang byi la dang sre mo dang sbrul 'di rnams mthong zhing nags dang mtsho rnams kyang skam par byed pa mthong ba rnams yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: smra ba thos dang mthong ba dang byi la spre 'u sram sbrul lam bcad cing bkra mi shis pa gang mthong ngan pa'i ltas dge ba 'bru dang zho sogs snod gang dang dril bu mar me me tog 'bras yos zan lha yi sku dang lus kyi rgyan dkar po chos spyod pa dang rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang me 'bar rta lug ba sogs phrug gur bcas yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'am bza' btung rgyan de dag lam du mthong ngam khyim du 'jug dge ltas nad pa sos pa'i mtshan nyid yin zho phrum la sogs khyim nas phyir 'byung dang rlung med me shi snod chag ngan pa'i ltas rmi lam byi la spre'u stag dang wa ro la zhon rmis 'chi bdag zin pa'i rtags ma he rta phag bong bu rnga mo la gcer bur zhon nas lho phyogs 'gro rmis 'chi spyi bor lcug ma skyes te bya tshang bcas ta la tsher ma can shing snying gar skyes padma phyung dang g.yang lhung dur khrod nyal

pairs.d4310: spangs ma pu tse shel dang pa ya sya shing mngar thal tres tsandan 'bras bu gsum shu dag tsha ba gsum dang ser po gnyis pa to la'i rtsa rgyam tsha zhib tu btags
pairs.d4311: spangs ma dang pu tse shel dang pa ya sya dang shing mngar dang tsandan dang thal tres dang shu dag dang 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum dang ser po rnam gnyis dang pa to la'i rtsa ba dang rgyam tsha dang 'di rnams legs par btags te
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi

pairs.d4310: dar bar sbyar bas gzhang 'brum sel go bye legs par smin pa ni 'bras kyi phung po'i nang du gzhug
pairs.d4311: dar ba dang lhan cig 'thungs na gzhang 'brum sel to go bye legs par smin par dpyid kyi dus su 'bru'i phung po'i nang du bcug ste
pairs.rgyud_text: dang skra dang kha spu bregs gshin dang lhan cig chang 'thung des 'drud dang gos dang phreng ba dmar pos brgyan pa yi gshin po dag dang lhan cig gar byed pa de dag 'chi

pairs.d4310: pi ling skyu ru ra yi phye rang gi khu bar legs par sbangs sha kha mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas
pairs.d4311: pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra'i phye ma rang gi khu ba dang sbangs te sha kha ra dang sbrang rtsi dang mar dang lhan cig lde gur byas te lhags la de'i 'og tu btung bar 'o ma blud na skyes bu lo brgyad cu lon na yang lang tsho la bab pa'i skyes bu bzhin du dga' ba thob cing nus par 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: zho bzhi bur srang gcig mar rnying srang bdun lde gur byas te btang mi rus bsdus khur sgog skya shing kun bran mthil bzhi tshigs pa rlung gsang sku mnye dang rlung gsang bzhi bsro mar rnying 'jam rtsi bya sha chang mar rnying bu ram drod bcud bsten byis pa bad kan grang shas che ba dang bad kan yul du tsha ba babs pa dang ma smin gtar bsil tsha ba byer

pairs.d4310: tshil dang rlung nad la ni gu gul phan khrag mkhris la ni ba sha ka rab bsngags
pairs.d4311: tshil dang rlung 'dres pa'i nad la ni gu gul phan no khrag dang mkhris pa la ni ba sha ka phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: dang sbyar la bcos pa ni ba spur babs dus lto sgug chu skol btang kha zas bsil phyogs mi btang smin par dka' bsil thang phye ma mi bsten tsha

pairs.d4310: phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste bzhi bcu tham pa'o sman pa'i bdag po dge 'dun gsang ba zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas te drug pa'o sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba ji snyed pa rdzogs so
pairs.d4311: ro tsa bar byed pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu tham pa'o sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las gnas drug pa ste tha ma rdzogs so
pairs.rgyud_text: man ngag gi rgyud las ngos 'dzin rtags kyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o le'u lnga pa gso thabs de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig nad la gso bar byed pa'i gnyen po ni zas dang spyod lam sman dpyad bzhi yin te rta bong 'phyi ba lo sha sha chen dang 'bru mar lo mar bu ram

pairs.d4310: sman pa'i bdag po dge 'dun gsang ba zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas te drug pa'o sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba ji snyed pa rdzogs so
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las gnas drug pa ste tha ma rdzogs so
pairs.rgyud_text: lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyud bzhi'i mjug don bsdus pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags dang po nad shugs ma rdzogs mngon tshul dus gso ba byas kyang lam nas mi zlog

pairs.d4310: 'thungs pa'am 'thung bar 'dod pa dag kha zas zos dang mgo bkrus dang 'khru bar 'dod dang gtar ga byas
pairs.d4311: yang de la sman sna nas gtang du mi rung ba'i dmigs ni chu 'thungs pa dang chang 'thungs pa dang dug 'thungs pa dang mar 'thungs pa rnams dang 'phral du 'thung bar 'dod pa dang kha zas zos pa dang mgo bkru ba dang khrus byed 'dod pa dang gtar ga gdab pa dang cham pa sar pa dang bshang gci 'ong bar 'gyur te
pairs.rgyud_text: bu sel bad kan lto sbos dbugs mi bde ba dang cham pa rims gsar 'phral du zlog par byed bskol grang bad kan mi skyed mkhris pa sel zhag gcig lon nas dug 'dra nyes kun skyed chang ni mngar skyur kha la zhu rjes skyur rno dro rtsub phra cung zad thur du 'khru drod 'bar spobs skyed gnyid 'phel bad rlung sel thal drags sems bsgyur bag med ngo tsha 'jig ra

pairs.d4310: de nas mig brta ba'i cho ga dang mig sman gyi phur ma bsregs shing btsos pa'i khu ba mig tu blugs pa'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: mig brta ba'i cho ga zhun mar mig tu blugs pa dang sman gyi phur ma bsregs shing bcos pa'i khu ba'i thigs pa mig tu blugs pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bshad par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: ni lud pa bsal ba'i cho ga bya mchi ma bkag pas snying dang mgo bo na sna chu 'dzag cing mgo 'khor yi ga 'chus de la chang btung gnyid log gtam snyan phan 'phyen bkag rtug skams 'phyen dang bshang ba 'gag skran

pairs.d4310: yang na go ra danda dang a pa marga dzi ba ka zangs rtsi ba dang sherya ka
pairs.d4311: yang na go ra da na da dang a pa marga dang dzi ba ga dang zangs rtsi ba dang shri sha dang 'di rnams la gnyis sam gsum mam mang du 'tshogs kyang rung ste
pairs.rgyud_text: sel lug ngal dug sel yan lag skrangs pa 'joms zangs rtsi ba yis mkhris nad mig ser sel rnya los rgyu long snod kyi tsha ba sel sho mang rma yi tsha ba sel bar byed pa yag rtsa bas glo gso glo

pairs.d4310: rmi lam du ni phye ma leb rtsangs pa sdig sbrul gcan gzan spre'u bya rnams kyis ni gtses par mthong skra rus phub ma thal kyi phung po la ni 'dzegs pa dang
pairs.d4311: rmi lam na phye ma leb dang rtsangs pa dang sdig sbrul dang spre'u dang gcan gzan dang bya rnams kyis bdag la 'tshe bar mthong skra dang rus pa dang phub ma dang thal ba'i phung po la bdag 'dzeg cing 'gro bar rmi
pairs.rgyud_text: tan gang 'tsho mdzad khyod kyis bdag la lung ston cig ces zhus pa las ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po khyod nyon cig gtad pa'i snod la bzang ngan ci ste med snod ngan rnams kyis gdams pa'i bcud

pairs.d4310: mtshon la pas smas pa yis rma byung mi 'phrod bsten pa las rma kha'i tsha ba rlung gis phul khrag bcas mkhris pa 'byung bar byed
pairs.d4311: mtshon la sogs pas rmas te rma byung ba las mi 'phrod pas rma red de rma kha tsha ba rlung gis phul nas khrag dang mkhris pa mched de khrag dang mkhris pa de las nad bla thabs rne'u lhags shing de dag tu na bar 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: dang spyod lam mi 'phrod pas ma zhu'i dwangs ma mchin gnas zungs ma gyur ngan khrag chu ser rgyas pa rlung gis gtor lus kun khyab pas skya rbab dag tu g.yo de nyid glo mchin mcher par zhugs pa dang chu ser rlung dang ldan phyir dbye ba lnga glo ba skya rbab khrag shas

pairs.d4310: rlung skyed pa ni de dang des rlung 'phel ro stod la zhugs nas gdong gi gzhogs phyed yon por byed smra ba dgod dang lta ba'ang yo
pairs.d4311: pa dang gdong yon por gcus nas sbrid pa gtong ba dang gzhu sra ste ma 'dren pa dang mal stan mthon dman mi snyoms pa la nyal ba dang bca' ba skam po sran te ma 'cha' ba dang de bzhin du rlung nad skyes pa'i bag bsten pas rlung 'phel te ro stod du zhugs nas kha gdong gi gzhogs phyed yon por byas te de smra ba dang dgod pa dang lta ba rnams kyang yo bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: ske bstungs brang du bsdus te ro stod 'bur 'gram pa nyams pa 'thams 'phyang 'byed 'dzum nyams lce ldib bza' btung smra dka' lugs ldib then gzhogs gcig gug pa kha yo mgo bo 'dar tshig thogs mig rengs dran nyams gnyid log dngangs rtsa 'dzin rlung khrag spyi bo'i rtsar zhugs te nad tshabs drag la spyi gtsug sha mdog nag gzhogs phyed skams pa tshor med bya ba nyams lus kun skams pa thams cad de dang 'dra shing rengs dgye dgu mi shes shing ltar rengs

pairs.d4310: yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcu drug pa'o yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las nad gzhi'i gnas zhes bya ba bcu drug pa rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i gnas gsum pa'o
pairs.rgyud_text: dang ngos 'dzin dang gso ba'i thabs dang rtsis kyi le'u drug mdo gnas rtsa ba'i rgyud du shes par bya bshad pa'i sdom dang chags tshul 'dra dpe dang gnas lugs mtshan nyid dbye ba 'jig ltas dang nad kyi rgyu rkyen zhugs tshul mtshan nyid dang dbye ba rgyun dus gnas skabs spyod

pairs.d4310: pa la ka sa nim pa'i lo shu dag ru rta a ru ra yungs kar nas bcas mar sbyar ba'i
pairs.d4311: yang na ba la ka sha dang nim pa'i lo ma dang shu dag dang ru rta dang a ru ra dang yungs kar dang nas dang mar dang sbyar bas bdug par byas na rims ma rungs pa sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: gsum gyi mar khu yungs kar dang don snod sha rus rtsa yi sgo srung bzang drug se 'bru pa tol dug nyung pi ling sdig srin ba ru yung ba spyi zhur 'bri ta sa 'dzin shing mngar skyu ru re skon dang rlung mkhris bad kan khrag

pairs.d4310: bri shi ba dang bri ha ti a ru ra dang yab ti kru trug tres dang rgun 'brum dang dbyi mong byi tsher bar sha bu
pairs.d4311: mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang sman pa la dang tsha ba gsum dang byi dong ga dang zur pa dang bal po se'u dang se'u rtsa la zhes bya ba kha ru tsha dang ya baksha ra zhes bya ba nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang ma nu'i rtsa ba dang bri kshi ba zhes bya ba ba spru ba dang bri ha ti dang a ru ra dang la la phud dang kru trug tres dang rgun 'brum dang dbyi mo dang purna rna ba me tog dmar po can dang byi tsher ba dang a ma la po ta sa zhes bya ba lta bu dang kar ka ta shring gi ni dang ta ma la ki dang bhar gi zhes bya ba ga bra'i rtsa ba dang ra sna dang gze ma dang 'di rnams cham chom brdungs pa dang 'di rnams lhan cig bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i mchog ra mnye nye shing lca ba ba spru ba gze ma 'bri mar rtsa ba lnga yi mar tshwa sna gsum dang sle tres bzang po gsum bca' sga pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar mkhal ma'i grang nad rlung tshabs sel bar byed 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres pa 'ba' sam zhes bya stod smad kun la bsngags 'ba' sam de nang da byid lug thug 'bras mar la cong zhi bca' sga pi pi ling sle tres rgyam tshwa sug smel bre ga dang bu ram sbyar ba da byid skyin gor te ro tsa mkhal nad za khu 'dod nyams sel sgog skya a ru sga yi sman mar la rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa dang pi pi ling sug smel bu ram btab pas da rgan dang rgyu long mkhal rked nad dang rlig rlugs sel sgog skya srang brgyad 'bri mar cha mnyam sbyar bcu gnyis nas kyi gseb

pairs.d4310: sman gyi phye ma mar sbyar blugs pi pi ling dang kha ru tsha ya baksha ra sle tres dang shing kun tso ra bye'u rug pa
pairs.d4311: rtsa ba bcu pa tshul bzhin du bskol ba'i khu ba 'o ma dang bskol te mar lus pa dang des gong ma bzhin du dro ba dang grang ba res mos kyis snar blugs so pi pi ling dang kha ru tsha dang ya baksha ra dang gu ru tshe dang shing kun dang tso ra ka dang byi'u rug pa dang 'di rnams mar dang zho ga chu dang rtsa ba bcu bskol ba'i khu ba dang bsres te yang bskol nas
pairs.rgyud_text: tshwa thal tshwa dang shing tsha ya baksha ra bul tog rnams de dang de 'dra la sogs lan tshwa'i sde nim pa tig ta bong nga dkar po dang hong len gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung gla rtsi mkhris pa skyer pa ba sha ka brag zhun kyi lce re son la sogs pa de dang de 'dra kha ba'i sman sde yin na le sham dang bca' sga pi pi ling sga gsher shing kun srub ka lce tsha ba dwa ba btsong dang sgog skya la sogs

pairs.d4310: mchil mang yi ga 'chus pa dang snying dang rtsib logs na lud pa dbugs mi bde dang mgul nad 'joms la la phud dang da trig dang star bu bca' sga se'u 'bru dang rgya shug zho ni gnyis gnyis byas kha ra srang bzhi 'u su dang go snyod shing tsha kha ru tsha zho re pi pi ling 'bru brgya na le sham ni nyis brgya dag
pairs.d4311: cham pa dang yi ga 'chus pa dang snying na ba dang lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang mgul pa'i nad rnams 'joms so la la phud dang da trig dang star bu dang bca' sga dang se'u 'bru dang rgya shug dang de rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang kha ra srang bzhi dang 'u su dang kha ru tsha dang go snyod dang shing tsha dang 'di rnams zho re re dang pi pi ling 'bru brgyad dang na le sham nyis brgya dang de rnams kyi phye mas ni yi ge 'bye
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs

pairs.d4310: dbugs mi bde dang mgul nad 'joms la la phud dang da trig dang star bu bca' sga se'u 'bru dang rgya shug zho ni gnyis gnyis byas kha ra srang bzhi 'u su dang go snyod shing tsha kha ru tsha zho re pi pi ling 'bru brgya na le sham ni nyis brgya dag
pairs.d4311: cham pa dang yi ga 'chus pa dang snying na ba dang lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang mgul pa'i nad rnams 'joms so la la phud dang da trig dang star bu dang bca' sga dang se'u 'bru dang rgya shug dang de rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang kha ra srang bzhi dang 'u su dang kha ru tsha dang go snyod dang shing tsha dang 'di rnams zho re re dang pi pi ling 'bru brgyad dang na le sham nyis brgya dang de rnams kyi phye mas ni yi ge 'bye
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang ba'i nad mi 'byung ba yod do grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na ri bo gangs

pairs.d4310: shing kun mar dang til mar brngos zho yi spris mar bskol ba dang 'u su dang ni tsha ba lnga btags pa'i phye dang se 'bru'i bcud 'u su'i 'dab ma gzhon nu dang sge'u gsher gshags par gyur pa dang
pairs.d4311: ma yang ba dang phyi sa sla bar 'gyur ba'i bag gang yang rung ba tshod mar byas pa'i nang du shing kun dang til dang mar dang zho'i spris ma dang 'u su dang tsha ba lnga btags pa'i phye ma dang 'u su'i ge sar dang sge'u gsher gshags pa dang 'di rnams spod thabs su bcug pa legs par sbyar te
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed

pairs.d4310: des ni gzhang 'brum skran bcas zhi byed cing me yi stobs ni myur du skyed par byed yang na rtsa ba bcu pa dur byid dang pa ta ar ka gnyis dang bong nga dkar
pairs.d4311: rlung med pa'i gnas su zla ba phyed bzhag nas de las ran par 'thungs na gzhang 'brum dang skran rnams zhi bar byed de me'i stobs skyed cing myur du 'ju bar 'gyur ro yang na rtsa ba bcu pa dang dur byid dang pa tha dang arka rnam gnyis dang bong nga dkar po dang kad pha la dang 'di rnams srang bcu bcu btags la sbyor ba gong ma bzhin du rdza ma kha sbyar gyi nang du bsregs te thal bar gyur pa dang chu srang lnga brgya bcu gnyis kyi nang du bcug la ras kyis btsags nas tshigs ma bor la dngas ma de rdza bum gyi nang du bskol nas bzhi cha srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad lus pa dang de'i nang du bu ram srang brgya dang tsha ba gsum dang dbyi mo dang a ru ra srang lnga lnga dang tsi tra ka srang gnyis dang ya baksha ra srang gnyis dang de rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma bcug la yang bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: ka ra la sbyor zhib tu btags la gdab 'ju tshod lon tsam khyi'u sus bsten par bya zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las lde gu'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig sman mar sde tshan tsha sel grang sel gnyis tsha sel tig ta hong len ba sha ka spang rtsi kyi lce khu ba phyungs pa yi dwangs ma ba mdzo'i 'o ma mar gsar la sbyar ba'i mar khur gur kum ge sar gsum ka ra sbrang sbyar mig ser skya rbab dang chu ser lpags nad tshad rnying rlung ldan 'don tig ta kyi lce ba dang sum cu tig ba le ka dang 'bras bu gsum gyi mar mchin mkhris snying gi tsha ba rnyings pa sel tig ta nim pa hong len pa to la skyer pa byi tsher kyi lce par pa ta bskol khur gla sgang rtsa mkhris dug

pairs.d4310: bzhi cha lus par bu ram srang brgya dang tsha ba gsum dang dbyi mong a ru ra srang lnga tsi tra ka ni srang gnyis dang ya baksha ra srang gnyis bcug ste bskol
pairs.d4311: yang na rtsa ba bcu pa dang dur byid dang pa tha dang arka rnam gnyis dang bong nga dkar po dang kad pha la dang 'di rnams srang bcu bcu btags la sbyor ba gong ma bzhin du rdza ma kha sbyar gyi nang du bsregs te thal bar gyur pa dang chu srang lnga brgya bcu gnyis kyi nang du bcug la ras kyis btsags nas tshigs ma bor la dngas ma de rdza bum gyi nang du bskol nas bzhi cha srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad lus pa dang de'i nang du bu ram srang brgya dang tsha ba gsum dang dbyi mo dang a ru ra srang lnga lnga dang tsi tra ka srang gnyis dang ya baksha ra srang gnyis dang de rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma bcug la yang bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: ka ra la sbyor zhib tu btags la gdab 'ju tshod lon tsam khyi'u sus bsten par bya zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las lde gu'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig sman mar sde tshan tsha sel grang sel gnyis tsha sel tig ta hong len ba sha ka spang rtsi kyi lce khu ba phyungs pa yi dwangs ma ba mdzo'i 'o ma mar gsar la sbyar ba'i mar khur gur kum ge sar gsum ka ra sbrang sbyar mig ser skya rbab dang chu ser lpags nad tshad rnying rlung ldan 'don tig ta kyi lce ba dang sum cu tig ba le ka dang 'bras bu gsum gyi

pairs.d4310: bshang ba ma 'dres mkhregs bcas la zho dang 'o ma mar til mar bca' sga bu ram bcas pa blud yang na rgya shug 'bras bu spangs bu ram til mar ldan pa sbyin
pairs.d4311: yang na phyi sa btsir yang mi 'byung ba la ni zho dang 'o ma dang mar dang bca' sga dang bu ram dang sbyar ba btung ngo yang na rgya shug gi 'bras bu sbangs pa bu ram dang til mar du bcas pa bza'o
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil

pairs.d4310: nad ni gnas nas bskyod pa dang cho ga grub bshad bkru sman gtang pa to la'i rtsa 'bras bu gsum skyer pa byi dang ga zho re
pairs.d4311: rlung zhi zhing nad rang gi gnas las bskyod pa dang cho ga grub pa las 'byung ba'i bkru sman bya'o pa to la'i rtsa ba dang 'bras bu gsum dang skyer pa dang byi dang ga dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang ka pi lya zho bzhi bzhi dang ni li ni zho drug dang tri bi tsa zho brgyad dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma gcin dang sbyar ba'i bkru sman blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: dbang bla gnyan bcas pa'i nad yin te rang gi gnas nas langs nas gnas gzhan phyin phyin nas rang gnas snga ma la gnod 'khrug de stobs chung na rang gnas snga ma gso phyi ma stobs che bla gnyan de bcos pas rang gnas gnas pa bcos mi dgos par 'tsho dper na rkun mo bsten pa'i rje bo bzhin khyad par gso ba'i tshul la rnam pa dgu ma rtogs dogs bcas gdengs ma thob ba'i nad byi la 'jab pa lta

pairs.d4310: nyam chung ba la brtas byed pa rnga mo'i 'o ma blud par bya mcher pa'i dmu rdzing nad gzhi ni ji bzhin snum chos dugs bya ste zho dang 'bras chan bcas byin la
pairs.d4311: lus nyam chung na srog bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir rnga mo'i 'o ma blud do mcher pa'i nad dmu rdzing la ni nad gzhi ji lta bar snun chos dang dugs bya ste zho dang 'bras chan du bcas pa zos la lag pa g.yon pa la gtar gas khrag dbyung ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: pa sel de phyir rim pas nyam chung khrus rjes bsngags 'bras chan legs btsos tsha ba'i sman dang bskol yang zhing 'ju sla sha khu 'o bskol lci 'bras yos 'khru ba gcod dang rus chag sbyor srus thug nas thug rgyun 'gag me drod 'joms yos dral yang zhing 'jam dro pho bar 'phrod rtsam pa grang mo stobs

pairs.d4310: 'o ma ma he'i mar bskol ba'i skyu ru ra yi khu ba dang dur byid sbyar ba'i bkru sman blud 'khrus nas kha zas mngar bag ni rlung 'joms mkhris pa 'joms pa sbyin
pairs.d4311: de nas skyu ru ra'i khu ba dang dur byid dang sbyar bas bkru sman bya'o kha zas ni mngar ba dang rlung dang mkhris pa 'joms pa gtang ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: mig nad sel bar byed ru rta a ru ra yi khu ba yis rna ba'i rnag khrag zug gzer 'joms par byed skyer pa mkhan skya bsdus pa'i khu ba la dom mkhris btab btang sna khrag 'dzag pa gcod nag mtshur

pairs.d4310: da ba lo ma bdun pa dang seng ldeng thang shing bkru sman dang gla sgang dong grar bcas pa'am
pairs.d4311: yang na da ba dang lo ma bdun pa dang seng ldeng dang thang shing dang ku sman da ka dang gla sgang dang dong ga 'di rnams kyi lde gu 'am
pairs.rgyud_text: tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman dri zhim pa lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su grang

pairs.d4310: dong ga'i rtsa ba dag dang mar lan brgya'i bar bskol mar yang blud seng ldeng bskol ba'i chu bsten na mdze nad myur du sel bar byed
pairs.d4311: yang na dong ga'i rtsa ba mar dang lan brgya bskol ba'i mar blud cing seng ldeng gi chu bsten te 'thungs na mdze nad las myur du rgyal lo
pairs.rgyud_text: byas na nad kyi 'dam las myur du grol bar 'gyur zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gso thabs kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o le'u drug

pairs.d4310: 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling byi dang ga dang sbrang rtsi ni til mar mar sbyar lde gu'am ka ka u dum ba ra dang
pairs.d4311: yang na 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling dang byi dang ga dang 'di rnams sbrang rtsi dang til mar dang mar dang lde gur byas pa 'am yang na ka ko u dum ba ra dang byi dang ga dang nim pa dang gla sgang dang tsha ba gsum dang de rnams kyi phye ma briksha bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na pags pa'i nad thams cad 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal rma 'tsho zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod

pairs.d4310: khu bskol mar dang a ru ra sbrang rtsi ldan zos mdze nad 'joms seng ldeng nim pa sle tres dang pa to la dang byi tsher bskol
pairs.d4311: dug mo yungs dang tsi tra ka dang nim pa dang thang shing dang seng ldeng dang a sa na dang lo ma bdun pa dang 'di rnams bskol ba'i nang du mar dang a ru ra'i phye ma dang sbrang rtsi dang ldan par zos na mdze nad 'joms so seng ldeng dang nim pa dang sle tres dang pa to la'i rtsa ba dang byi tsher ba dang 'di rnams bskol ba ni seng ldeng la sogs pa sman gyi sbyor ba drug ces bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: skol dbul gzhan yang rtsa ba drug dang lo ma lnga me tog gcig dang 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi tsha gsum thal ba gnyis dang bu ram sbyar chu tshan 'phul bas grang nad ma lus sel mtha' 'khob yul gyi sngo sbyor man ngag 'di sems la long la byams pas 'gro don gyis zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sngo sbyor gyi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis

pairs.d4310: gla sgang dngul rdo dang ni skyer pa dang nag tshur kam bi lya dang ru rta dang seng phrom mu zi pog dkar byi dang ga ldong ros ba bla ka ra bi ra'i shun
pairs.d4311: yang na gla sgang dang skyer khanda skam po dang skyer pa dang nag tshur dang kam pi lya dang ru rta dang seng phrom dang mu zi dang sra rtsi pog dang byi dang ga dang ldong ros dang ba bla dang ka ra bi ra'i shun pa dang 'di rnams phye mar byas la sngar til mar gyis lus bskus pa'i steng du btab na
pairs.rgyud_text: rtsa sdom gsha' dkar sha 'u skyed ldong ros ba bla rmen ngan rul ba gcod rdo sol rdo rnams 'ju zhing rtsa kha sdom ba nu rdo rgyus mthing rgyus chu ba gso ti tsha ser po rma 'drub mig la phan mtshal gyis rma 'drub glo mchin rtsa tshad sel lig bu mig dang btsag yug rnam la sogs mig nad rus tshad sel zhing chu ser skem cong zhis 'khru gcod bad

pairs.d4310: shri pa sa da du ru ka li shi chu srin sen mo dang ru rta spang spos ka ko la pri yang ku dang sto ne ya rgya spos shu dag bya ma ka
pairs.d4311: bye'u rug pa dang bya khran kha zhes bya ba rgya mtsho nas byung ba'i chu srin sen mo dang zangs rtsi ba dang dzi ba ka dang rgya skyegs shing dang bo la dang gla rtsi dang na li ka zhes bya ba ka po ta tsa ra na dang dza ti bha dra dang 'bu su hang dang gur kum dang rdo dreg dang dza ti pha la dang kad pa la dang ba la dang shing tsha dang pog dkar po dang ga phur dang tu ruska dang shi ni ba sa ka dang li shi dang chu srin sen mo dang ka ko la dang ru rta dang spang spos dang pri yang ku dang sto ni ya dang rgya spos dang bya ma ka dang shu dag dang ma de na ga dang pla ba zhes bya ba ku tan na ta dang na ga ge sar dang 'di rnams srang re re btags la btab ste yang bskol la phyir phyung ste tshigs ma bor ba'i nang du gandha bha dra btags pa'i phye ma btab ste cho ga bzhin sbyar te byin na
pairs.rgyud_text: shu dag gnyis tsan dan dmar po rdo dreg spang spos dang shu ti til mar ka ra sbyar ba'i mar rtsa 'dzin shing rengs sra 'theng la sogs pa'i rlung nad lhag ma ma lus 'joms par byed smyo brjed skran dang rlig rlugs sel bar 'gyur gnas kyi sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni sha lpags la zhugs bsku mnye byug dugs bya tshil zhugs brla rengs phyug po'i rlung ltar gso rus dang rkang zhugs snum dugs bya ba dang snum bzhi bza' dang byug dang 'jam rtsi btang bcud la rlung zhugs da byid skyin gor sbyar rgyus pa tshigs dang rtsar zhugs snum dugs dkri chu ba 'khums la mon sran dre'u dang rgyam tshwa til mar sbyar te bskol ba byug khrag la rlung zhugs snum 'chos byas la gtar khrag zags rjes su tshor med gyur pa la dud pa rgyam tshwa til mar sbyar bas byug don babs snying rlung shing kun gsum thang btang 'bras bu'i mar dang sman chen sman mar sbyar glor zhugs star bu cu gang zi ra dkar po sug smel te bzhi pa'i phye ma dang a ru 'bri rkang sur phug sman

pairs.d4310: phyer btags sbrang rtsi mar dang ni lde gu byin na 'dus pa dang rims dang lus rengs tsha ba dang skom dad kyis gzer legs par 'khru
pairs.d4311: byid kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang mar sbyar ba'i lde gu bldags na 'dus pa dang rims dang lus rengs pa dang lus tsha ba dang skom dad kyis gzir ba legs par 'khru bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: sha rid tshil bu 'bru mar dang rtsi mar rul pa lo bshur la phug ras ri sgog la sogs rjen zas mtha' dag dang ma 'tshos 'tshig dang khengs po'i zas rnams dang ra yi 'o rlon zho dar chu grang ja bza' btung ches

pairs.d4310: khron bu'i phye ma chu dron sbyar dgun gyi dus su blud par bya dur byid kha ra cha mnyam pa
pairs.d4311: tri bi ta dang tsi tra ka dang pa tha dang zi ra dang sa ra la dang shu dag dang rtsa sman khron bu dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma chu dron dang sbyar ba dgun gyi dus su bkru sman bzang ngo dur byid dang kha ra cha mnyam pa ni so ga'i bkru sman bzang ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: bong nga gsum khyung sder rtsad yung ba btsan dug rnams kyi phye kha tshar btab mngar dang sbyar la ston zla tha chung btang zad ka'i dri chen dri chu bar pa gnyis 'khar gzhong nang du chos sman gsum sbyar la ras gtsang snod blug mkhan gseb zhag bdun bsrul grib lhags skams phye thun bdun chang gis 'phul dug rigs ma lus ma shi'i

pairs.d4310: sha ma dur byid byi tsher ba gla sgang hasti pi pi ling dug mo nyung dang ni li ni 'bras bu gsum dang pu tse shel
pairs.d4311: dur byid dang kyi lce dang spa ma'i 'bras bu dang pu tse shel dang khron bu dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma zhag gsum gyi bar du gcin gyi nang du sbangs shing snum chos byas pa'i mod la btang na dri ma thams cad 'byin par byed do sha ma dur byid dang byi tsher ba dang ha ti pi pi ling dang dug mo yungs dang ni li ni dang pu tse shel dang gla sgang dang 'bras bu gsum dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma sha khu dang mar dang chu dron gang yang rung ba las dus thams cad du btang na khong rtsub pa la rab tu bsngags so
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus ma zhu skyug pa sel bar byed dur thod sha ru spen ma'i thal ba gsum tsa bya a ru'i ril bus dmu rdzing skem dbyi mong sug smel sdig pa tsha ba gsum

pairs.d4310: myur du 'khru bar byed pa yin lci zhing rlung nad 'khru byed cing mkhris pa bad kan 'ju bar byed
pairs.d4311: dan ti'i rtsa ba glang po che'i so ltar brtan zhing sbom pa dang dra ban ti'i rtsa ba dmar la cung zad gnag par 'dug pa dang gnyis ni rno ba dang drod che la myur du 'khru bar byed pa yin pas rlung lci ba ni 'khru bar byed la mkhris pa dang bad kan ni 'ju bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: ldog la chu babs chung sbo 'khrog byed la myur du skye ba yin rgyu rdol rgyu smad mi bde smad nas skye 'dre chu sha sna 'gul zhing snying mi dga' gdong la chu bur 'ong zhing sna khrag 'dzag 'phar rtsa mi grung ldang dub 'dre kha rgod yang na shes pa bying la tshig pa za me long steng du bying bying thu lu 'dra dug las

pairs.d4310: bad kan mang dang srin nad dang mdze dang za khu'i nad rnams 'joms til mar ba gcin zho ga chu
pairs.d4311: mas gtong na mig nad dang srin nad dang mdze nad dang gcin nad rnams 'joms so til mar dang ba gcin dang zho ga chu dang rtsabs skyur po de rnams srang gnyis gnyis yungs kar btags pa'i phye ma dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsi byas na bud med la phod par 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: ma'i ro gsum bsten nas rnying skam sa'i sha dang sbrang rtsi dang chu sol sga thang btang zhing rtsub pa bsten rtsol bas bcag dang dril phyis bad kan bsal dri zhim skyed mos tshal gyi nyi grib 'dug so ga nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha bas stobs 'phrog phyir na mngar yang snum bsil bza' lan tshwa tsha skyur rtsol ba nyi 'od

pairs.d4310: e randa'i rtsa bskol ba yi khu ba shu dag pi pi ling po son cha yi phye mar bcas sbrang rtsi til mar rgyam tshar bcas
pairs.d4311: yang na e randa'i rtsa ba bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du shu dag dang pi pi ling dang po son cha gsum pa'i phye ma dang sbrang rtsi dang til mar dang rgyam tshwa ci ran tsam btab pa ni yug ti ra tha zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro

pairs.d4310: shin tu ro tsar byed pa yin rma bya'i gshog pa mkhris pa dang rgyu ma rkang pa mchu rtug pa por ba'i sha ni 'ba' zhig dang rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu ni srang re dang ni ldan gyur pa
pairs.d4311: shin tu bud med la nyal phod par 'gyur ro rma bya'i gshog pa dang mkhris pa dang rgyu ma dang rkang pa dang mchu dang rtug pa rnams bor ba'i sha 'ba' zhig dang rtsa ba chung ngu lnga srang re re dang sman gyi
pairs.rgyud_text: gzugs 'khums kha li rkang brtse dang rkang pa tsha ba zhes bya nyi shur bshad mdor bsdus rengs 'khums skams dang sbos pa dang 'phyes gzer 'phyos dang bog pa brgyad du bsdu gnas ni rang rgyud gnod bya la zhugs pa lpags gram shar rgyas rtsa ru rgyu ba dang rus la

pairs.d4310: dus shes pa yis bkru sman gtang bil ba'i rtsa ba dur byid dang thang shing nas dang rgya shug dang rgya sran chang dang ba gcin bcas
pairs.d4311: yang na rtug pa 'gags te zug gzer che ba la ni po son cha'i reng bu btang zhing dugs bya ba dang dus tshod shes par byas la bkru sman yang btang ste bil ba'i rtsa ba dang dur byid dang thang shing dang nas dang rgya shug dang rgya sran dang 'di rnams btags ba'i chang dang ba gcin dang lhan cig mas gtong na phyi sa 'gags pa sel par 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dzag lgang pa'i rdo skran chu bgag zug gzer che glo ba'i rtsa skran glo mang 'gogs pa dka' skad 'dzer sha lus sngo skam zos rjes skyug mkhal ma'i rtsa skran thog mar na zug chung smin nas ltar mngon sha skam dgye dgu dka' chu mdog dmar la lus lci chu 'thungs skyug mchin dri'i rtsa skran tshigs pa brgyad pa na dgye dgu mi bde sgreg cing skyug snyam byed mchin pa mchin dri'i sha zos skyug par 'gyur rtsa

pairs.d4310: sa la parni shu dag dang bri ha ti gnyis ram nye ba pi pi ling dang rgya spos dang lcang ma utpal ba spru ba ga bra'i rtsa ba gla sgang rnams
pairs.d4311: sti ra dang shu dag dang bri ha ti rnam gnyis dang bu tshang rdo dang pi pi ling dang rgya spos dang lcang ma dang utpa la dang ba spru ba dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang gla sgang dang de rnams zho gnyis dang mar srang bcu drug dang lhan cig bskol te bsgrubs pa las ran par blud na rgyu srang dag par byed pa'i mchog yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: shu dag gnyis tsan dan dmar po rdo dreg spang spos dang shu ti til mar ka ra sbyar ba'i mar rtsa 'dzin shing rengs sra 'theng la sogs pa'i rlung nad lhag ma ma lus 'joms par byed smyo brjed skran dang rlig rlugs sel bar 'gyur gnas kyi sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni sha lpags la zhugs bsku mnye byug dugs bya tshil zhugs brla rengs phyug po'i rlung ltar gso rus dang rkang zhugs

pairs.d4310: shring gi ma du lung ga dang ga bra'i rtsa ba pi pi ling thang shing a shwa gandha dang ra mnye ba gnyis ra sna dang zangs rtsi ba dang dzi ba ka
pairs.d4311: chu nas skyes pa'i shing mngar dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang pi pi ling dang thang shing dang a shwa gan dha dang ram nye ba rnam gnyis dang ra sna dang zangs rtsi ba dang dzi ba ka dang 'dam pa gnyis dang byi dang ga dang de rnams cham chom brdungs te mar dang ri bong gi mgo bo bskol ba'i khu ba dang tshul bzhin bskol te mar lus pa las ran par 'thungs na
pairs.rgyud_text: bu rnam pa bzhi tsha gsum thal ba gnyis dang bu ram sbyar chu tshan 'phul bas grang nad ma lus sel mtha' 'khob yul gyi sngo sbyor man ngag 'di sems la long la byams pas 'gro don gyis zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sngo sbyor gyi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang

pairs.d4310: ngu zhing gdong ni 'jigs rung ston zas ma zos kyang stobs dang ldan gnyid med mtshan mo rgyu ba dang ngo tsha gtsang sbra med cing dpa'
pairs.d4311: gdong 'jigs su rung ba ston pa dang kha zas ma zos kyang stobs dang ldan pa dang gnyid med pa dang mtshan mo rgyu ba dang ngo tsha mi shes pa dang gtsang sbra med pa dang dpa' ba dang ma rungs pa'i las byed pa dang tshig rtsub po smra ba dang khro ba dang khrag dang phreng ba dmar po dang bud med dang sha dang chang la dga' ba dang khrag gam sha mthong na rkan gtog cing mchu bldag pa dang kha zas za ba'i dus su dgod pa dang 'di dag ni srin po'i gdon gyi mtshan ma'o
pairs.rgyud_text: lhan cig chang 'thung des 'drud dang gos dang phreng ba dmar pos brgyan pa yi gshin po dag dang lhan cig gar byed pa de dag 'chi bdag dbang du song ba'i ltas de la sogs te rmi lam mi bzang ba yid 'jug bu ga nad kyis bkag phyir mthong rgyun du rmi ba'i nad pa 'chi 'gyur te nad med ma nges rim gros thar bar 'gyur mthong thos myong dang gsol ba btab pa dang grub pa nad las byung dang rnam pa drug mtshan stod rmi lam brjed ngas 'bras bu med tho rangs mthong dang gsal na 'bras bu 'byin lha dang khyu mchog skyes bu

pairs.d4310: 'dab mar bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin seng phrom lo ma dkar po dang rgya sbos na ga ge sar dang nyungs kar chu grang la btags pas snar blugs mig tu bskus pa'ang phan
pairs.d4311: zas mchog ces bya ba'i 'o thug dang sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma dang sa nag po dang na ga ge sar dang shu dag dang padma dang gu gul dang pu shel tsi dang utpa la dmar po'i 'dab ma dang ldan pa'i gtor ma sbyin no seng phrom dkar po'i lo ma dang rgya spos dang na ga ge sar dang yungs kar dang 'di rnams chu grang mo dang btags te snar blugs pa dang mig la bskus na klu'i gdon las thar ro
pairs.rgyud_text: sel na ga pushpa na ga ge sar dang padma ge sar glo mchin snying tshad sel zi ra dkar pos glo yi tshad pa sel zi ra nag pos mchin pa'i grang ba sel la la phud kyis pho nad grang ba sel so ma ra dzas lpags nad chu ser sel thal ka rdo rje dag kyang de bzhin no gser gyi me tog snod tshad mkhris tshad sel gser gyi phud bus mkhris pa gyen du 'dren dug mo nyung gis mkhris sel tsha 'khru gcod rgun 'brum glo nad sel zhing

pairs.d4310: pa tra e la thang shing dang e la ba lu ka dang ni thal tres rnam gnyis ser po gnyis sthi ra rnam gnyis pri yang ku
pairs.d4311: 'bras bu gsum dang bi sha la dang ha re nu ka dang thang shing dang e la ba lu ka dang thal tres rnam gnyis dang ser po rnam gnyis dang sthi ra rnam gnyis dang pri yang ku dang rgya spos dang bri ha ti dang ru rta dang btsod dang dong ga dang na ga ge sar dang se'u 'bru dang byi dang ga dang bal bu'i lo ma dang sna ma'i me tog kha ma phye ba dang utpa la dang dan ti dang shug pa dang tsandan dkar po dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis dang btags te
pairs.rgyud_text: dud khu skyug dus se 'bru dang btsod dang 'u su sug smel pi pi ling bse yab shing mngar dom mkhris sbrang sbyar btang dpyad du gtar ga bshal dang me btsa' dugs gang dgos nad kyi skabs dang sbyar te bcos de nas bye brag bcos thabs rnam gsum ste gnas dang dus dang rigs dang sbyar te bcos dang po gnas dang sbyar te bcos pa ni pho bar gnas tshe bad kan gtso bor bcos dang po ma nu bzhi thang gtong ba bsngags spyi sman se 'bru bzhi dang ltag pa sprod yang na se 'bru bzhi dang gur kum dang ma nu 'u su star

pairs.d4310: sha za chen po'i mar zhes bya des ni nyin bzhi pa'i rims dang smyo byed brjed byed gdon 'joms shing
pairs.d4311: na ku la rnam gnyis dang ka tam bha ra dang bi shtsi ka li dang sa la parni dang 'di rnams cha snyoms te mar dang tshul bzhin bskol ba ni sha za chen po'i mar zhes bya ste de las ran par 'thungs na nyin bzhi pa'i rims dang smyo byed kyi gdon dang
pairs.rgyud_text: sems la gnas pa smyo byed brjed byed gnyis lus la gnas pa stod smad phyi nang bzhi phyi nang kun khyab nad dang rnam pa lnga lus stod dbang po mgo la gnas pa ni mgo mig rna ba sna dang mchu so lce rkan dang lba ba gre ba nam tshong nad gre bar gnas pa nad dang gag pa dang mgul

pairs.d4310: a pa marga lo ma bdun ni li ni dang pu tse shel dong ga pushkar mu la dang phal gu'i rtsa ba byi tsher srang
pairs.d4311: rtsa ba rnam pa lnga pa gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum dang ser po rnam gnyis dang dugs mo yungs kyi shun phrags dang lo ma bdun pa dang a pa marga dang ni li ni dang pu tse shel dang dong ga dang ma nu dang shing phal gu'i rtsa ba dang byi tsher ba dang sman de rnams chu srang gnyis gnyis chu srang brgyad la chu phul gang du brtsis pa'i chu phul drug cu rtsa bzhi dang bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus ma zhu

pairs.d4310: ba spu'i bu ga gtsags pa'am srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung ngo yang na 'o ma'am bu ram shing khu bas slon bya mngar bsil sman
pairs.d4311: yang na srin bu pad pas khrag dbyung ba phan no yang na rdzi ma'i nad la 'o ma dang bu ram shing gi khu ba dang sbyar ba'i mar gyis slon bya ba dang mngar
pairs.rgyud_text: phyi bsrung tsha grang sbyar ba'i mar gyis byug nus pa skyed pa ril bu chang gis dbul sha chang ltor bsten skabs su ba spur dbyung bsten thabs ma shes sbyor ba dug tu 'gyur snod ngan seng ge'i 'o ma bzhos dang

pairs.d4310: bya rgod dus su shi ba'i mgo bo ni nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog 'dra gang yin de ba lang lci bas bsregs thal lig bu mig cha mnyam btags par gyur pa'i phye ma yi
pairs.d4311: bya rgod legs par shi ba'i mgo bo nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ba ba lang gi lci bas bsregs pa'i thal ba dang lig bu mig cha snyoms te bsregs pa'i phye ma 'di ni bya rgod kyi mgo bo'i phye ma zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: par pa ta bskol grang thang btang pri yangku bsregs pa'i thal ba zhun mar sbyar te btang bar bya cu gang gur kum dom mkhris ba sha ka zab thal 'gron thal sran ma'i me tog sbyar tsan dan dmar po ra khrag pu shel rtse stang zil 'bras yos phye dang ka ra sbyar

pairs.d4310: na le sham ni rdog ma bcu drub mar cang ni srang phyed dang spangs ma srang gcig shing mngar ni zho gnyis 'o ma'i nang du sbangs
pairs.d4311: yang na na le sham rdog ma bcu dang drub mar cang zho gcig dang spangs ma srang gcig dang shing mngar zho gnyis dang de rnams 'o ma'i nang du sbangs shing brlan par bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i

pairs.d4310: de 'og 'bras bu gsum dang ni rtsa ba lnga'i khu 'o ma dang e randa yi til mar bcas
pairs.d4311: de'i 'og tu 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du 'o ma dang e randa'i mar dang bsres te bkru sman du sbyar ro
pairs.rgyud_text: skyes tshad mthong tshad sman du sbyar thabs zhu 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa las ston pas gsungs pa kye ma legs so drang srong yid las skyes khyod kyis zhus

pairs.d4310: ba la gsum dang dzi ban ti nye'u shing rtsa ba srang re dang shing mngar srang ni bzhi dang bcas lcags kyi snod du bskol bar bya
pairs.d4311: yang na dzi ban ti'i rtsa ba dang yal ga dang bcas pa srang brgya chu srang lnga brgya rtsa bcu gnyis dang bskol te brgyad cha lus pa'i nang du til mar dang 'o ma srang sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis dang ba la rnam gsum dang dzi ban ti dang nye'u shing gnyis kyi rtsa ba srang re re dang shing mngar srang bzhi dang de rnams lcags snod kyi nang du bskol te lcags snod de nyid kyi nang du zla ba gcig gi bar du bzhag la
pairs.rgyud_text: lgang par gnas srin skran pho long gnyis kyi nang du 'byung chu skran nges med gar yang 'byung srid de glo snying mchin pa rgyu long bar du mang rnag gi skran la gar 'ong nges pa med mdor bsdus phyi skran nang skran bar skran gsum phyi skran snod kyi phyi dang sha lpags bar bar skran snod kyi nang ldebs don gyi logs nang skran don snod kun gyi gting na gnas gyur tshul kha zas gyong tshil sbang ma sogs ma zhu rang sor gnas pas be snabs 'dril snyigs ma ma zhu zas kyi

pairs.d4310: shing mngar bcas pa'i phye mar byas mig bskus 'dus pa las gyur pa'i rab rib sel bar byed mchog yin
pairs.d4311: de'i 'og tu phyung la bskams te me tog lug ru ba dang shing mngar rnams phye mar byas te mig tu bskus na 'dus pa las gyur pa'i rab rib sel ba'i mchog yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis

pairs.d4310: ma he'i mchin pa mcher pa dang til mar mar ni lhan cig bza' 'tsho byed sna bcu lo ma ni mar dang lhan cig bskol ba bza' a ti mug ta e randa nye'u shing lang ga li'i lo ma
pairs.d4311: mtshan mo mi mthong ba'i nad pas bza' ba ni ma he'i mchin pa dang mcher pa til mar dang lhan cig bza'o yang na 'tsho byed sde bcu'i 'o ma mar dang lhan cig sbrus te bza'o de bzhin du a ti mug ta dang e randa dang lang ga li dang shu ti dang de rnams kyi
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed

pairs.d4310: mig tu bzhag na mig nad sna tshogs sel skyer pa srang gcig chu bre phyed du yang khu ba brgyad cha lus par sbrang rtsi btab de bzhin mig tu bskus par gyur na ni nad gzhi thams cad 'khrugs pa'i mig nad sel shi kru'i lo ma'i khu ba sbrang rtsir bcas mig tu blugs na rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan 'dus pa las gyur mig nad rnams
pairs.d4311: phur ma'i thum po de yang de'i nang du bcug pa des mig tu bdugs na mig nad kyi rnam grangs sna tshogs sel to skyer pa srang gcig chu srang bcu drug gi nang du bskol te brgyad cha lus pa'i nang du sbrang rtsi btab pa mig tu blugs na nad gzhi thams cad las gyur pa'i mig nad sel to shi kru'i lo ma rang gi khu ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba mig tu blugs na rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan la sogs pa nad kyi rnam grangs mang po las kyang rgyal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: reg mi tshor ma nges 'chi ltas nad tshul mang po las 'chi ba'i ltas rnams snang bar gyur na yang nad zhi bas ni 'chi ltas zhi 'gyur ro zhi yang ltas brtan gnas na nges par 'chi phyi nang srog zungs sha zas rtsa dang gsum shor ba'i nad pa gang yin 'chi bar nges nad la cho ga sna tshogs bsgrubs byas kyang bcos skyed med pa 'chi bar nges pa yin de ltar phung po 'jig pa'i 'chi ltas rnams nad dang lus zungs dri ma 'khrugs gyur nas gcig gshed gcig gis byas te srog 'dor phyir 'byung 'gyur dus kyi ri rab 'jig dang

pairs.d4310: kha skam sbrid pa drag tu 'byung sna 'gags zug cing na ba dang mur 'gram so dang klad pa dang smin ma nas ni sna rtse'i bar
pairs.d4311: de la rlung las gyur pa'i sna nad cham pa'i mtshan ma ni gdong skem pa dang sbrid pa drag tu 'byung ba dang sna subs shing na ba dang so dang mur 'gram dang klad pa na ba dang smin ma'i steng du grog ma rgyu ba snyam byed pa dang skad zhen pa dang myur du ma smin pa dang sna nad mchil ma dang snabs bsil bar 'dzag pa yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong rngam pa bde sna rdog mnyen zhing chu mdog

pairs.d4310: rtsa bcu'i khu ba dro 'jam mam chang snying dngas ma blud par bya tsa rong agni mantha dang shu dag zi ra go snyod snom
pairs.d4311: rtsa ba bcu pa bskol ba'i khu ba dro 'jam tsam mam chang rnying pa btung bar blud do tsa rong dang agni mantha dang shu dag dang zi ra dang zi ra nag po dang de rnams kyi phye ma dang snum sbyar bar bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar til mar

pairs.d4310: phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu pa'o de nas kha nad kyi dmigs shes pa bshad par bya'o nya dang ma he phag gi ni sha dang la phug rjen pa dang
pairs.d4311: sna nad gso ba'i le'u ste nyi shu pa rdzogs so de nas kha nad kyi dmigs brtag pa'i le'u bshad par bya ste nya dang ma he dang phag dang de rnams kyi sha zos pa dang la phug rjen pa zos pa dang mon sran sde'u'i tshod ma dang zho dang
pairs.rgyud_text: man ngag gi rgyud las 'or nad gso ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig gcong chen dmu chu'i rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang gyur tshul gnas dang rtags dang bcos thabs dang phyi rjes bcad dang spyi don brgyad kyis

pairs.d4310: e randa'i mar sna sman gtang so brtse de bzhin bye ba la rlung 'joms gso ba thams cad bya til dang shing mngar sbrang rtsi ni 'o mar bskol ba'i mkhur bkang bcang so 'gul ba la rtsa ba bcu'i khu ba mar bskol mkhur ba bkang sbangs ma seng phrom pi pi ling 'bras bu gsum dang rma shing dang
pairs.d4311: e randa'i mar sna sman du sbyar ro so brtse ba dang so bye ba'i nad la ni rlung 'joms pa'i gso ba thams cad bya'o yang na til mar dang shing mngar dang sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma rnams bskol te mkhur bar bcang ngo so 'gul ba'i nad la ni rtsa ba bcu pa mar dang bskol te mkhur bar bcangs na phan no yang na spangs ma dang seng phrom dang pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum dang shing mngar dang lan tshwa dang de rnams bdar ba'i khu ba sman du sbyar ro
pairs.rgyud_text: rnon pos bdug lce la zhugs na tsha ba'i mkhur bkang bcang bye brag nang tshegs bad kan rten byed la spyang tsher skyugs bya se 'bru lnga pa'am cong zhi drug sbyar tshigs pa brgyad pa bsreg myag byed se 'bru rgyam tshwa'i tres sam sbyar bcu gsum dgu pa pho gsang gang rigs bsreg myong byed nad la 'bras bu gsum thang btang star bu sge gsher shing mngar 'bras bu gsum sbrang dang sbyar btang ske stong dang po bsreg tshim byed skyugs bya sna sman bzhi pa btang mtshog ma'i gsang dbye 'dus so gsum du bsreg 'byor byed a ru'i gla

pairs.d4310: bya lcang ma gi ri karni dang gla sgang thang shing bca' sga dang shu dag dan da mur ba yi
pairs.d4311: skyer pa dang tsi tra ka dang skyer khanda dang pa tha dang te dzo pa ti dang nis pa pa dang de rnams tshwa dang ba gcin dang sbyar ba'i ri lur byas pa dang phye mar byas nas gdab pa dang mkhur bar dgang ba la sogs pa ci rigs par bya'o lcang ma dang ge ri karni ka dang gla sgang dang thang shing dang bca' sga dang shu dag dang dan ti dang mur ba dang de rnams lhan cig sbyar ba'i lde gu dro 'jam tsam bskus na na zhing skrangs pa sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: nad stong la phan se 'bru 'u su sga dang tsi tra ka pi pi ling dang 'bri mar rlung rnams 'joms me drod skyed cing skem po rgyas par byed sgog skya bur mar sbyar ba nas gseb mnan rlung nad ma lus 'joms pa'i sman mchog yin dza ti kha ru tshwa dang shing kun dang a ru ra dang 'bri mar rlung rnams 'joms de bzhin btsan dug rus chen 'bras bu gsum rtsa ba lnga yi sman mar sbyar bar bya dpyad du mar rnying drod kyi 'jam rtsi btang a ru ra dang sgog skya rgyam tshwa dang zhun mar sbyar ba'i

pairs.d4310: tsandan rnam gnyis seng phrom stag tsher ba shing mngar rgya skyegs a dza ri rnam gnyis da ta ki dang katpa la'i 'bras bu ser po rnam gnyis 'bras bu gsum dang ni dri sna bzhi dang gla sgang a ru ra
pairs.d4311: bzhi cha lus pa dang tshigs ma bor la dngas ma yang bskol la skan ter song ste bsgongs pa'i nang du dbyi mo dang ba la ka dang rma shing dang btsag dang tsandan rnam gnyis dang seng phrom dang pra punda ri ka dang shing mngar dang rgya skyegs dang an dza na rnam gnyis dang da ta ki dang kad pa la'i 'bras bu dang ser po rnam gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum dang dri sna bzhi dang a ga ru dang gla sgang dang btso dang nya gro dha'i myu gu dang spang spos dang byi tsher ba dang shug pa dang o la ba lu ka dang btsod dang de rnams zho gnyis gnyis zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma dang dza ti bha dra dang
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung gla sgang bong nga dkar po ba le ka re skon ka ra sbyar ba'i mkhris phye bdun rgyu long bsnad 'grams khrag mkhris tsha 'khru gcod cong zhi se 'bru sug smel pi pi ling ma nu gur kum ka ra cong zhi drug bad kan brang tsha chu tshan skyug

pairs.d4310: dha du ra yi shun pa yi sa bon padma ge sar dang spra tshil spangs ma shug pa sogs zhag dang 'o ma rkang dang mar 'o ma can shing 'o ma ni bskol ba'i mar ni bskus gyur na ngo shig gnyer ma sogs 'joms shing
pairs.d4311: btsod dang sha ba ri'i seng phrom dang tu ba ri dang rgya skyegs dang ser po rnam gnyis dang ldong ros dang gur gum dang ru rta dang gi wang dang nya gro dha dkar po'i lo ma dang tsandan rnam gnyis dang ka li ya ka dang dngul chu dang rma shing dang lang tang tse'i shun pa dang padma'i sa bon dang padma ge sar dang spra tshil dang spangs ma dang shug pa dang de rnams dang zhag dang rkang dang mar dang 'o ma dang shing 'o ma can gyi 'o ma dang de rnams bskol ba'i mar gyis bskus na ngo shig dang gnyer ma la sogs pa 'joms te gdong gi bzhin mdongs zla ba bzhin du rgyas par 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung gla sgang bong nga dkar po ba le ka re skon ka ra sbyar ba'i mkhris phye bdun rgyu long bsnad 'grams khrag mkhris tsha 'khru gcod cong zhi se 'bru sug smel pi pi ling ma nu gur kum ka ra cong zhi drug bad kan brang tsha

pairs.d4310: gnod pa'i dug ni sel ba'i sman pi pi ling dang bya ma ka spang spos seng phrom sug smel dang ku tan na ta sardzi ka ru rta shing mngar tsandan dang yug snam btsag dang sbyar ba'i sman
pairs.d4311: de yang pi pi ling dang bya ma ka dang spang spos dang seng phrom dang sug smel dang swardzi ka dang ku tan na ta dang ru rta dang shing mngar dang tsandan dang btsag yug snam dang de rnams ni dug 'joms pa'i sman zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: nang dag tu dza ti gur kum gla rtsi spang spos dang spang rgyan sbyar te lus kun bkrus rjes byug yang na gla rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang sdig srin mu zi ra khrag bse mar khur yang na ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dang gla rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra khrag byug

pairs.d4310: 'brum bu rims dang lus lci sel tang pal nya gro dha'i myu gu dzi ba ka dang zangs rtsi ba ka ra dkar po shing mngar btsod
pairs.d4311: de bzhin du skrang ba dang shu ba mched pa dang 'brum bu dang rims dang lus tsha ba rnams la phan no tang pal dang nya gro dha'i myu gu dang dzi ba ka dang zangs rtsi ba dang kha ra dkar po dang btsod dang shing mngar dang de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba blud na sbrul 'khyil bas zin pa 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang skrangs na skyugs btang dmar tsha gtar ga gdab brla rengs ma zhu bad tshil skyes

pairs.d4310: zhal zhal byas la shir sha dang yung ba rgya spos gur gum dang sle tres kyi ni lde gus bsku
pairs.d4311: yang mtshon gyis zhal zhal byas la de'i 'og tu shri sha dang yung ba dang rgya spos dang gur gum dang sle tres dang de rnams kyis byug par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: stag sha ha bo dang yung ba gang ga chung dang re ral dang 'om bu spang rgyan spang rtsi do bo dang se rgod skyer pa'i bar shun dug sman sde cu gang shing mngar rgun 'brum star

pairs.d4310: btung dang bsku ba la sbyar na byi ba'i dug kun sel bar byed ka pid ta yi snying po dang til ka dang til dang ni am ko la yi rtsa ba ni
pairs.d4311: angko la'i rtsa ba btags par thug gi gcin dang sbyar ba'i 'dag gus bsku ba dang btung bar sbyar na ni byi ba'i dug thams cad 'joms so ka pid ta'i snying po dang shing ti la ka dang til dang ma ko la'i rtsa ba rnams kyi phye ma ba gcin dang sbyar ba blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: bong nga gsum khyung sder rtsad yung ba btsan dug rnams kyi phye kha tshar btab mngar dang sbyar la ston zla tha chung btang zad ka'i dri chen dri chu bar pa gnyis 'khar gzhong nang du chos sman gsum sbyar la ras gtsang snod blug mkhan gseb zhag bdun bsrul grib lhags skams phye thun bdun chang gis 'phul dug rigs ma lus ma

pairs.d4310: skyon med a ru ra dang skyu ru ra stong dang pi pi ling ni stong dang bcas rgya skyegs shing gzhon thal ba'i chu sbyar ba
pairs.d4311: a ru ra dang skyu ru ra rdog ma stong dang pi pi ling 'bru stong dang rgya skyegs shing gzhon nu'i thal ba chu dang sbyar te btsags pa'i khu ba snod kyi nang du bcug ste
pairs.rgyud_text: smag dang tha rams na rams rgya skyegs shing gtsod khrag bya rkang 'khru gcod sman sde yin rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa gser gyi bye ma dang sdig srin sug smel nyi dga' chu sman sde son cha ri sho spyang tsher shu dag dang gser

pairs.d4310: chu 'am 'o ma sha khu 'thungs gyur na dran dang yid gzhungs blo gros stobs dang ldan snying stobs dang ldan gser gyi mdog dang 'dra
pairs.d4311: de'i 'og tu chu 'am 'o ma dang sha khu tshim tshad du blud la dran pa dang yid gzhungs pa dang blo gros dang stobs dang ldan pa dang snying stobs dang ldan pa dang gser gyi ri bo 'dra bar mdog dkar ser du 'gyur zhing tshe ring ba dang 'tsho ba yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: drod bsrung bar gnas gyur na lus kyi stobs dang tshe ni gnas par gyur me drod de yis kha zas 'ju tshul ni zas skom srog gi rlung gis lto bar bcug skom gyis bshig cing snum gyis mnyen par byed me mnyam rlung gis mkhris pa 'ju byed bus pho ba'i gnas su sman ltar bskol bar byed dang por ro drug zas skom gang zos pa

pairs.d4310: bshad pas nad rnams zhi bar nus pa yin de ni yul dang dus kyi stobs las ni ci rigs par ni brtags te sbyar bar bya
pairs.d4311: gyi mchog bsdus pa yin te nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa yin no de yang yul dang dus dang nad kyi stobs ji lta ba bzhin du brtags te sbyar bar bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: dang sbyang dang byug sogs ci rigs sbyar bar bya rgya spos ru rta sug smel shu dag gnyis tsan dan dmar po rdo dreg spang spos dang shu ti til mar ka ra sbyar ba'i mar rtsa 'dzin shing rengs sra

pairs.d4310: tsha ches lan tshwa mang ba spang phrum dang zho dang phrum skam dang ba tsha tsha dang la phug rjen phag rgod lug dang ba glang nya
pairs.d4311: kha zas kyi nang na rtswa dang skra dang sbu la sogs pa dang zos pa'i lhag ma dang zhag lon pa'i khongs su bsros pa dang tshod ma'i bag dang ha cang tsha ches pa dang lan tshwa ches pa dang phrum dang zho phrum dang ro ma dang ba tsha dang tshwa dang la phug rjen pa dang phag rgod dang lug dang ba lang dang nya dang ma he dang 'di rnams kyi sha rid dam
pairs.rgyud_text: sbyar rgyu long gsang la bsreg kha zas lug dang ba lang ri dwags sha ma rul gsar pa'i tsho khu bongs chung btang gsar 'jam gla ba rgya skyegs shing thal sbyar cong zhi'i phyes bran kha skom bag re bsten 'khru ba ma chod bar du zas spyod gzab ces gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyu gzer gyi rims bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o de nas drang srong rig

pairs.d4310: rlung dang bad kan tshil ches dang cham pa skran dang rims dang gzer gzhang 'brum gyi ni nad rnams sel
pairs.d4311: pi pi ling dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba la rtse lag dang dbyi mo'i lo ma dang tsitra ka dang li dong gra 'di lnga dang sman de rnams ni rlung dang bad kan dang tshil ches pa dang cham pa dang skran dang rims na ba dang gzhang 'brum gyi nad dang 'di rnams sel bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: bu sel bad kan lto sbos dbugs mi bde ba dang cham pa rims gsar 'phral du zlog par byed bskol grang bad kan mi skyed mkhris pa sel zhag gcig lon nas dug 'dra nyes kun skyed chang ni mngar skyur kha la zhu rjes skyur rno dro rtsub phra cung zad thur du 'khru drod 'bar spobs skyed gnyid 'phel bad rlung sel thal drags sems bsgyur

pairs.d4310: mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o de nas sman gyi thigs pa mig tu blugs pa dang sman gyis mig bsku ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: sman gyi khu bas mkhur ba dgang ba'i dpyad la sogs pa bshad pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa rdzogs so sman gyi thigs pas mig tu blugs pa dang sman gyis mig bsku ba'i cho ga bshad pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bshad par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dab cig rus bcud gsum gyi khu bas bal tshi btsir tsha la gla rtsis dug 'don rdo dreg gis ngar btags rlung dus btang bar bya yang na bal tshir dza ti ka ko la rus khu sbyar btang ma mchu'i dkyil du bsreg grang bas smyo na bur dkar chang sbyar btang ma non bcud

pairs.d4310: de nas mig brta ba'i cho ga dang mig sman gyi phur ma bsregs shing btsos pa'i khu ba mig tu blugs pa'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: sman gyi thigs pa mig tu blugs pa dang sman gyis mig bsku ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste nyi shu gsum pa rdzogs so mig brta ba'i cho ga zhun mar mig tu blugs pa dang sman gyi phur ma bsregs shing bcos pa'i khu ba'i thigs pa mig tu blugs pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bshad par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: ra sha mar du btsos pa'i khu ba de pi pi ling ngam sga 'am se 'bru 'am nas thug dang sbyar gnod pa drug sel byed mkhris gyur chang blud 'u su sga thang btang shing mngar dug nyung bya kri rgun 'brum dang ma nu zur pa usgranal byi tsher ba gze ma pa la go snyod pi pi ling kyi lce'i sman mar gcong nad sel

pairs.d4310: cha spyad gdung srub dgang dang rgyun srang dag bya dang thal sman gdab dang mtshon dbyung bcing dang bcer ba dang gzhib dang smad dang stod dang bskyod dang bcag pa dang bzlog dang drang por bya ba tsha spyad las rnams yin
pairs.d4311: cha byad kyi las kyang brdung ba dang bsrub pa dang dgang ba dang rgyun srad dag par bya ba dang thal sman la sogs pa gdab pa dang mtshon dbyung ba dang bcing ba dang btsir ba dang gzhib pa dang smad pa dang bstod pa dang rma btsal ba dang drang por bya ba dang de dag gi gong du bstan pa'i cha byad kyi las mdor bsdus pa yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: ltar shugs ni bkag dang btsir ba yis nad kun 'byung 'gyur 'phral du rlung 'khrug pas de phyir de yi zas dang sman skom sbyar nad gang smyung dang zhi bas bzhu byas kyang ro ma ldang 'gyur legs sbyangs slar mi 'byung de phyir dgun bsags grang nad dpyid dus sbyang sos bsags dbyar sbyang dbyar bsags ston dus sbyang legs par sbyangs pas ro thon nad med 'gyur rtag tu phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam rnams nyams

pairs.d4310: ras kyis dam du bcings nas ni chu ba tshigs rus gnad rnams ni dor te zhal zhal gdab bar bya
pairs.d4311: zhal zhal bya ba'i thabs ni zhal zhal gang bya ba'i gong du srad bu 'am dar ram ras kyis dam par mnyam por bcings la chu ba dang tshigs rus pa dang gnad rnams ni dbab par zhal zhal gdab po
pairs.rgyud_text: 'dra bas skrangs la zhal zhal bya sor brgyad zor ba'i dbyibs kyis lce skrangs gshag gtsags 'dra brang ba can gyis mgo rma 'dra dbug pa'i thur dpyad srid sor drug pa la mgo 'og lus shong thur zhabs ldig par bya sbubs thur sbal mgo glo dkar yod

pairs.d4310: mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o de nas thal sman rnon po dang me btsa' gdab pa'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o
pairs.d4311: thor bu la sogs pa skrangs pa dang rnags pa dang smin pa las gtar ga gdab pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa rdzogs so nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal sman rnon por byug pa dang me btsa' gdab pa'i cho ga'i le'u sum cu pa bshad par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: log gnon rtsa sbyongs kyi le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig dpyad lnga'i mchog gyur gtar ga'i brdeg thabs la cha byad brtag pa thabs dang skyon yon lnga dang po cha byad rno mnyen ldan pa'i lcags

pairs.d4310: rgya cher kun tu bstan pa yin yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las mdo'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu tham pa'o yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las gnas drug pa ste tha ma rdzogs so
pairs.rgyud_text: spyi ru sdoms pas nyi shu tham pa'o phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad rigs la mkhris pa smug po dmu 'or skya rbab gcong tsha ba sde drug 'grams 'khrugs rims nad dang 'brum bu lhog pa sbyar dug rdzi zer dug rlangs dug sha dug mi 'phrod pa yi dug btsan dug khyi dug srin bu

pairs.d4310: rgya cher kun tu bstan pa yin yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las mdo'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu tham pa'o yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las mdo'i gnas zhes bya ba le'u sum cu pa rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i gnas dang po'o
pairs.rgyud_text: spyi ru sdoms pas nyi shu tham pa'o phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad rigs la mkhris pa smug po dmu 'or skya rbab gcong tsha ba sde drug 'grams 'khrugs rims nad dang 'brum bu lhog pa sbyar dug rdzi zer dug rlangs dug sha dug mi 'phrod pa yi dug btsan dug khyi dug srin

pairs.d4310: de ni snyim gang blud par bya yang na go ra danda dang a pa marga dzi ba ka zangs rtsi ba dang sherya ka
pairs.d4311: de la gser ram dngul lam lcags nag po gang yang rung ba la skyes bu'i gzugs chung ngu byas te me'i nang du bsregs la dmar por gyur pa dang 'o ma'i nang du smyugs la khyor gang blud do yang na go ra da na da dang a pa marga dang dzi ba ga dang zangs rtsi ba dang shri sha dang 'di rnams la gnyis sam gsum mam mang du 'tshogs kyang rung ste
pairs.rgyud_text: ngam rus bcud gsum mam bur zho gang rung ba khyor gang srod la btang pa'i de nub tu gnyid che zug chung bla 'chol nyung ba dang nang par lce rlon shes pa gsal na nges rngam rgod 'dar 'bog smra 'chal 'bros pa na 'phral du mthil bzhi tshigs pa bsku mnye bya tshil bu bu ram phye gsur du bas bdug gong bzhin sna lon mtshams su phebs par nges nges pa rnyed na bsil sha gsar pa yi tsho khu me

pairs.d4310: gos dmar gyon dang g.yang sa dang khron lta sha za chang 'thungs dang gan rkyal nyal dang bud med dang
pairs.d4311: ba 'byung ba dang 'dod pa dgag pa dang smyung bar 'dug pa dang lam du 'gro ba dang shin tu tsha ba'i zas dang dro ba dang lci ba dang phyi sa 'gags par 'gyur ba'i zas dang gos dmar po dang g.yang sa dang khron par lta ba dang sha dang chang cher 'thungs pa dang gan rkyal du nyal ba dang gang yang bud med mkhas pas mi 'dod pa thams cad spang bar bya ste
