pairs.rgyud_text: las las lnga'i sngon du 'gro ba snum 'chos kyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig las lnga'i mchog gyur bshal la brtag pa dang btang thabs skyon yon rnam pa bzhi yis bstan dang po rung dang mi rung nad gzhi brtag ran dang mi ran dus tshod brtag pa dang thub dang mi thub lus shed brtag par bya rung ba rims 'khrugs tsha

pairs.d4310: smad du lci zhing yi ga 'chus mchil ma mang zhing gcin mang 'byung brla dang rked pa lto dang rgyab snying dang chu so brla rtsa na
pairs.d4311: de la bu byung ba nye ba'i snga rtags ni lus dub pa dang dku dang mig gnyis 'gul bar snang ba dang ro smad lci ba dang zas yi gar mi 'ong ba dang mchil ma mang ba dang gcin mang ba dang brla dang rked pa dang rgyab dang snying dang chu so dang brla brag dang 'di dag tu na ba dang mo mtshan rgya chen por gyur cing rgyun du na ba dang 'gul ba dang khrag dang be'u snabs lta bu 'byung ba dang de dag ltar snang na
pairs.rgyud_text: sbrid pa mang mkhal babs rked pa na zhing ro smad lci snod du lhung na dang ga 'gags pa dang 'khru skyug dri ma 'gag gam 'tshing zhing 'gyung gso ba'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po gnyis bcos tshul dang po rlan chen bye ma skam bar du chu bo rka ru drang ba dang tha ma dgra bo gnyen du bzlums pas bcos gnyen po sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi dang po tsha rnyogs chu ser skem pa'i sman sdud thang gsum gyis byer ba bsdus byas nas

pairs.d4310: purna rna ba a ka ru a shwa gandha nye shing dang kshi ra ku shu shing mngar dang ba la ras shu ti dang
pairs.d4311: a shwa gandha dang nye'u shing dang pa yas sya dang shing mngar dang ba la ra sa dang shu ti dang mungga parni dang ma sha parni dang sug smel dang shing tsha dang gandha bha dra dang 'di rnams zhib tu btags te lhan cig tu me mi che bas bskol la til mar 'ba' zhig
pairs.rgyud_text: ka ra la sbyor zhib tu btags la gdab 'ju tshod lon tsam khyi'u sus bsten par bya zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las lde gu'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po

pairs.d4310: rgya dag dang ni rnyi rnams dang slon dang bshang ba gtong ba dang rnag dang mtshan ma ngan pa mthong snying po med dang 'khrig pa spyod
pairs.d4311: 'bru nag po dang bu ram dang dar ba dang lan tshwa dang btung ba dang pags pa dang yungs kar dang zhag dang 'bru mar dang rtswa dang 'dam dang bud shing dang ma ning dang rigs ngan pa dang rgya dang rnyi dang slon pa dang bshang ba dang rnag dang de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ngan pa mthong ba dang snying po med pa dang 'khrig pa spyod pa dang
pairs.rgyud_text: dbyi mong srub ka'i 'bras bu rnams 'o ma mar dang zhag la 'dag pa bya nus ldan bsregs thal sug smel pi pi ling se 'bru sdig srin lcam pa sram gyi brun kha tshar btab la 'du ba'i rta dang sbyar dmu chu rgya mtsho tsam yang skem par nus thal sbyor thal sman 'jam po sum gnyis la btsan dug a ru bcu gcig pho 'gron bdun cu gang gur kum tsha ba rnam pa lnga tshwa sna tshogs

pairs.d4310: yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las lus kyi gnas kyi le'u drug pa'o yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las gnas drug pa ste tha ma rdzogs so
pairs.rgyud_text: dang ngos 'dzin dang gso ba'i thabs dang rtsis kyi le'u drug mdo gnas rtsa ba'i rgyud du shes par bya bshad pa'i sdom dang chags tshul 'dra dpe dang gnas lugs mtshan nyid dbye ba 'jig ltas dang nad kyi rgyu rkyen zhugs tshul mtshan nyid dang dbye ba rgyun dus gnas skabs spyod pa dang zas tshul

pairs.d4310: rtag tu chang 'thungs de'i rigs skyes tshil dang bad kan shas che la rlung dang mkhris pa shas chung dang me drod che zhing brtan pa rnams
pairs.d4311: chang 'thungs kyang ha cang ra ro bar mi 'gyur ba ni nyams 'tshag yod de tshor ba dang sngar kha zas zos pa dang kha zas cher za phod pa dang rtag tu kha zas snum bag za ba dang snying stobs che ba'i mi dang na tshod dar la bab ste gzhon pa dang rtag tu chang mi 'chad par 'thung ba lta bu dang pha ma'i rgyud kyis rtag tu chang 'thung 'thung bar gyur pa dang lus tshil dang bad kan gyi shas che la rlung dang mkhris pa'i shas ni chung pho ba'i me drod ni che zhing brtan par yang yod pa de lta bu ni chang la sra ste 'thungs na yang ra ro bar mi 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: phan yon tshe ring na tshod dar la 'jog lus mdangs stobs skyed dbang po gsal bar byed gnas gtsang dben dga' bar chad med pa der rten ni ha cang rgas pa ma yin pas chags spang brtson pas gza' skar bzang dus 'jug bya thabs gtsor blang zhar spyad rnam pa gnyis gtso bor spyad pa sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis sngon 'gro snum 'chos rjes la khrus byas la 'bras bu gsum dang rgyam tshwa pi pi ling bca' sga shu dag yung ba byi tang ga bu ram ba chu sbyar bas khong pa sbyang ma sbyangs dri bcas tshos ltar don med 'gyur dngos gzhi sgog skya zhun mar sbyar byas la nas snod bdun gsum bzhag la zhag grangs bsten rlung gi nad sel tshe 'phel byed

pairs.d4310: de las skya ba'i shas che bas de phyir skya rbab nad ces bshad nad des lus ni lci ba dang lus zungs rnams ni lhod pa dang mdangs kyi yon tan zad gyur zhing
pairs.d4311: kha dog de gsum gyi nang nas skya ba'i shas che bas de'i phyir skya rbab kyi nad ces bya'o de'i phyir nad des lus lci ba dang srog zungs kyi khams rnams lhod pa dang mdangs dang yon tan yang zad pas
pairs.rgyud_text: du gsol zhes zhus pa dang yon tan las sprul pa'i drang srong rig pa'i ye shes des 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes gsum pa man ngag rgyud la bslab pa ni 'gro mchog gtso bor gyur pa'i mi lus kyang ma rig

pairs.d4310: rtsa 'dzin de ni gsor mi rung rlung gis de la gzhogs phyed bzung rtsa dang rgyus pa bskams byas nas gzhogs phyed gang yang rung la gnod
pairs.d4311: de ni rtsa 'dzin pa'i rlung nad ces bya ste gsor mi rung ngo rlung gis lus kyi gzhogs phyed bzung ste des rtsa dang rgyus pa bskam par byas nas gzhogs phyed gang yang rung ba la gnod par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: 'og snod kyi phyi rol chu yis khengs de ni rtsa kha log pa'i 'khyims chu yin byer chu dwangs ma ma zhu mchin lam brgyud zungs su ma song ngan khrag chu ser rgyas sha lpags rtsa mig byer ba khrag byer yin mchin rgyas ngan khrag mkhris par

pairs.d4310: bad kan rlung 'dres shu dag dang pu tse shel dang pa ta dang dong ga dug mo nyung bskol phan yang na sle tres bskol ba yi khu bar pi pi ling gi ni phye ma btab ste 'thungs na phan
pairs.d4311: bad kan dang rlung 'dres pa'i rims la ni shu dag dang pu tse shel dang pa tha dang dong ga dang dug mo yungs kyi shun pa rnams bskol la blud do yang na sle tres bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du pi pi ling gi phye ma btab pa 'thungs na yang phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang

pairs.d4310: rtsib logs na dang dbugs mi bde lud pa lu ba'i nad sel byed 'u su zho gnyis go snyod dang la la phud la zho bzhi bzhi se 'bru dang ni da trig dag de yi nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur bya kha ru tsha ni srang gcig dang bca' sga zho gnyis bil ba'i rkang
pairs.d4311: yi ga 'chus pa dang me drod nyams pa dang rtsib logs na ba dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa rnams la phan no 'u su zho gnyis dang go snyod dang la la phud dang bal po se'u dang da trig dang 'di rnams srang phyed phyed dang kha ru tsha srang gnyis dang bca' sga zho gnyis dang ka pid ta dang a ru ra srang phyed dang gsum gsum dang sha kha ra srang bcu drug dang bsres pa'i ka pi da ta ro drug pa'i phye ma zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: ti gsum mam lnga kha ru tsha la zho bzhi bur srang gcig mar rnying srang bdun lde gur byas te btang mi rus bsdus khur sgog skya shing kun bran mthil bzhi tshigs pa rlung gsang sku mnye dang rlung gsang bzhi bsro mar rnying 'jam rtsi bya sha chang mar rnying bu ram drod bcud bsten byis pa bad kan grang shas che ba dang bad kan yul du tsha ba babs pa dang ma smin gtar bsil tsha ba byer rkyen 'dom tshad gzhug mi mngon grang rtags kha yar 'ong rtsa dal chu mdog sngo la dang ga 'gag lce

pairs.d4310: skad 'gags sna sman bla med yin pra punda ri ka shing mngar pi pi ling dang bri ha ti ba la 'o ma mar bskol te
pairs.d4311: yang na pra punda ri ka dang shing mngar dang pi pi ling dang bri ha ti dang ba la rnams 'o ma dang mar du sbyar ba bskol ba snar blugs na yang mkhris pa'i skad 'gags pa sel ba'i mchog yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: rgod brun a ru ra dang pi pi ling du sbyar ka ras rta byas chu skol 'phul la btang ma zhu lhen skran thal bar rlog par byed yang na thun gsum tsha ba'i ril bus bshig zhig nas nad ro bshal lam skyugs kyis sbyang lcags dreg chags na cong

pairs.d4310: bza' ba yi ga 'byed pa'i mchog de las rlung 'gyur yi ga 'chus ha re nu dang pi pi ling byi dang ga dang ra sna dang rgyam tsha dang ni dong gra dang sug smel ga bra'i rtsa ba dang nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang
pairs.d4311: yi ga 'byed pa'i mchog yin no de la rlung las gyur pa'i yi ga 'chus pa la ni ha re nu ka dang pi pi ling dang byi dang ga dang ra sna dang rgyam tsha dang dong gra dang sug smel dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang shing kun dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma chang gi dngas ma'am
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong rngam pa bde

pairs.d4310: bu ram zhun mar sha khu dge ba che tsha ba gsum dang 'tsho byed sman mar dang
pairs.d4311: de yang mar dang bu ram dang sha khu dang dge ba'i sman mar dang tsha ba gsum gyi sman mar dang 'tsho byed sde bcu'i sman mar dang 'o ma dang lde gu gang yang rung ba rnams bsten na shin tu mi bzad pa'i skyugs pa
pairs.rgyud_text: zhi dang sbyang ba gnyis zhi byed sman la thang phye mar dang gsum thang la smin thang dbye thang sdud pa'i thang gsod thang sad thang dgug thang skam thang bdun smin par byed pa'i thang la rnam gsum ste ma nu bzhi pas bad rlung smin par byed tig ta gsum pas mkhris tshad

pairs.d4310: a shwadtha yi myu gu srang gnyis gnyis chu bre gsum dang ni 'o ma bre gang nang du bskol 'o ma lus nas tshigs ma btsags khu ba der ni mon cha ra btsod dang tsandan utpal
pairs.d4311: yang na byi tsher ba dang ku sha dang ku sha'i rtsa ba dang shal ma li'i me tog dang rtsa ba dang nya gro dha dang u dumba ra dang a shwadtha gsum gyi myu gu dang 'di rnams srang gnyis gnyis dang chu bre gsum dang 'o ma bre gang dang tshul bzhin du bskol la 'o ma lus pa dang tshigs ma bor la khu ba'i nang du mon cha ra dang btsod dang tsandan dang utpa la dang pri yang ku dang dug mo yungs kyi sa bon dang padma ge sar dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma dang mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sha kha ras btab ste 'dres par gyur pa ni bi tse'i 'jam rtsi zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: sel na ga pushpa na ga ge sar dang padma ge sar glo mchin snying tshad sel zi ra dkar pos glo yi tshad pa sel zi ra nag pos mchin pa'i grang ba sel la la phud kyis pho nad grang ba sel so ma ra dzas lpags nad chu ser sel thal ka rdo rje dag kyang de bzhin no gser gyi me tog snod tshad mkhris tshad sel gser gyi phud bus mkhris pa gyen du 'dren dug mo nyung gis mkhris sel tsha 'khru gcod rgun 'brum glo nad sel zhing tshad pa sbyong 'u sus pho ba'i bad kan tsha ba sel star bus glo brko khrag 'ju bad kan gcod bse yab bad kan tsha ba sel bar byed se 'brus pho ba'i nad rnams ma lus sel

pairs.d4310: bre bcu drug bskol bzhi cha lus pa der bu ram srang ni brgyad cu tsha ba gsum srang brgyad zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma gzhug 'di dag zla gcig bzhag ste langs gyur nas
pairs.d4311: chu srang lnga brgya rtsa bcu gnyis kyi nang du bskol te bzhi cha lus pa dang tshigs ma bor la dngas ma'i nang du bu ram srang brgyad cu dang tsha ba gsum srang brgyad zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma bcug ste bsregs la zla ba gcig bzhag ste rang gi drod kyis legs par smin pa dang cung zhig skyur bar 'gyur te
pairs.rgyud_text: mthong snang so sor shar dper na mkha' la zla ba gcig shar na chu yi skyogs rer zla ba re re bzhin gcig tu gsungs kyang so sos du mar go zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyud bzhi'i mjug don bsdus pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad

pairs.d4310: dri sna gsum dang tsha gsum se 'bru dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba sru sru'i rtsa gu gul ma nu 'u su dbyi mong dang spa ma'i 'bras bu sge gsher star bu ni srang re zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma bskol
pairs.d4311: bzhi cha sum brgya brgyad cu rtsa bzhi lus pa dang tshigs ma bor te bsgrangs pa'i nang du dri sna gsum dang tsha ba gsum dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang se'u 'bru dang sru sru'i rtsa ba dang gu gul dang ma nu dang 'u su dang dbyi mo dang spa ma'i 'bras bu dang sge'u gsher dang star bu dang 'di rnams srang re re zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang rgun 'brum dang skyur rtsi chen po dang sge'u gsher dang 'di rnams rlon pa brjid pa'i khu ba srang nyi shu nyi shu dang bu ram shing gi khu ba ci mang du blugs te
pairs.rgyud_text: sbyang bar bya bsdu ba phag khrag ma nu 'u su dang star bu ka ra sbyar bas byer ba sdud yang na se 'bru se rgod bar shun dang re ral phag khrag ka ra ba 'os dbul yang na tsha la 'o ma sbyar bas bsdu de dag kun gyis smug po spyi ru sdud ser po gsum thang stod du byer ba sdud tsha la tshos sum thang gis smad byer sdud 'dus rtags lus lci kha skam dang ga 'gag pho ba na la rtsa chu'i tsha ba skye de dus spyi sman rtsi sbyor bsten te bsad de rjes dur byid hong len tsha las sbyang nad stobs che na rim pa ci rigs bskyar chung na sbyangs

pairs.d4310: spa ma'i 'bras bu sge gsher star bu ni srang re zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma bskol
pairs.d4311: bzhi cha sum brgya brgyad cu rtsa bzhi lus pa dang tshigs ma bor te bsgrangs pa'i nang du dri sna gsum dang tsha ba gsum dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang se'u 'bru dang sru sru'i rtsa ba dang gu gul dang ma nu dang 'u su dang dbyi mo dang spa ma'i 'bras bu dang sge'u gsher dang star bu dang 'di rnams srang re re zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang rgun 'brum dang skyur rtsi chen po dang sge'u gsher dang 'di rnams rlon pa brjid pa'i khu ba srang nyi shu nyi shu dang bu ram shing gi khu ba ci mang du blugs te
pairs.rgyud_text: ka ra la sbyor zhib tu btags la gdab 'ju tshod lon tsam khyi'u sus bsten par bya zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las lde gu'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig sman mar sde tshan tsha sel grang sel gnyis tsha sel tig ta hong len ba sha ka spang rtsi kyi lce khu ba phyungs pa yi dwangs ma ba mdzo'i 'o ma mar gsar la sbyar ba'i mar khur gur kum ge sar gsum ka ra sbrang sbyar mig ser skya rbab dang chu

pairs.d4310: der ni bu ram rnying pa srang brgya gzhug slar bskol ska bar gyur pa de nang du tsha ba gsum dang shu ti a ru ra
pairs.d4311: yang na kru trug tres kyi rtsa ba lnga bcu chu srang lnga bcu brgya bcu gnyis kyi nang du bskol te brgyad cha srang drug cu rtsa bzhi lus pa dang de'i nang du bu ram rnying pa srang brgyad bcug ste yang bskol la cung zhig ska bar gyur pa dang de'i nang tsha ba gsum dang shu ti dang a ru ra dang ru rta dang dur byid dang byi dang ga dang shing tsha dang tsi tra ka dang sug smel dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma bcug la dkrugs nas lde gur gyur pa las ran par zos na gzhang 'brum dang mdze dang mcher pa na ba dang skran dang dmu rdzing rnams las rgyal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: lgang par gnas srin skran pho long gnyis kyi nang du 'byung chu skran nges med gar yang 'byung srid de glo snying mchin pa rgyu long bar du mang rnag gi skran la gar 'ong nges pa med mdor bsdus phyi skran nang skran bar skran gsum phyi skran snod kyi phyi dang sha lpags bar bar skran snod kyi nang ldebs don gyi logs nang skran don snod kun gyi gting na gnas gyur tshul kha zas gyong tshil sbang ma sogs ma zhu rang sor gnas pas be snabs 'dril snyigs ma ma zhu zas kyi skran du 'gyur ma zhu'i rkyen gyis bad kan be snabs 'phel rlung gis bsgril bas lhen skran zhes byar 'gyur dwangs ma ma zhu pho bar yun ring gnas bad kan grang bas

pairs.d4310: rtag tu bsten na me drod skyed par byed tsha ba gsum dang til dang 'bras bu gsum byi dang ga dang go bye tsi tra ka bu ram ri lur byas bsten gzhang 'brum dang
pairs.d4311: rtag tu goms par byas na me'i drod skyed par byed do yang na tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga dang til dang go bye dang tsi tra ka 'di rnams bu ram dang ri lur byas te btang na gzhang 'brum sel zhing me drod skyed par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: zo mar bad rlung sel zhing me drod skyed 'bri dang lug mar de bzhin grang rlung sel mdzo snyoms ba ra bsil bas rlung tshad sel til mar tsha rno skem po sha skyed cing sbom po 'bri la mkhregs te bad rlung sel yungs mar rlung gnon bad mkhris skyed pa yin rkang mar rlung 'joms khu stobs bad kan skyed

pairs.d4310: bu ti ka dang pi pi ling bca' sga shu dag a ru ra 'u su legs par bskol ba blud yang na bil ba 'u su dang gla sgang dong gra ba le ka
pairs.d4311: de la ni 'khru ba gso ba'i le'u las 'byung ba'i sman bu ti ka dang pi pi ling dang bca' sga dang shu dag dang 'u su dang a ru ra bskol ba 'am yang na bil ba dang 'u su dang gla sgang dang bca' sga dang bal dang de rnams bskol ba 'am
pairs.rgyud_text: ni ma zhu me drod nyams las 'byung ba'i phyir grang ba'i chu la se 'bru bzhi pa ste tsha ba'i chu la de steng gur kum bsnan bur dkar sbyar ba chu skol 'phul la btang pho ba'i me drod skyed cing ma zhu 'ju bad kan be snabs rtsa sbubs 'gags pa sel dwangs ma ma zhu lus zungs rang sor 'jug

pairs.d4310: sha khu dang yang sbyin par bya bil ba gla sgang ba ru ra bca' sga da ta ka'i me tog
pairs.d4311: khyim bya gang yang rung ba'i sha khu dang bcas pa'i bza' ba sbyin no bil ba dang gla sgang dang ba ru ra dang da ta ka'i me tog dang dong gra dang 'di rnams dar ba dang sbyar ba'i thug pa 'thungs na zhu ba'i 'khru ba sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: mo pi pi ling dang dong gra cha re bskyed a ru kun mnyam phye ma me dang 'dra ma zhu bad rlung grang skran 'joms par byed bi sha a ru bcu 'gyur pho 'gron bdun cu gang gur kum tsha ba rnam pa lnga tshwa sna lnga dang rgya tshwa pri yangku thal sman zho gsum dri

pairs.d4310: zho dang sbyar bas 'khru ba sel ka pid ta dang ka tsu ra ga bra'i rtsa ba yu ti dang nya gro dha dang rdo dreg dang
pairs.d4311: bil ba dang gla sgang dang ba ru ra dang da ta ka'i me tog dang dong gra dang 'di rnams dar ba dang sbyar ba'i thug pa 'thungs na zhu ba'i 'khru ba sel to ka pid ta dang ka tsu ra dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang yu ti ka dang nya gro dha'i myu gu dang se'u 'bru dang sha na'i ras bal dang sha ma li dang de rnams kyi lo ma btags pa
pairs.rgyud_text: ma ba ra mdzo zho dar ba dang nya sha phag sha sol ba la sogs pa zas skom yang rtsub bsil drod snyoms pa 'phrod bye brag gnas sa yul la brtag pa dang gnas skabs dus dang nad rigs sgo nas brtag dang po gnas sa pho mchin rgyu long bzhi pho bar gnas tshe sgreg skyug zos rjes na 'ju dka' chang rgan chang gsar shi sha gnod ha cang drod drags rlan grang dus na ldang mchin par gnas tshe mchin dri

pairs.d4310: su ta'i sdong bu srang bzhi dang lan tshwa gsum las srang re dang par ta ka ni phul gang dang arka srang brgyad tsi tra ka srang gnyis bsregs la par ta ka'i
pairs.d4311: su dha kshi ra'i shing srang bzhi dang lan tshwa rnam gsum srang re re dang bar ta ka bskol ba bskams pa srang bzhi dang arka srang brgyad dang tsi tra ka srang gnyis dang 'di rnams yang gong ma ltar bsregs pa'i thal ba bye'u bar ta ka'i khu ba dang ri lur byas te
pairs.rgyud_text: par pa ta bskol grang thang btang pri yangku bsregs pa'i thal ba zhun mar sbyar te btang bar bya cu gang gur kum dom mkhris ba sha ka zab thal 'gron thal sran ma'i me tog sbyar tsan dan dmar po ra khrag pu shel rtse stang zil 'bras yos phye dang ka ra sbyar ma chod log non dur byid pri yangku khu

pairs.d4310: rlan dugs lus ni spying ba'ang bya rtsa ba bcu pa e randa ba la nas dang nye shing pa ba spru ba dang ku langtha
pairs.d4311: snum dang ldan pa'i dugs dang blugs pa'i dugs dang byug pa rnams bya'o rtsa ba bcu pa dang ba la dang e randa dang nas dang nye'u shing dang ba spru ba dang rgya sran dang rgya shug dang lcags dang ba spru ba me tog dmar po can dang sru sru'i rtsa ba dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma mar dang phag tshil dang lan tshwa rnam lnga dang chu dang tshul bzhin bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: spa 'bru gze ma lcam pa ba spru ba ra'i mar la sdig srin gur kum bu ram pa'i mar sbyar dugs lums bya rjes la zas skom drod bsten mkhal gsang bsreg pho bar 'grams na spyang tsher chig skyugs bya mcher 'grams 'ol se so cha 'o sbyar btang rgyam tshwa tsha la la phug sa bon dang cong zhi tsha gsum sbrang la ril bu sbyar ru thung snod ka gung srin bar rtsa gtar rjes la pho gsang mdun rgyab rim pas

pairs.d4310: gzer dang lto sbos 'joms par byed spa ma'i 'bras bu tsha ba gsum zi ra go snyod tsha ba lnga
pairs.d4311: khyad par du zug gzer dang lto sbo ba 'phrog go spa ma'i 'bras bu dang tsha ba gsum dang zi ra dang tsha ba lnga dang a dza mo rda dang go snyod dang lce myang tsha dang 'di rnams cham chom brdungs te
pairs.rgyud_text: khyad par pho long rlung dang snying rlung sel sga dang go snyod dza ti bsdus pa'i thang rlung nad ma lus 'joms shing dran pa gsal chang ni lca ba ra mnye zan chang la gro yi chang bsings rlung nad ma lus 'joms mchog tu mkhal rked smad kyi rlung la

pairs.d4310: sgog skya'i rtsa ba srang brgya dang rtsa ba chen po srang lnga lnga chu srang stong dang de bskol la bzhi cha lus par phyed se 'bru'i
pairs.d4311: shun pa bshus pa'i sgog skya srang brgya dang rtsa ba lnga chen po srang re re dang chu srang gong dang bskol la bzhi cha lus pa'i phyed dang mnyam pa'i se'u 'bru'i rang gi khu ba dang chang
pairs.rgyud_text: ba phal rag lus me dang mnyam pa'i rlung ni pho bar gnas nang khrol kun tu rgyu zhing kha zas 'ju dwangs snyigs 'byed cing gnod bya smin par byed thur du sel ba'i rlung ni gzhang la gnas long dang lgang pa gsang ba brla nang

pairs.d4310: rlung las gyur pa'i skran sel to rlung gi skran la bad kan 'phel dro 'jam yi ga 'chus pa dang snying rgal khong lci snyom gyur pa de la skyug sman gtang bar bya gzer dang lto sbos bshang sri la
pairs.d4311: se'u 'bru'i khu ba'am zho'i spris ma gang yang rung ba dang sbyar ba'i sman mar 'thungs na rlung las gyur pa'i skran sel to gal te rlung gi skran la bad kan te me drod nyams shing yi ga 'chus pa dang snying 'dzag pa dang lus lci ba dang snyom par 'gyur te de la skyug sman gtang ngo zug gzer dang lto sbo ba dang rtug pa 'gags pa dang khong pa snum par shes na sman bskol ba'i chu dang phye ma dang ri lu dang
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong rngam pa bde sna rdog mnyen zhing chu mdog dmar ser dang rtsa rgyud phyi grims khong lhod tha mal grangs lce steng ser la

pairs.d4310: srang re chu bre bzhi nang bskol khu ba brgyad cha lus pa ru mar bre gang dang zho bre gang su dha kshi ra srang gcig bskol
pairs.d4311: yang na ni li ni dang 'bras bu gsum dang ra sna dang ba la dang pu tse shel dang pi dang ga dang kanda ka ri dang 'di rnams srang re re dang chu srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig bskol te khu ba brgyad cha lus ba'i nang du mar bre gang dang zho bre gang dang su dha kshi ra srang gcig dang lhan cig bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: chang rkyang pa sbrang rtsi bre gang dang chu bre drug bsres btsos la rnga mas btsags bre dor gdu nas chu bre gang blug la ngad bsad gzar bus phyar te 'o drod tsam phabs rdog snyim gang gris drad rnga mar phur cong zhi'i gting rdo lding thag shing la gtod sug smel thun gcig btags la btab ste mnan zhag dus bsros kyin zhag gsum bar du bzhag langs na skyur mnam lbu ba phyir gyis 'ong de

pairs.d4310: rtsa ba bcu pa ldan par sbyang pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra rgun 'bru sha ma dur byid sogs
pairs.d4311: bya ba'i rim pa de dag gis bad kan las gyur pa'i skran nad snyi bar gyur pa la ni snum bag dang ldan pa'i khrus dang rtsa ba bcu pa dang sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsi sbyar ro pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra dang rgun 'bru dang sha ma dur byid la sogs pa'i sde tshan dang
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang

pairs.d4310: skran dang rtug 'gags rgyu rlugs dang gzhang 'brum dmu rdzing pho ba'i nad srin nad brjed byed smyo byed gdon mngal nad khu chu las gyur rde'u
pairs.d4311: ran par 'thungs na skran dang rlung las gyur pa'i rtug pa 'gags pa dang rlig rlugs dang gzhang 'brum dang dmu rdzing dang pho ba'i nad dang srin bu dang brjed byed kyi gdon dang smyo byed dang mngal nad dang khu chu las gyur pa'i rde'u'i nad dang de bzhin du byi ba dang sbrul la sogs pa'i dug dang de rnams thal sman 'dis zhi bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong rngam pa bde sna rdog mnyen

pairs.d4310: khrag las gyur pa'i skran dang ni bud med zla mtshan med la blud ga bra'i rtsa ba pi pi ling thang shing ka ranydza'i shun pa pi pi ling gi rtsa ba yi
pairs.d4311: til bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du bu ram dang mar dang tsha ba gsum dang ga bra'i rtsa ba'i phye ma dang ldan par byas pa byin te bud med zla mtshan nyams pa la sbyar ro ga bra'i rtsa ba dang pi pi ling dang ka ranydza'i shun lpags dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang thang shing 'di rnams kyi phye ma til bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na
pairs.rgyud_text: rnag khrag chu ser 'dren bya po tsi tsis bud med zla mtshan gcod shu mo za yis glo rnag 'khru ba gcod snyi ba lug mur brang tsha cham pa sel g.yer shing pa yis 'brum pa'i tsha ba sel me tog ser chen rma 'drub rtsa rul gso brag skya ha bos dug sel tshad 'khru gcod brag spos rma 'drub rnag skem lha ba 'dzin rgya spos spang spos tshad rnying dug tshad sel myang rtsi spras kyis chu 'thung rims tshad

pairs.d4310: chu dron 'o mar sbyar blud na mig ser skya rbab snying nad dang mdze dang gzhang 'brum nad rnams sel dong gra lcags phye til dang ni bu ram cha mnyam pa yi tshad
pairs.d4311: dar ba 'am chu dron po dang 'o ma dang bcas par 'thungs na mig ser dang skya rbab dang snying nad dang mdze dang gzhang 'brum dang gcin nad thams cad sel bar byed do dong gra dang lcags phye dang til dang bu ram 'di rnams cha mnyam pa dang sman sna gcig gi nyis 'gyur gyi pi pi ling dang de rnams ri lur byas pa zos na skya rbab la phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: ngal dub dbugs bkag skran dang snying nad 'byung myos 'gyur der ni ngal gso rlung sel phan gnyid bkag g.yal mang lus snyom mgo bo lci mig 'grib kha zas mi 'ju sha khu dang chang btung bsku mnye bya zhing gnyid log phan lud pa bkag pas lud 'phel dbugs mi bde sha skem skyigs bu snying nad yi ga 'chu der ni lud pa bsal ba'i cho ga bya mchi ma bkag pas snying dang mgo bo na sna chu 'dzag

pairs.d4310: pri ka thang shing spang spos dang pi pi ling dang dbyi mo dang ku nan na ta bya ma ka ma li ka dang dri sna bzhi bal bu'i lo ma gla sgang dang gandha pa la sha la ni
pairs.d4311: yang na rdo dreg dang ru rta dang sto ne ya dang ha re nu ka dang a ru ra dang shug pa dang shri beshta ka dang chu srin sen mo dang 'bu su hang dang thang shing dang bri yang ku dang spang spos dang pi pi ling dang dbyi mo dang ku tan na ta dang bya ma ka dang ba la ka dang dri sna bzhi dang bal bu'i lo ma dang gla sgang dang gandha pa la sha dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma til mar dang sbyar bas bsku ba dang phye ma chu dang sbyar ba'i khrus dang lde gu'i byug pa rnams bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: myos na ba lu rdo dreg dang shug 'brum thang btang spyang snying sdig pa'i mgo gi wam bu mo stag lo ma'i srin lag sen mo chur sbyangs kyi sbyor ba bya byi ba nya mig gang rnyed mig la byug mgo gzer gser phud g.ya' kyi ri sho'i rtsa skyi 'bras bong nga dkar po'i skyugs kyis drangs zug ma chogs na de rjes bshal gyis sbyang dpral rtsa mtshogs gsang gtar la chu lcag bya mur gong 'phar rtsa ltag pa'i sdud sgo bsreg dom mkhris tig ta gur kum bong nga dkar a byag gangs thigs gser gyi me tog dang ka ra sbyar btang mgo bo 'khyoms pa la mgo khrol sbyor ba shing kun

pairs.d4310: thor bu khong 'bras skran dang ni zad byed smyo byed myos pa dang snying nad rab rib ngo khabs dang sha bkra mig ser pho ba'i nad mtshan par rdol dang brjed byed dang
pairs.d4311: rma 'grams pa dang 'brum bu dang khong 'bras dang skran dang skem byed kyi nad dang smyo byed dang myos pa dang snying nad dang rab rib dang ngo shig dang pho ba'i nad dang sha bkra dang mig ser dang mtshan par rdol ba dang brjed byed dang bud med kyi zla mtshan gyi nad dang sbyar ba'i dug dang gzhang 'brum dang khrag mkhris rnams la phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: skyon bsal ma rig pa las byung ba'i dug gsum gyi nad thams cad zhi bar byas nas slar thugs kar 'dus pa las sprul pa'i ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba zhig thugs las sprul te mdun gyi bar snang la bzhugs nas drang srong gi 'khor rnams la 'di skad ces mdun bsu'o kye grogs po dag shes par gyis shig mi na ba gnas par 'dod pa dang na ba gso

pairs.d4310: sa lu nas dang gro dang ni ci tse khre dang mungga dang sran chung dang ni tu ka ri'i tshod ma kha bo skam sa'i sha 'bras bu gsum dang pa to la seng ldeng nim pa go bye sbyar
pairs.d4311: bza' ba ni 'bras dmar po la sogs pa dang nas dang gro dang ci tse dang khre dang sran mungga dang sran chung dang tu ba ri dang tshod ma kha ba rnams dang skam sar gnas pa'i sha khu 'bras bu gsum dang pa to la dang seng ldeng dang nim pa dang go bye rnams sbyar ba sbyin no
pairs.rgyud_text: bkru 'jam mo gsum pa skam sa'i sha khu ra 'o mar gong sman so cha sbyar ba bkru ma slen mar rab sha khu 'bring la 'o ma tha sha grogs 'o ma 'o grogs mar nyid gces kha 'dzin rlung la shing kun kha ru tshwa bad kan ldan la sga dang pi pi ling mkhris par ldan la sle tres kyi lce ba skran la rgya tshwa

pairs.d4310: skyer pa pi pi ling dong gra byi dang ga dang ba to ri tsi tra ka dang bya rnams
pairs.d4311: mdze nad thams cad 'joms so skyer pa dang pi pi ling dang dong gra dang byi dang ga dang to ba ri dang tsi tra ka dang ta bya dang 'di rnams yas kyi rim bzhin du cha res bskyed pa'i phye ma ba gcin dang bcas pa 'thungs na
pairs.rgyud_text: ni mngar skyur lan tshwa kha tsha bska go rim bzhin du 'tsho byed stobs chen yin ngo bo lce la gsal bas ro zhes bya de yang mngar ba'i ro de myangs pa'i tshe kha la chags shing zhim pas sred pa skye skyur ba so brtse bzhin sdud kha chu 'dzag lan tshwa reg na tsha zhing

pairs.d4310: nim pa ser po rnam gnyis dang bye'u rug pa dang pa to la ru rta a shwa gandha dang thang shing shi kru nyungs kar dang g.yer ma 'u su gla ba dang
pairs.d4311: ras bal gyi me tog dang dong ga'i lo ma dang mon sran sde'u dme ru'i rtsa ba dang lo mar bcas pa dang 'di bzhi btags pa'i phye ma'i lde gus bskus na yang phan no nim pa dang ser po rnam gnyis dang bye'u rug pa dang pa to la dang ru rta dang a shwa gandha dang thang shing dang shi kru dang yungs kar dang g.yer ma dang 'u su dang bla ba zhes bya ba ku tan na ta dang tsandan dang 'di rnams cha snyoms pa'i phye ma dar ba dang btags te
pairs.rgyud_text: gla sgang par pa ta dang dug mo nyung pa to la dang rtsa mkhris bsnan la btang zla gcig phar 'das rims rnying tsha ba rnams sle tres pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum thang mang btang rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar skabs su rngul dbyung mig chu ser na sbyang bshang gci phyen 'gags pa la bya kr i dang gze ma 'o ma bur rnying bskol ba phan mdog sngo sha skam dang ga bde ba na tsha ba phyi ru byer bas chu lcag phan rtsa khrid na 'phreng lci na cung zad gtar tshigs gzhi rus pa na skrangs chu

pairs.d4310: mig dmar gza' la bskus na ni sha bkra sel ba grub pa yin dzi ban ti dang skyer pa btsod kam bi lya dang spangs ma ni
pairs.d4311: gza' mig dmar la bab pa'i dus su bskus na sha bkra sel bar grags pa yin no dzi ban ti dang btsod dang skyer pa dang kam pi lya dang spangs ma dang de rnams cham chom brdungs te mar dang til mar dang mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi 'o ma dang bskol ba'i nang du sra rtsi pog dang spra tshil gyis btags pa bskus na 'bras byer ba 'jig par 'gyur te
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal rma 'tsho zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod

pairs.d4310: legs par bsres pa blud par bya ba la nye shing ra snang dang pi lu rtsa ba bcu par bcas dur byid sti ra e randa
pairs.d4311: yang na til mar dang li kha ra bsres pa blud do ba la dang nye'u shing dang ra sna dang pi lu dang rtsa ba bcu pa dang dur byid dang e randa dang de rnams
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung

pairs.d4310: bcud kyis len gyi dam pa ste dbang po gsal bar byed pa yin tshe ring lus 'phel skad snyan dang khu chu khrag gi nad sel byed
pairs.d4311: khyad par du bcud kyis len gyi mchog tu 'gyur zhing dbang po rnams gsal bar byed de tshe dang lus 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang skad snyan pa dang khu chu dang khrag gi nad rnams 'joms par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: brtson dang gzi mdangs dang tshe dang lus zungs me drod stobs 'phel byed zhu gnas sgor 'jug zas lam sgo gtan yin de stobs ldan na zhu nas thur 'gro ste stobs zhan kha zas ma smin nyid phyir 'byung me drod de ni zas gang lus zungs

pairs.d4310: ra yi 'o mar bcas pa dag dug skran dmu rdzing rmen bu dang 'bras dang rkang bam nad la blud
pairs.d4311: yang na ku ba kha bo'i sa bon ra'i 'o ma'i nang du bran te ra'i 'o ma de nyid dang bcas pa 'thungs na dug dang skran dang dmu rdzing dang thor bu dang 'bras dang rkang bam rnams la phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: sde kun tu rgyug pa'i spyi bshal dang thor bu nad kyi sgos bshal rnam pa gnyis dang po sna sel ded dpon kha 'dzin gsum sna sel a ru mchu ring lcum rtsa dang chu ma rtsi dang rgyam tshwa pi pi ling bsdus thang dro 'jam nam dgung btang

pairs.d4310: nad bslangs phyin par ma nus pas mgo 'khor skrangs dang skyigs bu dang mun par mthong dang skom dad che
pairs.d4311: skyes bu gang gi lus snum chos dang dugs kyis zhen par byas pa la sman rnying pa rtsub pa'i bkru sman btang bas nad rang gi gnas nas bskyod cing 'khru ma nus pas mgo 'khor ba dang skrang ba dang skyigs bu dang mun par mthong ba dang skom dad che ba dang byin pa'i nyan ba dang lus g.ya' ba dang mgo bo tsha ba che zhing mdog 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i nad de rnams skyed par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: dbang bla gnyan bcas pa'i nad yin te rang gi gnas nas langs nas gnas gzhan phyin phyin nas rang gnas snga ma la gnod 'khrug de stobs chung na rang gnas snga ma gso phyi ma stobs che bla gnyan de bcos pas rang gnas gnas pa bcos mi dgos par 'tsho dper na rkun mo bsten pa'i rje bo bzhin khyad par gso ba'i tshul la rnam pa dgu ma rtogs dogs bcas gdengs ma thob ba'i nad byi la 'jab pa lta bu'i sad mdas bcos ngos zin

pairs.d4310: btsags pa la la phud dang po son cha bil ba ru rta sha ta pushpa dang shu dag gla sgang pi pi ling rnams kyi lde gu bu ram sbrang rtsi mar dang ni til mar rgyam tsha dag dang ldan gyur pa
pairs.d4311: tshigs ma bor te bzhi cha srang drug cu rtsa bzhi lus pa'i nang du la la phud dang po son cha dang bil ba dang ru rta dang sha ta pushpa dang shu dag dang gla sgang dang pi pi ling dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma dang bu ram dang sbrang rtsi dang mar dang til dang lan tshwa dang ldan par bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal

pairs.d4310: 'jam rtsi btang na bcud len mchog rtsol bas dkrugs glo 'grams pa dang dbang po nyams dang gzi mdangs stobs khu chu bshang gci 'gags pa dang dreg nad kyis 'theng nad rnams dang
pairs.d4311: lus kyi rtsol bas glo 'grams pa dang dbang po rnams mi gsal ba dang stobs dang gzi mdangs nyams pa dang khu chu dang bshang gci 'gags pa dang dreg nad la phan zhing de bzhin du rta dang glang po che dang shing rta la sogs pa las lhung zhing rkang lag chag cing grugs pa rnams la 'jam rtsi btang na slar 'tsho bar 'gyur te
pairs.rgyud_text: bzod nad kyi dri dugs stobs dang gzi mdangs 'chor smin pa'i long med bdun dgu'i dus na 'chi blun po 'ga' zhig smin byed dus la sdod rtsa spun shes pa yang la lus stobs shor phyi yi drod chung lpags mdog gser ltar ser dus 'das rang gnas sleb pas zlog thabs med de phyir ma smin dus na bya ra sgrims khyad par mgor bros klad gzer sna khrag 'dzag glor babs ro stod

pairs.d4310: dzi ban ti dang po son cha me da rnam gnyis sra ba ni shing mngar ba la shu ti dang zangs rtsi ba dang pi pi ling ka ka ni sa nye shing ba kha sral kshi ra ka ka ri
pairs.d4311: de bzhin du yang dang yang byas pa'i mar gyi 'jam rtsi mas gtong na rlung nad las rgyal bar byed do dzi ban ti dang po son cha dang me da rnam gnyis dang sra ba ni dang shing mngar dang ba la dang shu ti dang zangs rtsi ba dang pi pi ling dang ka ka na si dang nye'u shing dang kha sral ba dang ra mnye ba 'o ma can dang ka ra ka ta shring gi dang zur pa dang shu dag dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma dang mar dang til mar dang de'i bzhi 'gyur gyi 'o ma dang sbyar te 'jam rtsi mas gtong na
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal rma 'tsho zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod stobs skyed tshe 'phel snum pa'i mchog ste las stong byed phrum gsar spri dang phyur ba la sogs pa dang ga len zhing rtug skams bad kan sel zo mar bad rlung sel zhing me drod skyed 'bri

pairs.d4310: tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka thal tres pa tra byi dang ga shing mngar shing kun pa ya sya
pairs.d4311: thal tres dang tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka dang pa tha dang byi dang ga dang shing mngar dang pa ya sya dang shing kun dang thang shing dang pi pi ling mu la dang dug mo yungs dang de rnams btags pa'i phye ma dang mar lhan cig bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: btang se 'bru bzhi dang na ga zi ra dang pa tra 'u su la la phud dang sga na le sham dang kar sbyar gsar 'jam dbul bzhi lnga bya rog mig dang ske stong bsreg yib ma gar chang mi btang sha gsar dang gro chang sro los bsings dang gsar 'jam btang mchin rlung mchin sna skams phye'i

pairs.d4310: lha min gdon ni yar ngo yi bcu gsum mar ngo bcu gnyis la dri za'i gdon ni bcu bzhi dang bcu gnyis dag la'ang 'dzin par byed klu gdon tshes lnga la 'dzin byed
pairs.d4311: lha ma yin gyi gdon ni yar ngo'i tshes bcu gsum dang mar ngo'i bcu gnyis la 'jug par 'gyur ro dri za'i gdon ni tshes bcu bzhi dang bcu gnyis la 'jug go klu'i gdon ni tshes lnga la 'jug par 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: ni 'chi ltas zhi 'gyur ro zhi yang ltas brtan gnas na nges par 'chi phyi nang srog zungs sha zas rtsa dang gsum shor ba'i nad pa gang yin 'chi bar nges nad la cho ga sna tshogs bsgrubs byas kyang bcos skyed med pa 'chi bar nges pa yin de

pairs.d4310: lan cig skyes 'o bzhi 'gyur dang med rnam gnyis ra mnye ba bung tshang rdo dang kha sral phre'u bu ram shing dang parni gnyis
pairs.d4311: bzhi cha lus pa'i nang du mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ba be'u mang du skyes pa'i 'o ma mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang me da rnam gnyis dang ra mnye ba dang bung tshang rdo dang kha sral phre'u dang bu ram shing dang mungga parni dang 'di rnams kyi phye mas btab ste yang bskol la mar lus pa ni dge ba chen po'i sman mar zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: sbyar la gtar gtso bo brgyad kyi phye mas tsha ba bsad skabs su bad kan tsha ba rngul du dbyung phye thug ba zho ba sha chu grog btang skyed chung sbyangs rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar ma lhag ma chad rtsa ba thon par bcos zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'khrugs kyi tsha ba bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o de nas

pairs.d4310: nyams pa'i sems ni brta bar bya yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste bdun pa'o yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las gnas drug pa ste tha ma rdzogs so
pairs.rgyud_text: lus kyi 'jig ltas bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o le'u brgyad pa nad kyi rgyu bstan pa de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas la ji ltar bslab par bgyi 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos

pairs.d4310: mig mchu'i sha brud bca' sga dang rgyam tsha'i phye ma gdab par bya chu dron gyis bkrus seng ldeng dang
pairs.d4311: mig mchu'i nad sha skyes pa la 'brum bu phra mo 'byung ba'i nad la ni thog mar mtshon gyis bzhar la bca' sga dang rgyam tsha gnyis kyi phye ma btab ste de'i 'og tu chu dron gyis bkru'o seng ldeng dang atta ka zhes bya ba tu ba ri dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i bsdus khu la shing kun sga dang rgyam tshwa kha tshar btab rlung nad kun 'joms khyad par mgo rlung sel sga dang shing kun bsdus pa'i khu ba la kha ru tshwa btab rlung nad kun la phan khyad par pho long rlung dang snying rlung sel sga dang go snyod dza ti bsdus pa'i thang rlung nad

pairs.d4310: de lta bu ni mthong ba dang nyi zla 'khyims dang me dang ni smig rgyu 'ja' tshon mthong bar 'gyur
pairs.d4311: mthong ba'i mig gi 'bras bu khar ba phyis pa ltar sngon por snang zhing gzugs kyang de ltar mthong ba dang nyi ma dang zla ba 'khyims pa dang me dang smig rgyu dang 'ja' tshon rnams mthong ba yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: ltar rkyen des lo dang zla ba ru nad de zungs su 'dres shing zhen pa yis lcags la btsa' ma ras la snum zhen nam shing la sra rtsi btang 'dra gting 'don dka' yun ring lon phyir tsha ba rnyings zhes bya rnyings tshad dbye ba spyi dang

pairs.d4310: nim pa skyer pa pa to la pu tse shel dang pu shel tsi 'bras bu gsum dang ba sha ka byi tshe rab dang kyi lce ba par pa ta ni srang re yin
pairs.d4311: yang na pa to la dang nim pa dang pu tse shel dang skyer pa dang pu shel tse dang 'bras bu gsum dang ba sha ka dang byi tsher ba dang kyi lce ba dang sro lo dang 'di rnams srang re re dang skyu ru ra srang bcu drug dang chu srang lnga brgya rtsa bcu gnyis dang lhan cig bskol te bzhi cha srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad lus pa'i nang du gla sgang dang tig ta dang shing mngar dang
pairs.rgyud_text: shi dug nyung dom mkhris skyer pa brag zhun pa to la bdun pa ba sha kas 'phul btang lud pa smug nag mcher pa'i gab 'khrugs yin gi wam gur kum ba le mtshal a ru lnga pa se rul thang gis dbul mchin mcher gnyis la ru thung g.yas g.yon gtar lud pa sre'o mkhal ma'i gab 'khrugs yin btsod khus brag zhun gur kum sug smel a ru gla rtsi usgranal bong dkar tig ta brgyad 'phul byin gzhug gtar rtsa 'khrugs lud pa dmar la theng por lu dom

pairs.d4310: 'bras bu gsum gyi khu bar bcas 'thungs na rab rib thams cad 'joms shing mngar ra mnye ba gnyis dang kanda ka ri pi pi ling a ru ra dang utpa la
pairs.d4311: kha ra'am sbrang rtsi dang 'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba dang de gsum gang yang rung ba dang lhan cig 'thungs na rab rib thams cad 'joms so yang na shing mngar dang ra mnye ba rnam gnyis dang kanda ka ri dang pi pi ling dang a ru ra dang utpa la dang kha ra dkar po dang rgun 'bru dang 'di rnams srang re re dang mar dang ra'i 'o ma srang sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum dang ba sha ka dang bring ga ra dza dang de gsum gyi rang gi khu ba srang sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis dang de rnams lhan cig bskol te mar lus pa ni 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar chen po zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: sde tshan yin sle tres kanda ka ri a ga ru go snyod ru rta gu gul sgog skya rnams rlung dang tshad par ldan pa'i sman sde yin bse yab ma nu 'u su star bu dang utpal se 'bru sga skya skyu ru ra bad kan tsha ba sel ba'i sman sde yin sman sga sga skya shing kun kha ru tshwa btsong sgog bad rlung sel ba'i sman sde yin se 'bru pho ba ris dang pi pi ling sman sga tsi tra ka dang ka ko la sug smel shing tsha 'jam 'bras byi tang ga da lis zi ra nag po la la phud dbyi mong srub ka lce tsha tsabs ru tshwa rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa rwa tshwa thal tshwa rnams bad kan grang ba sel ba'i sman sde yin dza

pairs.d4310: dpral ba mig dang smin ma sogs gtsub shing gis ni gtsubs snyam byed de yang bag med yal bar bor
pairs.d4311: ba dang 'phral ba dang mig dang smin ma la sogs par gtsub shing gis gtsubs pa snyam sems pa yin no de yang bag med pa las yal bar bor na ni mig tu gdung ba 'joms byed ces bya bar 'gyur te
pairs.rgyud_text: sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang skrangs na skyugs btang dmar tsha gtar ga gdab brla rengs ma zhu bad tshil skyes pa'i phyir de la snum 'chos spangs la rtsub bcos bya nas dkar so ba sre zan skam sa'i

pairs.d4310: de mnyam zangs ma'i phye ma zhib tu btags phye ma mig sman thur ma gcig gis kyang rdzi ma bskyed cing mig tshag 'dis sel byed
pairs.d4311: ba bla dang so ba'i la zhes bya ba stang zil dang mnyam pa'i zangs ma'i phye ma zhib tu btags pas mig sman du sbyar na thur ma gcig gis kyang rdzi ma skyed cing mig tshag pa'i nad sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: skyes tshad mthong tshad sman du sbyar thabs zhu 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa las ston pas gsungs pa kye ma legs so drang srong yid las skyes khyod kyis zhus pa'i gtam la de ga bden lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar

pairs.d4310: dbug nyes pa la a sman ta 'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma ni bskol ba'i khu ba blugs par bya rna shal til mar gyis bsku zhing shing mngar btsod dang stag tsher ba
pairs.d4311: rna shal phug nyes pa'i rna ba'i nad la ni a sman ta dang 'dzam bu dang a mra gsum gyi lo ma bskol ba'i khu ba blugs par bya ste de'i 'og tu til mar gyis bskus la shing mngar dang btsod dang pra punda ri ka dang yung ba dang 'di rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye mas gdab po
pairs.rgyud_text: sman mar byin sle tres kabraspya ka ri shu dag dang btsod dang dza ti sug smel pi pi ling yung ba shu mo za dang ra mar gyi 'jam rtsi btang zhing long phugs g.yas g.yon bsreg mkhal rlung mgo tshod shu mo za btab btang rus sna'i khu ba bu ram sbyar bsdus sam bong sha sram sha bur chang zan chang dang rtsa ba lnga yi mar

pairs.d4310: mthon dman med pa nyid du bya zhun mar dang ni sbrang rtsis byug ras bal gyis ni glan pa dang skud pas dam lhod ran par bcing
pairs.d4311: de nas mtshon gyis rna shal bcad pa dang bzhar la ci rigs par mthon dman med par legs par sbyar la zhun mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs la ras bal gyis glan te skud pas mi dam mi lhod par bcing ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: la bcang gnyis pa legs par sbyar la byin gyis brlab rang nyid baidurya 'od rgyal po dang sman gyi snod ni bdud rtsi lhung bzed bsam sman bla drang srong rnams kyis shis pa brjod 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas

pairs.d4310: snabs ni sbyin zhing ser ba dang dri dang ro ni tshor ba yin snar ni rnon po brngubs pa dang nyi 'od skud pa rtsa sogs dang
pairs.d4311: de nyid smin pa'i mtshan ma ni lus yang ba dang sbrid pa zhi ba dang 'dzag pa yang 'jam zhing ser ba dang dri dang ro mi tshor ba rnams yin no de la dud pa rnon po brngubs pa dang nyi ma'i 'od kyis shas cher phog pa dang skud pa dang rtsa la sogs pas snad pas sna'i rmen bu rnyi ma ma rung bar byas pas rlung 'khrugs te rtsa sgo 'gags shing
pairs.rgyud_text: spyod pa skal ldan re re tsam nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla skar zil gnon bzhin rgyud rgyal 'di yis gso rig kun zil gnon 'di ni sngags med pa yi srung skud yin 'chi bdag bdud sde bzlog pa'i 'phrul 'khor yin nad kyi dgra dpung 'joms pa'i dpa' bo yin 'du ba 'phel zad snyoms pa'i spyi pa yin dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i ral gri yin nad kyi zug gzer gcog pa'i tho ba yin sdug bsngal 'dam nas 'dren pa'i

pairs.d4310: sna nad kun las dang por ni rlung med khang par 'dug nas ni snum chos dugs dang skyug sman dang dud pa brngub dang mkhur bkang bsten
pairs.d4311: thog mar nad pa rlung med pa'i khang par bzhag ste snum chos dang dugs dang slon dang du ba brngub pa dang mkhur bar bcang ba de rnams bsten la
pairs.rgyud_text: mgo bsku 'jam rtsi khong du btang rna ba mig dang mkhur bkang sna nas dgang nad dang ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du sbyar bza' ba'i thun tshad me drod 'ju stobs dpag chung 'bring chen po rim

pairs.d4310: bu ram rnying pa srang bskol te ri lur byas pa ni zos na cham pa dbugs mi bde lud pa lu ba 'joms byed cing
pairs.d4311: tsha ba gsum dang bal bu'i lo ma dang dbyi mo dang da trig dang star bu dang tsi tra ka dang zi ra dang de rnams srang gnyis gnyis dang shing tsha dang sug smel dang gan dha bha dra de dag srang phyed phyed dang bu ram rnying pa srang lnga bcu dang tshul bzhin du bskol te ri lur byas pa zos na sna nad cham pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa lu ba rnams 'joms te
pairs.rgyud_text: bu sel bad kan lto sbos dbugs mi bde ba dang cham pa rims gsar 'phral du zlog par byed bskol grang bad kan mi skyed mkhris pa sel zhag gcig lon nas dug 'dra nyes kun skyed chang ni mngar skyur kha la zhu rjes skyur rno dro rtsub phra cung zad thur du 'khru drod 'bar spobs skyed gnyid 'phel bad rlung sel thal drags sems bsgyur bag med ngo tsha 'jig ra ro dang po bag med gnas la gnas rnam rtog ngan bcom bde ba yin snyam

pairs.d4310: nas zan za zhing til mar rnos sna sman dang ni bsku byug bya kha dri nga la slon sman dang dud pa sna sman rnon po gtang btsod dang seng phrom da ta ki
pairs.d4311: kha zas ni nas las byas pa bza' zhing sman rno ba dang sbyar ba'i til mar gyis sna sman dang bsku byug bya'o kha nas rnag 'byung ba la ni du ba brngub pa dang sna sman rnon po gtang bar bya'o btsod dang seng phrom dang da ta ki dang pri yang ku dang shug pa dang de rnams chu dang sbyar bas kha'i nang du bkru bar bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed dom mkhris

pairs.d4310: tsa kra mar da skyer pa seng phrom gyi lde gu gdong la byugs par gyur na ni do khabs sme ba dri ma la sogs sel
pairs.d4311: tsakra marda dang skyer pa dang seng phrom rnams kyis lde gu byas te gdong la bskus na ngo khabs dang sme ba dang dri ma la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad sel zhing gdong pa zla ba ltar mdangs gsal bar 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: ta mkhal ma zho sha dang seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed brag zhun gla rtsi gur kum sug smel dang dom

pairs.d4310: mgo dang rna ba brta bar bya ba ra na sogs sde tshan brdungs 'o ma chu phyed bskol ba yi 'o ma lus pa de bsgrangs la
pairs.d4311: snum dang ldan pa'i sna sman gtang ba dang du ba rngub pa dang de bzhin du mgo bo dang rna ba rnams nyams brta bar bya'o sman ba ra na'i sde tshan 'o ma dang chu dang bskol la 'o ma lus pa dang de bsrubs la mar sar phyung ba dang mngar ba'i sde tshan gyi sman dang yang bskol ba'i khu ba mar des snar blugs pa byas na rab tu bsngags so
pairs.rgyud_text: bzung rtags la bslab pa ni me dang du ba ji bzhin du nad kyi ngos ni rtags la bzung brtag thabs med pa'i sman pa yis rtags nyid rtags su mi shes te du ba rlangs par 'khrul dang 'dra sprin 'dus char 'byung zer ba ltar ma nges rtags su byed pa yod de phyir ngos 'dzin brtag thabs man ngag gces kha dmar bcos la dgos pa'i phyir nyes pa dngos ston brtag pa dang skye bo mkhas zer mgu bya'i

pairs.d4310: til mar bskus na'ang phan pa yin bal bu'i lo ma shug pa dang spang spos ha re nu ka dang a ga ru dang tsandan dang
pairs.d4311: tshil gyis thor bu gso ba'i nad du bshad pa'i 'bru mar gyi bsku byug byas na yang phan no bal bu'i lo ma dang shug pa dang spang spos dang ha re nu ka dang a ka ru dang tsandan dang ser po rnam gnyis dang padma'i sa bon dang pu tse shel dang de rnams til mar dang bskol ba'i khu ba bskus na
pairs.rgyud_text: nang dag tu dza ti gur kum gla rtsi spang spos dang spang rgyan sbyar te lus kun bkrus rjes byug yang na gla rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang sdig srin mu zi ra khrag bse mar khur yang na ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dang gla rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra khrag byug ba spu'i sgo 'gags lus sbrid lci ba yin reg pa nyi zer rlangs kyis nyam mi

pairs.d4310: mtshan bar rdol la bskus na ni 'di ni phan byed mchog tu bshad shing mngar seng phrom pi pi ling sug smel ha re nu ka dang
pairs.d4311: su dha kshi ra dang a pa marga dang til mar dang lhan cig bskol te mar lus pa las mtshan mar rdol ba'i nad pa la bsku byug tu byas na 'di ni phan par byed pa'i mchog yin no zhes bshad do shing mngar dang seng phrom dang pi pi ling dang sug smel dang ha ri nu ka dang
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo

pairs.d4310: thum bus dugs byas mnye bar bya sha mi la phug shi kru yi sa bon nas dang yungs kar bcas
pairs.d4311: rgya mtsho'i phye ma dum bur byas la dugs bya ste mkhrang ba mnye bar bya'o sha mi dang la phug dang shi kru dang de rnams kyi sa bon dang nas dang yungs kar dang de rnams btags pa'i phye ma dar ba skyur po dang bcas pas bskus na 'brum chen gyi thor bu dang 'bras nad rnams 'joms par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: 'o sbyar btang rgyam tshwa tsha la la phug sa bon dang cong zhi tsha gsum sbrang la ril bu sbyar ru thung snod ka gung srin bar rtsa gtar rjes la pho gsang mdun rgyab rim pas bsro long 'grams shing kun kha ru tshwa dang ni pi pi ling gi bskol grang thang du btang yang na la phug sa bon kha ru tshwa shing tsha bu ram chang ngam

pairs.d4310: tsandan ser dang rgya skyegs dang tsandan dkar dang nya gro dha'i rkang pa gzhon nu shug pa dang de bzhin padma ge sar dang utpal sngon po btsod dang bcas
pairs.d4311: gur gum dang pu shel tsi dang ka li ya ka dang rgya skyegs dang shing mngar dang tsandan dkar po dang nya gro dha'i rkang pa gzhon nu dang shug pa dang padma ge sar dang utpal dang btsod dang de rnams srang re re chu srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang bskol te bzhi cha lus pa'i nang du rgya skyegs dang le brgan rtsi dang btsod dang shing mngar dang gur gum dang de rnams zho gnyis gnyis btags pa'i phye ma dang til mar srang brgyad dang de'i nyis 'gyur gyi 'o ma dang tshul bzhin bskol te mar lus pa las sna sman goms par byas na ni ling ga dang ngo shig dang skra dkar dang gnyer ma dang sme bas ma rungs par gyur pa rnams 'joms te gdong gi sha mdog skye bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: sel na ga pushpa na ga ge sar dang padma ge sar glo mchin snying tshad sel zi ra dkar pos glo yi tshad pa sel zi ra nag pos mchin pa'i grang ba sel la la phud kyis pho nad grang ba sel so ma ra dzas lpags nad chu ser sel thal ka rdo rje dag kyang de bzhin no gser gyi me tog snod tshad mkhris tshad sel gser gyi phud bus mkhris pa gyen du 'dren dug mo nyung gis mkhris sel tsha 'khru gcod rgun 'brum glo nad sel zhing tshad pa sbyong 'u sus pho ba'i bad kan tsha ba sel star bus glo brko khrag 'ju bad kan gcod bse yab bad kan tsha ba sel bar byed se 'brus pho ba'i nad rnams ma lus sel me drod skyed cing bad kan grang nad 'joms na le sham gyis bad kan grang ba sel

pairs.d4310: bdun par sna sman dud pa dang spyi bor rgya gram byas nas ni sha'am khrag ni gzhug par bya ko sha ta ki lang ga li
pairs.d4311: gnas skabs bdun pa la ni sna sman bud pa dang spyi bor rgya gram du dbral te de'i nang du sha 'am khrag gzhug par bya'o ko sha ta ki dang langga li dang pa tha dang lcam pa dang sle tres dang a ru ra dang she lu dang shri sha dang ge ri karni ka dang yung ba dang a ha dang ba spru ba dang sbrang rtsi dang tsha ba gsum dang bri ha ti rnam gnyis dang thal tres dang ba la dang de rnams bskol ba'i khu ba las gzhi blangs pa'i 'bras thug grang ba'i nang du mar dang sbrang rtsi dang bcas pas slon khrus la sogs pa'i las byed pa'i 'og tu dug 'joms pa'i sman 'di thams cad sbyar ro
pairs.rgyud_text: spa 'bru gze ma lcam pa ba spru ba ra'i mar la sdig srin gur kum bu ram pa'i mar sbyar dugs lums bya rjes la zas skom drod bsten mkhal gsang bsreg pho bar 'grams na spyang tsher chig skyugs bya mcher 'grams 'ol se so cha 'o sbyar btang rgyam tshwa tsha la la phug sa bon dang cong zhi tsha gsum sbrang la ril bu sbyar ru thung snod ka gung srin bar rtsa gtar rjes la pho gsang mdun rgyab rim pas bsro long 'grams shing kun kha ru tshwa dang ni pi pi ling gi bskol grang thang du btang yang na la phug sa bon kha ru tshwa shing tsha bu ram chang ngam phye ma shing kun cur nis sbyar long rtsa gtar zhing gur kum a ru dbyi mong bsdus

pairs.d4310: myur du snying la phan byed bya zug rngu phyung la lcags bsregs pas rma ni legs par bsreg par bya yang na mu ka ka dang ni gi ri karni dkar po dang kad pa la yi shun pa dang
pairs.d4311: dug mdas gnad du ma bsnun pa med pa myur du snying ga'i phyogs su bsil ba'i cho ga rnams bya ste zug rngu phyung la de'i 'og tu lcags bsregs pas rma bsreg par bya'o yang na mu ka ka dang ge ri ka dkar po dang kad pha la'i shing shun dang de rnams tam mra bal li dang shi ri sha dang grid da na khya dang 'di rnams kyi thal bas bsreg go
pairs.rgyud_text: mtshams rnams bsreg de ltar cho ga 'di rnams bsten gyur na rlung nad du ma ma lus 'joms par nges bye brag gso thabs rigs gnas nang tshegs gsum rlung nad rigs kyi sgo nas bcos pa ni a wa rta la snum dugs byas pa'i rjes sna sbyongs rno bas dbugs rgyu'i bu ga bsal de yi rjes la rgya shug 'o ma zho sha khu mar khu bskol ba'i dwangs ma blud rgya shug thang shing sle tres rtsa ba lnga ru

pairs.d4310: bkres skom nyam ni chung ba dang khro dang mya ngan 'jigs dang ngal ma zhu ba dang 'khru ba dang mkhris pa rlung ni 'phel ba dang til gyi me tog 'bras bu snum
pairs.d4311: byi sha sa ka zhes bya ba'i dbyig dug gi nad la bsrung bar bya ba ni bkres pa dang skom pa dang tsha ba dang nyam chung ba dang khro ba dang mya ngan dang 'jigs pa dang ngal ba dang ma zhu ba dang 'khru ba dang gang yang mkhris pa dang rlung 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu dang til mar gyi me tog dang 'bras bu snom pa dang sa'i rlangs pa snom pa dang 'brug gi sgra dang glang po che dang byi ba'i sgra dang rol mo'i sgra dang nyan pa dang shar phyogs kyi rlung dang utpa la'i dri snom pa dang gang yang myos par 'gyur ba'i bag bsten na dug 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin te spang bar bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: snyan par sgrog pa rtsa ba na glang po che dang dom dang gla ba la sogs pa sman bzang po yod pa'i sems can tshang bar gnas pa sman gyi rigs su gyur pa la ma 'khrungs pa'am ma tshang ba med pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'o gzhal yas khang de'i dbus na nor bu bai durya'i gdan la ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman gyi bla baidurya 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so ston pa de la 'khor ni lha dang drang srong dang phyi pa dang nang pa'i 'khor bzhis yongs su bskor ba ste gang zhe na lha'i 'khor ni 'di lta ste lha'i sman pa skye rgu'i bdag po myur ba dang lha'i sman pa tha skar dang lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang lha

pairs.d4310: shing tsha ldong ros rgya spos nyung ku sha'i khu ba chu srin sen ta ma la yi ge sar dang 'bras bu chu grang sbyar ba blud
pairs.d4311: shing tsha dang ldong ros dang yung ba dang rgya spos dang ku sha'i khu ba dang chu srin sen mo dang ta ma la'i ge sar dang 'bras kyi chu grang mo dang lhan cig sbyar ba blud na dug thams cad 'joms te
pairs.rgyud_text: stag sha ha bo dang yung ba gang ga chung dang re ral dang 'om bu spang rgyan spang rtsi do bo dang se rgod skyer pa'i bar shun dug sman sde cu gang shing mngar rgun 'brum star bu dang ru rta ga dur a krong sro lo dkar sug 'dra la

pairs.d4310: yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste sum cu brgyad pa'o yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las gnas drug pa ste tha ma rdzogs so
pairs.rgyud_text: lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyud bzhi'i mjug don bsdus pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags dang po nad shugs ma rdzogs mngon tshul dus gso ba byas kyang

pairs.d4310: dpal dang gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur khyad par du ni mdze nad sha bkra skran dug dang dbyig dug rims dang smyo byed dang
pairs.d4311: zhu ba'i tshod tsam na kha zas mar shas che ba sbrang rtsi dang ldan pa zos la tshul de bzhin du nyin re bzhin lo gcig gi bar du bsten na blo brtan pa dang dran pa dang yid gzhungs pa dang rga bas zil gyis gnon pa dang nad kyis zil gyis non pa dang sgyid skyur ba dang snyom pa dang ngal ba dang dub pa dang nad med cing lo brgya brgya yongs su rdzogs par 'tsho bar 'gyur ro dpal dang gzi brjid dang mdangs dang ldan pa dang lhag par mdze dang sha bkra dang skran dang dug dang rims dang smyo byed dang dbyig dug dang dmu rdzing rnams las zlog par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: pi ling bskol thang ma zhu gsar dang rims nad dang lhag par pho mchin nad rnams sbyong ba'i mchog a ru mchu ring ba ru skyu ru ra lcum rtsa dur byid spos dkar ba chur bsdus rgyun sbyongs dreg dang grum bu chu ser dang rnyogs tshad rnyings tshad lus la zhen pa sbyong btang tshul thang phye ril bu sman mar bzhi rgas dang zungs ngan rnams la bskol thang shis de yis btang bzhag ran par tshod zin 'gyur zungs bzang nad rgyas phye ma ril bu shis de yang skyug pa rnams la ril bu btang shin tu lto sra skyug lang yod pa la sman mar sbyar te gsangs la rgyun sbyongs bya sman dred yi ga sdar la zas dang sdeb gtong

pairs.d4310: mig gi nad la 'bras bu gsum rab phan dreg nad la ni sle tres rab bsngags shing pho ba'i nad la dar ba gsar pa mchog mdze la seng ldeng snying po bsten pas mchog
pairs.d4311: mig nad la ni 'bras bu gsum phan no dreg nad la ni sle tres phan no pho ba'i nad la ni dar ba phan no mdze nad la ni seng ldeng gi snying po rtag tu bsten par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: bu gcong nad dbye ba gsar rnying gnyis gsar pa bad kan skya bo smug po dang mkhris pa'i nad dang dug gcong rnam pa bzhi skya bo lhen dang lcags dreg me nyams dang mgul 'gags grum bu dkar po 'ju skems drug smug po byer rgyas

pairs.d4310: bsdus don nye bar mtshon byed yin sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las yan lag brgyad bsdus bdud rtsi'i tshogs thob gang
pairs.d4311: de yang drang srong chen po rnams kyi dgongs pa rgya che zhing dri ma med pa rnams kyi lugs dang rjes su mthun pa rgya mtsho chen po ltar rgya che ba'i yan lag bsdus pa'i don gnyis nye bar mtshon pa yin no sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba las bsrubs te yan lag brgyad pa bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i phung po dang 'dra ba 'di phyung ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: 'brel klad pa rtsa yi rgya mtsho chen po las rtsa ba lta bur thur du zug pa yi bya ba byed pa'i chu rtsa bcu dgu yod de yang don snod nang du 'brel pa yi dar gyi dpyangs thag bcu gsum sbas pa'i rtsa yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa drug ste de las chu rtsa phran bu bcu drug gyes mi la tshe yi rtsa ni gsum yod de gcig ni mgo lus thams cad khyab par gnas gcig

pairs.d4310: sman pa'i bdag po dge 'dun gsang ba zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha gol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las
pairs.rgyud_text: ste 'khyam pa yin rlung khrag rgyu ba'i bu ga phyi nang kun 'brel byas lus ni skyed cing gnas pa dang srog gi rtsa ba yin phyir rtsa zhes bya gnyan pa'i gnad la sha tshil rus

pairs.d4310: nyi ma'i zer gyis gdungs pa dang zla ba'i 'od kyis bsil byas la r i shi shar bas dug med pa
pairs.d4311: gzhan yang 'bras sa lu dkar po dang mon sran sde'u dang skyu ru ra dang pa to la dang sbrang rtsi dang yul ser che ba nas byung ba'i bya na dang kha zas ni chu nyin par nyi mas gdungs pa mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od kyis bsil bar byas la skar ma r i shi shar bas dug med par byas par gyur pa de lta bu'i chu nyin mtshan gnyi gar kun sbyangs pa'i chu gtsang ma ngang pa gnas pa dri ma med cing chu dngas ma 'thungs na bad kan du yang mi 'gyur
pairs.rgyud_text: spyod pa skal ldan re re tsam nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla skar zil gnon bzhin rgyud rgyal 'di yis gso rig kun zil gnon 'di ni sngags med pa yi srung skud yin 'chi bdag bdud sde bzlog pa'i 'phrul 'khor yin nad kyi dgra dpung 'joms pa'i dpa' bo yin 'du ba 'phel zad snyoms pa'i spyi pa yin dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i ral gri yin nad kyi zug gzer gcog pa'i tho ba yin sdug bsngal 'dam nas 'dren pa'i lcags kyu yin 'chi ba'i srog skyob mi 'jigs sbyin pa yin 'chi ba slong byed bdud rtsi bum pa yin drang srong

pairs.d4310: bri ha ti gnyis byi dang ga gandha bha dra sug smel dang ha re nu ka padma yi ge sar dang ni ba la ste sman ni 'di rnams cha mnyam la
pairs.d4311: de la sna nas gtang ba'i sman mar sbyar ba ni dzi ban ti dang dza la dang sgron shing dang gla sgang chen po dang shing tsha dang pu shel tsi dang go yu dang tsandan dkar po dang skyer ba'i rtsa ba dang shing mngar dang gla ba dang a ka ru dang nye'u shing dang pun da dang bil ba dang utpal dang dha ban ti dang u ra bhi dang thi ra dang byi dang ga zhes bya ba srin bu gsod pa dang gandha bha dra dang sug smel dang ha re nu ka dang padma'i ze ba ge sar dang ba la dang sman 'di rnams sna tshang bar ci snyed du sbyar te cha snyoms la til mar ci tsam btso ba de las chu ni char pa'i chu brgya 'gyur du bskyed pa'i nang du sman brdungs la btsos te chu'i khu ba srang dgu bcu ni du
pairs.rgyud_text: btang yang na kha ru tshwa dang dza ti dang mar rnying sbyar ba sum yar btang bar bya des ma thub na dza ti gsum mam lnga kha ru tsha la zho bzhi bur srang gcig mar rnying srang bdun lde gur byas te btang mi rus bsdus khur sgog skya shing kun bran mthil bzhi tshigs pa rlung gsang sku mnye dang rlung gsang bzhi bsro mar rnying 'jam rtsi bya sha chang mar rnying bu ram drod bcud bsten byis pa bad kan grang shas che ba dang bad kan yul du tsha ba babs pa dang ma smin gtar bsil tsha ba byer rkyen 'dom tshad gzhug mi mngon grang rtags kha yar 'ong rtsa dal chu mdog sngo la dang ga 'gag lce rlon gdong skya kha zas 'ju ba dka' bag la nyal bas grang bar 'khrul ba yod de la brten nas zas glod tsha bar ldog ha cang thal drags dmu chur 'gyur ba yod de

pairs.d4310: lto bsrubs mgul pa lte ba dang sha srab phyogs dang rlig pa dang pho mtshan bu ga sen mo phrag
pairs.d4311: rims dang tshad pa dang snying na ba dang mgul pa yan chad kyi nad dang skya rbab kyi nad dang yi ga 'chus pa dang mig rab rib khyer ba dang bkru sman gyis bkrus pa dang lus thams cad skrangs pa'i 'or nad dang thal sman gyis skrag ste 'thung mi phod pa dang bud med sbrum ma dang mo mtshan skrangs te na ba dang kha zas ma zhu ba dang byis pa dang mi rgan po dang rtsa bo che rnams dang rus pa'i tshigs dang gnad dang mi gzhon nu'i rus pa dang rtsa dang chu ba dang lto srubs thog thag dang mgul pa dang lte ba dang sha gar chung ba'i nyen 'khor dang rlig pa dang pho mtshan dang bu ga'i sbu gu rnams dang sen mo'i phrag dang rlig rlugs dang rnam pa 'di rnams la thal sman ksha ra gtang du mi rung ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: gnas lus kyi dang po lte ba chags drug pa lte ba la brten srog rtsa chags bdun par mig gi dbang po gzugs su dod brgyad pa de la brten nas mgo dbyibs chags dgu par lus dbyibs khog pa stod smad chags zla ba gsum pa bdun phrag bcu pa la dpung pa gnyis dang dpyi gnyis 'bur du dod bcu gcig dbang po dgu yi gzugs dbyibs dod bcu gnyis pa la don lnga'i gzugs dbyibs dod bcu gsum pa la snod drug gzugs dbyibs dod zla ba bzhi pa bdun phrag bcu bzhi la dpung rkang brla rkang bzhi po'i gzugs dbyibs dod bco lnga pa la rkang lag rje ngar dod bcu drug pa la sor mo nyi shu dod bcu bdun phyi nang 'brel ba'i rtsa rnams chags zla lnga bdun phrag bco brgyad sha tshil chags bcu dgu pa la chu ba rgyus pa chags nyi shu pa la rus dang rkang mar chags rtsa

pairs.d4310: 'bru gnag bu ram dar ba dang lan tshwa chang rnying pags pa dang yungs kar zhag dang 'bru mar dang rtswa dang 'dam bu bud shing dang ma ning mi srun sme sha can rgya dag dang ni rnyi rnams dang slon dang bshang ba gtong ba dang rnag dang mtshan ma ngan pa mthong snying po med dang 'khrig pa spyod
pairs.d4311: 'bru nag po dang bu ram dang dar ba dang lan tshwa dang btung ba dang pags pa dang yungs kar dang zhag dang 'bru mar dang rtswa dang 'dam dang bud shing dang ma ning dang rigs ngan pa dang rgya dang rnyi dang slon pa dang bshang ba dang rnag dang de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ngan pa mthong ba dang snying po med pa dang 'khrig pa spyod pa dang
pairs.rgyud_text: dbyi mong srub ka'i 'bras bu rnams 'o ma mar dang zhag la 'dag pa bya nus ldan bsregs thal sug smel pi pi ling se 'bru sdig srin lcam pa sram gyi brun kha tshar btab la 'du ba'i rta dang sbyar dmu chu rgya mtsho tsam yang skem par nus thal sbyor thal sman 'jam po sum gnyis la btsan dug a ru bcu gcig pho 'gron bdun cu gang gur kum tsha ba rnam pa lnga tshwa sna tshogs

pairs.d4310: de bzhin phyugs gcig btags pa dang gdu bu me long yungs kar dang gi wang rnams ni mthong ba dang
pairs.d4311: rma bya dang phyugs gcig btags pa mthong ba dang gdu bu dang me long dang yungs kar dang gi'u wang dang 'di rnams mthong ba dang bdug pa'i dri dang byug pas byugs pa dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'i khu bcud dang khyu mchog dang mthun pa'i skad snyan pa sgrogs pa dang dang bya dang mi rnams kyi skad snyan pa dang de bzhin du gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgrengs pa mthong ba dang rgyal ba dang bkra shis par gyur cig pa'i skad snyan pa thos pa dang rdza rnga dang rnga bo che dang dung dang
pairs.rgyud_text: mas tshil dang bad kan sel ka ragrad dang yungs dkar ba gcin byug tshil dang bad kan zad bya'i drag shul brtsam zad nas kha zas glod de snum 'chos bya gzugs 'khums sra 'theng bi sha tse sogs la ra sna mu la dong gra tsi tra ka pi pi ling dang zur pa ma nu yi phye ma mar bskol thogs med 'gro nus 'gyur bi sha tse dang gzugs 'khums gar yod ngos mthe'u chung srin lag rgyab kyi rgyus pa la ser po snal ma 'dra ba yod de bcad sra 'theng la sogs phyi ma'i rlung rnams kun rgyu las brtags la snum dugs gtar ba

pairs.d4310: bem bem por ni gyur pa dag bad kan rlung 'khrugs las gyur pa rkang pa brtse bar de bshad do
pairs.d4311: rkang pa gnyis brtse ste tshor ba bem bem por gyur pa ni bad kan dang rlung 'khrugs pa yin te de ni rkang pa brtse ba'i rlung nad ces bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: gar chang chu skol ni bad kan nad gzhi can gyis bsten par bya rlung la dro sar yid 'ong grogs bsten zhing mkhris pa'i nad la bsil sar dal bar bsdad bad kan nad la rtsol bcag dro

pairs.d4310: dzi ban ti dang gla sgang dang bye'u rug pa dang shing tsha dang sug smel gnyis dang ma nu dang lca ba ta ma ma li ka a ru ra dang ga bra'i rtsa dong ga dang ni ba la ka zur pa kar ka ta sring gi
pairs.d4311: bad kan shas che ba'i skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba sel to dzi ban ti dang gla sgang dang bye'u rug pa dang dwa tsha dang sug smel rnam gnyis dang tsantra dang ta ma la ki dang a ka ru dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang dong gra dang ba la ka dang kar ka ta sring gi dang zur pa dang pi pi ling dang na ga ge sar dang tsa rong dang de rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma'i nyis 'gyur gyi sha kha ra dang bza' ba dang btung ba'i nang du btab ste ci 'dod pa zos na rtsib logs na ba dang
pairs.rgyud_text: shes par gyis shig mi na ba gnas par 'dod pa dang na ba gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o tshe ring bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o chos dang nor dang bde ba sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o 'gro ba gang zhig nad kyi sdug bsngal las thar bar 'dod pa dang gzhan gyi spyi bos bkur bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang de'i tshe de'i dus na

pairs.d4310: bza' ba yi ga 'byed pa'i mchog de las rlung 'gyur yi ga 'chus ha re nu dang pi pi ling byi dang ga dang ra sna dang rgyam tsha dang ni dong gra dang sug smel ga bra'i rtsa ba dang nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang shing kun bcas pa mar ram ni
pairs.d4311: yang na zla ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i zas kha ra dkar po dang ga pur dang ldan par byas te zos na yi ga 'byed pa'i mchog yin no de la rlung las gyur pa'i yi ga 'chus pa la ni ha re nu ka dang pi pi ling dang byi dang ga dang ra sna dang rgyam tsha dang dong gra dang sug smel dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang shing kun dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma chang gi dngas ma'am
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong rngam pa bde sna rdog mnyen zhing chu mdog dmar ser dang rtsa rgyud phyi grims khong lhod tha mal grangs lce steng ser la skam

pairs.d4310: tsha dang bcas pa'i skom dad dang snying dang brang ni na ba la sle tres ga dur bskol ba'am yang na pa to la bskol khu
pairs.d4311: lud pa khrag dang lhan cig 'byung la rtsib logs gnyis dang nu ma rnams su zug cing lus tsha ba skyes te skom dad che ba dang snying dang brang rnams su na ba la ni sle tres dang ga dur dang pa to la bskol ba'i khu ba gang yang rung ba bca' sga dang lhan cig sbyar ba btung ngo
pairs.rgyud_text: gser me mtshon cha pa to la chibs su ka ra bcas pas nad yul 'don tsha ba smin dus ga bur gi wam bsnan snod du babs na brag zhun dug mo nyung bcos brdugs tsha la gur kum mde kha bsgyur dri che kha dog dmar ser nad thon rtags tsha grang chu lcag brabs la dag par sbyang sbyang ba ma dag bskyar la sbyang ba gces ma

pairs.d4310: bsku byug bsil dang nor bu dang chus gtor rlung yab kyis g.yab byed kha ra rgun 'brum bu ram shing 'bra go tang pal khu ba dang
pairs.d4311: brgyal ba dang myos pa thams cad la ni bsil ba'i byug pas bsku zhing nor bu chu nang du bcug pa'i chus gtor te rlung yab kyis g.yab po rgun 'brum dang bu ram shing dang 'bra go dang tang pal dang 'di rnams kyi khu ba 'o ma dang bskol ba kha ras btab pa blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: skyabs dang khur tshod chab tsha chu bsil dang bskol grang mkhris pa'i nad kyi zas su bshad lug dang g.yag rgod gcan gzan nya yi sha sbrang rtsi skam sa'i 'bru rnying zan dron dang 'bri yi zho dar gar chang chu skol ni bad kan nad gzhi can gyis bsten par bya rlung la dro sar yid 'ong grogs bsten zhing mkhris pa'i nad la

pairs.d4310: rgun 'bru rtsa yi rtsa ba lnga bskol ba'i nang du sbrang rtsi dang kha rab btab pa blud par bya ba sha ka dang ga gon dang
pairs.d4311: nye'u shing dang gze ma dang ba ta ri dang rgun 'bru dang rtsa'i rtsa ba dang 'di rnams tshul bzhin bskol ba'i nang du sbrang rtsi dang sha kha ra btab pa blud do ba sha ka dang ga gon dang er ba ru dang le brgan rtsi 'di gsum gyi sa bon dang gur kum dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma rgun chu dang sbyar ba 'thungs na gcin 'gags pa'i nad thams cad sel to
pairs.rgyud_text: phyen 'gags pa la bya kr i dang gze ma 'o ma bur rnying bskol ba phan mdog sngo sha skam dang ga bde ba na tsha ba phyi ru byer bas chu lcag phan rtsa khrid na 'phreng lci na cung zad gtar tshigs gzhi rus pa na skrangs chu lums bya rims rjes sna rtsa skrangs na gang nye gtar gur kum ka ra mar gsar sna sman btang brag zhun stag sha hong len dri chu byug ko ler na zhing gzer na

pairs.d4310: blud na rde'u ni 'jig par byed shi kru'i rtsa ba bskol ba ni dro 'jam 'thungs pas rde nad 'joms til dang a pa marga dang chu shing dang ni pa la sha
pairs.d4311: zhag bdun gyi bar du 'thungs na rde'u 'joms par byed do shi kru'i rtsa ba bskol ba dro 'jam tsam 'thungs na rde'u gnas nas skyod par byed do til dang a pa marga dang chu shing dang pa la sha dang 'di rnams kyi thal ba lug gi gcin dang lhan cig 'thungs na phye mar chags pa'i rde'u chags pa gnyis 'joms par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: dang skra dang kha spu bregs gshin dang lhan cig chang 'thung des 'drud dang gos dang phreng ba dmar pos brgyan pa yi gshin po dag dang lhan cig gar byed pa de dag 'chi bdag dbang du song ba'i ltas de la sogs te rmi lam mi bzang ba yid 'jug bu ga nad kyis bkag phyir mthong rgyun du rmi ba'i nad pa 'chi 'gyur te nad med ma nges rim gros thar

pairs.d4310: go bye ka ranydza'i rtsa ba ba ra na yi rtsa ba dang pi pi ling rtsa ma nu'i rtsa re re srang ni bcu bcu dang nas dang rgya shug rgya sran las
pairs.d4311: snu hi dang ar ka'i rtsa ba dang a ru ra dang bhu ka dam pa dang bse shing gi 'bras bu dang ka ranydza'i rtsa ba dang ba ra na'i rtsa ba dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang ma nu'i rtsa ba dang 'di rnams srang bcu bcu dang nas dang rgya shug dang rgya sran 'di rnams srang bcu drug bcu drug dang chu bre nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang tshul bzhin du bskol nas bzhi cha lus pa'i nang du pi pi ling rnam gnyis dang dbyi mo dang ni tsu la dang ro hi ta ka dang dur byid dang byi dang ga dang kam pi lya dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang de rnams btags pa'i phye ma dang mar bre gang dang yang tshul bzhin du bskol te mar lus pa ni thang la 'bar gyis bshad pa'i mar zhes bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: chang rkyang pa sbrang rtsi bre gang dang chu bre drug bsres btsos la rnga mas btsags bre dor gdu nas chu bre gang blug la ngad bsad gzar bus phyar te 'o drod tsam phabs rdog snyim gang gris drad rnga mar phur cong zhi'i gting rdo lding thag shing la gtod sug smel thun gcig btags la btab ste mnan zhag dus bsros kyin zhag gsum bar du bzhag langs na skyur mnam lbu ba phyir gyis 'ong de la tsha ba gsum po kha tshar btab dgong dang tho rangs ja sun tsam re bsten rlung tshabs chu ser bsdongs nas tshigs byer sel rus tshad mkhal tshad rlung ldan chu ser 'don khug pa chu ser rlung ldan bu ram bsnan yongs rdzogs chu ser tsha ba seng ldeng bsnan me tog kun dang khyad par g.yar mo thang btus skams bum par bsdigs la chu yis bsing khu ba bzhur te sbrang rtsi

pairs.d4310: ba ri na yi myu gu dang shi kru bil ba gzhon nu dang la phug gzhon nu skam po dang kha lung shing kun star bu dang se 'bru nas tshig 'khus thal ba tsha ba gsum dang ngar ba dang mar dang til mar kha zas sbyin
pairs.d4311: rgya sran dang srog chags thang las skyes pa'i sha dang pu ti ka ranydza dang tsi tra ka dang a ga ni man tha dang la la phud dang parna dang 'di rnams kyi myu gu dang shi kru dang bil ba gzhon nu dang la phug skam po gzhon nu dang kha lung dang shing kun dang star bu dang nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang se'u 'bru dang tsha ba gsum dang dar ba dang mar dang til mar dang 'di rnams dang ci ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du kha zas sbyar ro
