pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal rma 'tsho zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod stobs skyed tshe 'phel snum pa'i mchog ste las stong byed phrum gsar spri dang phyur ba la sogs pa dang ga

pairs.d4310: skran ni myur du sel bar byed slon dang smyung ba dugs dang ni sman mar blud dang bkru sman dang 'jam rtsi thal sman mnan chang dang
pairs.d4311: go snyod dang lce myang tsha dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma chang ngam chang gi snyigs ma dang bsres te 'thungs na bad kan las gyur pa'i skran myur du sel to gal te slon dang smyung ba dang dugs dang sman mar dang bkru sman dang 'jam rtsi dang thal sman dang
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag

pairs.d4310: phye ma sbrang rtsis sbrus pa yis skya rbab dug dang lud pa lu gcong chen mi bzad rims dang ni mdze dang ma zhu gcin sri dang skran dbugs mi bde yi ga 'chus khyad par du ni brjed byed dang mig ser gzhang 'brum nad rnams 'joms
pairs.d4311: yang na ta bya dang brag zhun dang dngul dang lcags kyi dri ma dang de rnams srang lnga dang tsi tra ka dang 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum dang byi dang ga dang de rnams srang re re dang sha kha ra srang brgyad dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba zos na skya rbab dang dug dang lud pa dang gcong chen po dang rims mi bzad pa dang mdze dang ma zhu ba dang gcin nad dang skrang ba dang dbugs mi bde ba dang yi ga 'chus pa rnams la phan te khyad par du brjed byed kyi nad dang mig ser dang gzhang 'brum rnams 'joms par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: chen po nyon cig glo gcong chen po zad byed rgyu dang ni dbye ba rtags dang de yi bcos thabs bzhi rgyu ni bshang gci phyen dbugs bkag pa dang dwangs ma la sogs lus zungs snum zad dang drag shul zas skom mi mthun bsten pa yis rlung mkhris bad kan nyes pa 'khrugs gyur te lus kun khyab cing bu ga 'khrug pa dang me drod nyams pas dwangs ma ma smin te dri mar gyur pas lus zungs zad par byed de phyir gcong chen zad byed ces byar bshad dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kan rnam gsum ste gcong chen nad kyi bla gnyan drug tu bshad de yi rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis spyi rtags dang po bar dang tha

pairs.d4310: ki shu ka dang pi la sha 'bras bu gsum dang seng phrom dang na li ka dang thang shing dang spang spos ko sha ta ki dang bong nga ta la'i lo ma dang dza yan ti dang 'ol ma se
pairs.d4311: yan lag phyogs gcig skrangs pa la ni ba spru ba dang ka ra bi ra dang king shu ka dang byi sha la dang 'bras bu gsum dang seng phrom dang na li ka zhes bya ba ka po da tsa ra na dang thang shing dang spang spos dang ko sha ta ki dang bong nga dkar po dang ta la'i lo ma dang dza yan ti zhes bya ba tang ga ri dang 'ol ma se dkar po dang ka ka da ni dang sa la'i shing dang dbyi mo dang bri sha kar ni dang bri ti dang rid dhi dang hasti kar na zhes bya ba e randa dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma chu dro 'jam tsam dang lde gur byas te bskus na phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: nang dag tu dza ti gur kum gla rtsi spang spos dang spang rgyan sbyar te lus kun bkrus rjes byug yang na gla rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang sdig srin mu zi ra khrag bse mar khur yang na ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dang gla rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra khrag byug ba spu'i sgo 'gags lus sbrid lci ba yin reg pa nyi zer rlangs kyis nyam mi nga zhes gsungs so de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags rgyud 'dir ma tshang gso dpyad mi bdog gam de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa bde gshegs rnams kyis sprul pas 'gro don du rgya gar yul du sman gyi sbyor ba gsungs rgya nag yul

pairs.d4310: 'bras bu gsum dang seng phrom dang na li ka dang thang shing dang spang spos ko sha ta ki dang bong nga ta la'i lo ma dang dza yan ti dang 'ol ma se
pairs.d4311: yan lag phyogs gcig skrangs pa la ni ba spru ba dang ka ra bi ra dang king shu ka dang byi sha la dang 'bras bu gsum dang seng phrom dang na li ka zhes bya ba ka po da tsa ra na dang thang shing dang spang spos dang ko sha ta ki dang bong nga dkar po dang ta la'i lo ma dang dza yan ti zhes bya ba tang ga ri dang 'ol ma se dkar po dang ka ka da ni dang sa la'i shing dang dbyi mo dang bri sha kar ni dang bri ti dang rid dhi dang hasti kar na zhes bya ba e randa dang 'di rnams btags pa'i phye ma chu dro 'jam tsam dang lde gur byas te bskus na phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: nang dag tu dza ti gur kum gla rtsi spang spos dang spang rgyan sbyar te lus kun bkrus rjes byug yang na gla rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang sdig srin mu zi ra khrag bse mar khur yang na ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dang gla rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra khrag byug ba spu'i sgo 'gags lus sbrid lci ba yin reg pa nyi zer rlangs kyis nyam mi nga zhes gsungs so de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags rgyud 'dir ma tshang gso dpyad mi bdog gam de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa bde gshegs rnams kyis sprul pas 'gro don du rgya gar yul du sman gyi sbyor ba gsungs rgya nag yul

pairs.d4310: bzhar zhing lus ni bskus gyur na pags pa'i nad dang mdze nad dang skrang dang skya rbab mdze nad 'joms ka ra bi ra nim pa dang dug mo nyung dang dong gra dang
pairs.d4311: lus bkru ba dang byug pa dang des bzhar ba dang slon khrus kyang byas na pags pa'i nad dang mdze dang skrang pa dang skya rbab kyi nad rnams kyang 'joms so ka ra bi ra dang nim pa dang dug mo yungs dang dong ga dang tsi tra ka dang 'di rnams kyi rtsa ba ba gcin dang lhan cig bskol te
pairs.rgyud_text: mo pi pi ling dang dong gra cha re bskyed a ru kun mnyam phye ma me dang 'dra ma zhu bad rlung grang skran 'joms par byed bi sha a ru bcu 'gyur pho 'gron bdun cu gang gur kum tsha ba rnam pa lnga tshwa sna lnga dang rgya tshwa pri yangku thal sman zho gsum dri chus 'dam btags bya ril bu byas bsten rgyam tshwa sum thang btang

pairs.d4310: rnags shing yan lag 'drul ba dang lus tsha 'brum bu phra mo 'byung pags pa myags dang bcas pa la bsil ba'i sman chus blugs shing byug gtar ga bkru sman btang ba dang tig ta'i sman mar byin na phan
pairs.d4311: gang gi lus 'drul zhing yan lag chad pa dang lus tsha ba dang 'brum bu byung ba dang pags pa myags pa dang bcas pa la ni bsil ba'i byug pa dang blugs pa dang gtar ga dang bkru sman dang tig ta'i sman mar rnams byin na phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: rlon khrus mas btang dang gtar ga la sogs zla brgyad bar du spang ci phyir mngal 'jig 'chi 'am dku skams 'gyur bzhi pa gor gor mer mer nar nar po de las pho mo ma ning rim par 'gyur de rtags dku lci lus rid yi ga 'gag g.yal rmyang sgyid skyur nu ma skye ba dang

pairs.d4310: dus kun du ni 'phrod pa yin tsha ba gsum dang dri sna gsum gla sgang dang ni byi dang ga skyu ru ra ni de thams cad
pairs.d4311: bar rdol ba dang pho ba'i nad dang skya rbab kyi nad rnams 'joms shing bud med bu med pa la bu yang skye bar byed do tsha ba gsum dang dri sna gsum dang gla sgang dang byi dang ga dang skyu ru ra dang de spyi dang mnyam pa'i dur byid dang de dang mnyam pa'i kha ra dkar po btags pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang ri lur byas pa zos na gcin sri ba dang rims dang skyug pa'i nad dang lud pa dang skem byed dang mgo 'khor ba dang zad byed kyi nad dang lus tsha ba dang skya rbab kyi nad dang me drod chung ba dang dug thams cad la rab tu bsngags so
pairs.rgyud_text: sha rgyas par byed bud med bu med la yang bu rnyed 'gyur gze ma chang sbangs tshad ldan chur bsdus pa'i mar la kha ru tshwa dang tsha ba gsum rgyu long sbo 'khrog mkhal rlung gzer ba 'joms de sogs sman mar mtha' dag sbyar ba'i thabs 'tshos par btsos la khu ba yang yang gdon khu phyin dwangs ma chu bre gsum du bsdus de la bzhos thog 'o ma bre bzhi blug dkrug cing btsos pas chu de 'o mar stim de la tsha sel ba ra mdzo yi mar grang sel 'bri dang lug mar rnying pa gzhug 'o ma mar la thim par bsdus byas te chu chod dwangs snyigs bye nas mdzub mos tshugs mer bcug sgra med tshigs ma dril du btub

pairs.d4310: de las 'o ma blang bar bya bil ba la sogs rtsa ba lnga bri ha ti ni rnam gnyis dang
pairs.d4311: shing de yang lo gnyis sam gsum lon pa dpyid kyi dus su mtshon gyis dral te lo ma dbyung bar bya'o bil ba la sogs pa rtsa ba chen po lnga dang bri ha ti rnam gnyis dang de dag gang yang rung ba re re bskol ba'i khu ba dang mnyam pa'i su dha kshi ra dang bsres te
pairs.rgyud_text: kha ru tshwa ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya mkhris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang da rgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la sna sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang skrangs na skyugs btang dmar tsha gtar ga gdab brla rengs ma

pairs.d4310: dar ba mnan chang pi lu yi khu ba gang yang rung sbyar blud nyam chung skran dang gcin snyi dang dmu rdzing sbyar ba'i dug rnams sbyong
pairs.d4311: de ltar bskams pa dang zho ga chu dang chang dang dar ba dang a sa ba'i chang dang pi lu'i khu ba gang yang rung ba dang lhan cig sbyar te btang na skran dang gcin nad dang dmu rdzing dang sbyar ba'i dug gis lus nyam thog pa la phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: gra btab byas nas nang re btang na skran mkhris mig ser sel thal tsha ya baksha thang sbos pa sel kha ru tshwa yi chig thang pho log 'joms rgyam tshwa'i chig thang ma zhu gsar pa 'ju rgya tshwa'i chig thang dri chu 'gags pa sel rdo thal chig thang pho ba'i bad kan bshig sga yi chig thang

pairs.d4310: bu ram srang brgyad a ru ra nyi shu dan da tsi tra ka srang re pi pi ling dur byid zho ni gnyis gnyis lhan cig sbyar ri lu bcu byas zhag bcu bar ri lu re re zos rjes la
pairs.d4311: bu ram srang brgyad dang a ru ra rdog ma nyi shu dang dan ti dang tsi tra ka srang re re dang pi pi ling dang dur byid zho gnyis dang 'di rnams lhan cig sbyar te ri lu bcur byas la zhag bcu bcu zhing ri lu re re zos te
pairs.rgyud_text: nang par nas rtsa kha phye la zhag dgu re re bskyed snga dro'i zas bsrung lto 'jam drod bcud bsten rdzogs nas nang ma gsum du rtsa kha bsdam de yis lo re'i bar du nyam nga med sman mchog rgyal po kun gyi gnyen po rnam rgyal 'jigs med gang rnyed dang bya ra ba dang 'dred byed 'khren

pairs.d4310: yang na ras dkar la bsgos te bskams la chu dron gyis bkrus la
pairs.d4311: ma zos na ni mkhris pa srog ces bya ba 'byung ba yin pas 'chi bar ston to yang na ras dkar po la khrag gis bsgos te bskams la de'i 'og tu chu dron gyis bkrus na
pairs.rgyud_text: ma mnam bad kan skya 'byar ro mngar bsil ba ste khrag gis rul te bad rlung dum bur chad khrag mkhris rnag 'dra bad mkhris mdud pa can rlung mkhris skam zhing 'dus pa bshang gci 'dra 'di dag skyon res sa bon byed mi

pairs.d4310: e randa'i rtsa srang gsum pa la sha srang gsum rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu dang ra sna ba la sle tres ba spru ba
pairs.d4311: ba la dang pa to la dang rtsa ba chung ngu dang kyi lce ba dang e randa dang nas dang sman de rnams tshul bzhin du bskol ba'i khu ba srang sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang du ra'i sha khu srang sum cu rtsa gnyis bcug la yang bskol te khu ba srang sum cu rtsa gnyis lus pa'i nang du pri yang ku dang pi pi ling dang gla sgang gsum gyi phye mas sman khu'i brgyad cha dang til mar dang mar dang sbrang rtsi dang rgyam tshwa rnams lhan cig bskol te 'jam rtsi mas btang na de ma thag me drod dang nyams stobs dang sha skye bar byed cing mig gsal bar 'gyur ro e randa'i rtsa ba srang gsum dang ba la sha srang gsum dang rtsa ba lnga chung ngu dang ra sna dang ba la dang sle tres dang a shwa gan dha dang ba spru ba dang dong gra dang thang shing dang de rnams srang re re dang po son cha rdog ma brgyad dang de rnams chu srang nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug dang bskol te brgyad cha lus pa'i nang du shu dag dang shu ti dang
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal rma 'tsho zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod stobs skyed tshe 'phel snum pa'i mchog ste las stong byed phrum gsar spri dang phyur ba la sogs pa dang ga len zhing rtug skams bad kan sel zo mar bad rlung sel zhing me drod skyed 'bri dang lug mar de bzhin grang rlung sel mdzo snyoms ba ra bsil bas rlung tshad sel til mar tsha rno skem po sha skyed cing sbom po 'bri la mkhregs te bad rlung sel yungs mar rlung gnon bad mkhris skyed pa yin rkang mar rlung 'joms khu stobs bad kan skyed tshil gyis rus tshigs na dang mes 'tshig dang rlung dang rna klad mngal nad sel bar byed skyes bu snum la brten par byed pa rnams nang gi drod 'bar khong pa dag pa

pairs.d4310: brgyad cha lus par gyur pa de nang du shu dag shu ti ba sha'i 'bras bu dang pri yang ku dang shing mngar pi pi ling dug mo nyung gi sa bon gla sgang dang skyer pa'i khandar bcas pa zhib btags pa
pairs.d4311: rtsa ba lnga chung ngu dang ra sna dang ba la dang sle tres dang a shwa gan dha dang ba spru ba dang dong gra dang thang shing dang de rnams srang re re dang po son cha rdog ma brgyad dang de rnams chu srang nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug dang bskol te brgyad cha lus pa'i nang du shu dag dang shu ti dang spa ma'i 'bras bu dang pri yang ku dang shing mngar dang pi pi ling dang dug mo yungs kyi sa bon dang gla sgang dang skyer khanda dang 'di rnams zho gn ⋯ r dang ba gcin dang 'di rnams dang sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsi mas btang na stod du skyugs pa dang me drod skyed pa dang byin pa dang brla dang rkang pa dang mjug do dang rgyab dang lto ba dang snying dang pho mtshan rnams su zug pa dang lus lci ba dang rlung dang bshang gci 'gags pa dang skran dang rde'u chags pa dang rlig rlugs dang pho ba'i nad dang gzhang 'brum dang de dang de la sogs pa bad kan dang rlung las gyur pa'i nad thams cad las rgyal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong rngam pa bde sna rdog mnyen zhing chu mdog dmar ser dang rtsa rgyud phyi grims khong lhod tha mal grangs lce steng ser la skam khog tha ma dmar sha rnying mar rnying bu ram chang la sogs bstud drags pa dang ha cang tshad las thal zos 'grog tsha ba skye yang zas mi bcad de las thal nas zungs zad rlung gyur na sha 'chor mdog ser lce yis ro mi tshor rngam rgod ba spu ldang zhing skom dad che skra rtsa seng la skra 'dab bag tsam 'dar mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyags mi 'gyur ngos 'dzin yin de la bcos thabs tshad rtags nub pa dang grang rtags mi sgug bur zho tsho khu dang chang 'jam chu bsres cha yis brid la btang de yis tsha ba mi skye

pairs.d4310: mas gtong skyug byed me drod skyed pa dang rkang pa byin pa brla dang mjug to dang lto ba snying dang pho mtshan na ba dang lus lci rlung dang bshang gci 'gags dang skran
pairs.d4311: spa ma'i 'bras bu dang pri yang ku dang shing mngar dang pi pi ling dang dug mo yungs kyi sa bon dang gla sgang dang skyer khanda dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis zhib tu btags pa dang lan tshwa ci ran tsam dang sbrang rtsi dang til mar dang ba gcin dang 'di rnams dang sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsi mas btang na stod du skyugs pa dang me drod skyed pa dang byin pa dang brla dang rkang pa dang mjug do dang rgyab dang lto ba dang snying dang pho mtshan rnams su zug pa dang lus lci ba dang rlung dang bshang gci 'gags pa dang skran dang rde'u chags pa dang rlig rlugs dang pho ba'i nad dang gzhang 'brum dang de dang de la sogs pa bad kan dang rlung las gyur pa'i nad thams cad las rgyal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal rma 'tsho zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod stobs skyed tshe 'phel snum pa'i mchog ste las stong byed phrum gsar spri dang phyur ba la sogs pa dang ga len zhing rtug skams bad kan sel zo mar bad rlung sel zhing me drod skyed 'bri dang lug mar de bzhin grang rlung sel mdzo snyoms ba ra bsil bas rlung tshad sel til mar tsha rno skem po sha skyed cing sbom po 'bri la mkhregs te bad

pairs.d4310: rkang pa byin pa brla dang mjug to dang lto ba snying dang pho mtshan na ba dang lus lci rlung dang bshang gci 'gags dang skran
pairs.d4311: spa ma'i 'bras bu dang pri yang ku dang shing mngar dang pi pi ling dang dug mo yungs kyi sa bon dang gla sgang dang skyer khanda dang 'di rnams zho gnyis gnyis zhib tu btags pa dang lan tshwa ci ran tsam dang sbrang rtsi dang til mar dang ba gcin dang 'di rnams dang sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsi mas btang na stod du skyugs pa dang me drod skyed pa dang byin pa dang brla dang rkang pa dang mjug do dang rgyab dang lto ba dang snying dang pho mtshan rnams su zug pa dang lus lci ba dang rlung dang bshang gci 'gags pa dang skran dang rde'u chags pa dang rlig rlugs dang pho ba'i nad dang gzhang 'brum dang de dang de la sogs pa bad kan dang rlung las gyur pa'i nad thams cad las rgyal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal rma 'tsho zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod stobs skyed tshe 'phel snum pa'i mchog ste las stong byed phrum gsar spri dang phyur ba la sogs pa dang ga len zhing rtug skams bad kan sel zo mar bad rlung sel zhing me drod skyed 'bri dang lug mar de bzhin grang rlung sel mdzo snyoms ba ra bsil bas rlung tshad sel til mar tsha rno skem po sha skyed cing sbom po 'bri la mkhregs te bad

pairs.d4310: snying nad skya rbab mi bzad rims dang ni skran bcas gcin 'gags mig ser la sogs pa mkhris pa las gyur nad ni thams cad 'joms ko sha ta ka dong ga thang shing dang mur ba gze ma arga dug mo nyung
pairs.d4311: de'i 'og tu lus khrus byas na lus tsha ba dang 'khru ba'i nad dang khrag dang mkhris pa rgyas pa dang snying nad dang skya rbab kyi nad dang rims mi bzad pa rnams dang skran dang gcin 'gags pa dang mig ser la sogs pa mkhris pa las gyur pa'i nad do cog sel to ko sha ta ki dang dong ga dang thang shing dang mur ba dang gze ma dang dug mo yungs dang arka dang pa tha dang rgya sran dang bri ha ti dang 'di rnams srang lnga de drug 'gyur gyi chu srang brgyad cu dang bskol la
pairs.rgyud_text: dang 'dus pa'i nad mar nag 'dra na rims dang mkhris pa rgyas dmar ser ska dugs 'grams sam 'khrugs chu yin chu mdog nag gam 'ja' tshon 'dra ba dug rlangs pa che na tsha ba rgyas pa'i chu chung la yun ring tsha ba gab bam rnyings rlangs chung yun thung bad rlung grang chu yin res che res chung tsha grang 'dres par brtag dri ma dugs la dku na tsha ba che dri ma med dam chung na grang ba yin zas kyi dri mnam gang mnam de ma zhu lbu ba sngo la che ba rlung yin te phra ser sangs pa skyen na mkhris pa yin lbu

pairs.d4310: rtug skam skran dang gzhang 'brum dang mcher pa'i nad dang gcin snyi dang rlung 'khyil ba dang lto sbos dang rde chags nad ni myur du sel yang na bil ba la sogs pa'i rtsa ba lnga pa til mar bskol
pairs.d4311: de bzhin du rlig rlugs dang phyi sa 'khyil ba dang skran dang gzhang 'brum dang mcher pa na ba dang gcin nad dang brla rengs pa'i nad dang lto sbo ba dang rde'u chags pa rnams myur du sel bar byed do yang na bil ba la sogs pa'i rtsa ba lnga til mar dang bskol ba'i 'jam rtsi mas gtong na
pairs.rgyud_text: sprin ser bshang zhugs rlung 'khyil rtug skam sgra bcas 'khru gcin zhugs lgang pa bsil sbo sri 'am snyi mngal zhugs 'bur 'dril mngal khrag sdom mam 'dzag mgor zhugs mgo 'khor zi 'khyom brtad mi tshugs mig zhugs rtsa dmar lug snyam bser bu gnod rna bar zhugs pa 'ur 'khrog stong snyam gzer snar zhugs sna 'gag chu 'dzag dri mi tshor sor zhugs ber ba langs nas

pairs.d4310: mar dang bri ha ti gnyis dang ras bal sa bon po son cha nas dang ra spu thang shing dang nyungs kar rma bya'i sgro dang pog
pairs.d4311: yang na glang gi rwa dang spu dang rus pa dang pags pa dang byi la'i rtug pa dang nim pa'i lo ma dang nim pa'i thang chu dang pu tse shel dang spra tshil dang bri ha ti rnam gnyis dang ras bal gyi sa bon gyi rus pa dang nas so ba dang ra'i spu dang thang shing dang yungs kar dang rma bya'i sgro dang shri bi sa zhes bya ba ko nyon tse'i thang chu dang phub ma dang mi'i skra dang shing kun dang de rnams kyi phye ma ras ma'i snod kyi nad du ra gcin dang sbangs te
pairs.rgyud_text: mong pho ba ris dang sga byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yid 'chus sel sug smel shing mngar rgyam tshwa tsi tra ka tsha ba gsum dang lce myang kha ru tshwa bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms se 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar ril bus ma zhu skyug pa sel bar byed dur thod sha ru spen ma'i thal ba gsum tsa bya a ru'i ril bus dmu rdzing

pairs.d4310: lag rtse bskyod cing su zhig la ci zhig sbyin zhes smra bar byed gsang tshig smra zhing sman pa dang bram ze la ni brnyas par byed
pairs.d4311: glu dang khrus dang phreng ba dang byug pa la dga' ba dang nya dang sha la sred pa dang spro ba dang dga' ba che ba dang stobs che ba dang nad med pa dang lag pa'i rtse mo 'gul zhing khyed cag rnams la nor la sogs pa ci zhig sbyin zhes smra ba dang gsang ba'i tshig mi thub pa dang sman pa dang bram ze la spyod pa dang khro bag chung ba dang 'gros myur ba dang 'di dag ni gnod sbyin gyi gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags so
pairs.rgyud_text: spang phye thug sga btab lug sha yib ma dang nya dang rgod sha chang dang zan dron sogs yang dro 'ju sla rgyu srung nyung shas bsten spyod lam rlan grang bser bu nyin gnyid spang skam sar lus dro rngul phyis rtsol ba spyad 'on kyang gsar dus smyung bya nyin gnyid phan kha cig ma zhu gsar rnying thams cad la bcags pa phan zhes rmongs pa'i mun tshig smra snyigs ma ma zhu gsar pa bcags phan te dwangs ma ma zhu rnying pa'i dug tu 'gyur ci phyir dwangs ma mchin gnas mkhris ldan tsha snyigs ma

pairs.d4310: rkan ni skam par byed pa dang mig dang rdzi ma bskyod pa dang gnyid che me drod chung ba dang g.yon phyogs nas ni gos gyon zhing sha dang bu ram til la dga'
pairs.d4311: mthong ba mi gsal ba dang bzhin zhan pa dang rkan bskams pa dang mig dang rdzi ma 'gul ba dang gnyid che ba dang me'i drod chung ba dang g.yon phyogs su gos gyon pa dang til dang sha dang bu ram la dga' ba dang tshig 'khrul ba dang 'di ni sngon gyi gnyen shi ba'i gdon gyis zin pa'i mtshan ma'o
pairs.rgyud_text: sman brta ba btang zhing spyi bo dang mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang skrangs na skyugs btang dmar tsha gtar ga gdab brla rengs ma zhu bad tshil skyes pa'i phyir de la snum 'chos spangs la rtsub bcos bya nas dkar so ba sre zan skam sa'i sha sbrang rtsi skyur rtsabs tshod ma tshwa med byin 'bras bu gsum dang tsa bya pi pi ling hong

pairs.d4310: 'di yi lde gus byugs pa dang bskol ba'i khu ba blugs par bya sbyor ba 'di yis smyo byed dang brjed byed bcas pa'i gdon zhi byed nyungs kar ha ti pi pi ling pi pi ling rtsa che ba gsum skyu ru ra dang go da dang
pairs.d4311: de la mig sman dang snar phye mas bud pa dang bsku ba dang bskol ba'i khu bas blugs pa la sogs pa ci rigs par byas nas gdon smyo byed dang brjed byed dang bcas pa zhi bar bya'o ha ti pi pi ling dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang tsha ba gsum dang skyu ru ra dang yungs kar dang srog chags go dha dang sre mo dang byi la dang dza sha dang de rnams kyi mkhris pa lhan cig btags pa'i phye ma sna nas gtong ba dang bsku byug dang blugs pa la sogs pa byas na gdon 'joms so
pairs.rgyud_text: sman shing sman rtsi sman thang sman sngo sman dang srog chags sman dang dbye ba brgyad du bshad dang po rin po che yi nus pa ni gser gyis tshe ring rgas sra dbyig dug sel dngul gyis chu ser nad dang rnag khrag skem zangs kyis rnag skem glo mchin tsha ba sel lcags kyis mchin dug mig nad skya rbab sel g.yu yis dug dang mchin pa'i tsha ba sel mu tig klad pa 'dzag gcod dug nad sel nya phyis nus pa mu tig khyad par med dung gis rnag skem 'gyings 'bigs rus tshad sel byu rus mchin tshad rtsa tshad dug tshad sel mu men dug dang chu ser

pairs.d4310: dri dang 'o thug 'bras chan dang zho dang gdugs ni dkar po dag shing kun nyungs kar shu dag dang tsha ba gsum ni srang phyed phyed
pairs.d4311: de yang me tog dkar po las byas pa'i phreng ba dang a ka ru la sogs pa dri zhim po dang 'bras kyi 'o thug dang 'bras chan dang zho dang gdugs dkar po dang bcas pa 'dod pa yin no shing kun dang yungs kar dang shu dag dang tsha ba gsum dang 'di rnams srang phyed phyed btags pa'i phye ma mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang mar bzhi 'gyur gyi ba gcin dang lhan cig bskol te mar 'ba' zhig lus pa las btung ba dang snar blugs pa dang bsku ba byas na lha'i gdon las grol bar 'gyur ro
pairs.rgyud_text: zal chu dang lci ba dang 'o ma zho dang mar la sbrang rtsi sbyar ba yi rnam lnga'i sman mar mchin nad rnying tsha ba rlung ldan chu ser skya rbab 'joms a gar tsan dan gu gul snying zho sha rgun 'brum mar la ka ras kha blangs pa zho sha'i sman mar snying gi tshad pa 'joms sro lo a ru'i mar la cu gang dang shing mngar sbrang sbyar sro lo'i sman mar te glo rnag 'byams dang glo yi tshad pa sel tsan dan dkar dmar sle tres dug mo nyung gla sgang kabraspya ka ri kyi lce ba hong len spang spos skyer shun skyu ru ra shug

pairs.d4310: seng ldeng srang ni nyi shu dang tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum shing kun shu dag shu ti dang nyungs kar nim pa'i lo mar bcas
pairs.d4311: seng ldeng srang nyi shu bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang du tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum dang shing kun dang shu dag dang shu ti dang yungs kar dang nim pa'i lo ma dang sgog skya dang de rnams kyi phye ma mar srang nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ba gcin mar gyi sum 'gyur dang lhan cig bskol ba de las yang btung ba dang snar blugs pa dang bsku byug byas na phan no
pairs.rgyud_text: 'byung de sman reng bu mas btang lus bcing dang bsku byug dugs dang sman mar bsten par bya khu ba bkag pas de 'dzag pho mtshan na chu 'gag rde 'u 'phel dang ma ning 'gyur mas btang lus bcing bud med spyad par bya til mar 'o ma khyim bya sha chang btang de ltar shugs ni bkag dang btsir ba yis nad kun 'byung 'gyur 'phral du rlung 'khrug pas de phyir de yi zas dang sman skom sbyar nad gang smyung dang

pairs.d4310: de bzhin pa ta la nag po bil ba'i rtsa ba tsha ba gsum shing kun nyungs kar dug mo nyung sgog skya skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu
pairs.d4311: ka ranydza dang shri sha dang pa tra la nag po gnyis kyi rtsa ba dang shun phrags dang me tog dang 'bras bu dang bil ba'i rtsa ba dang tsha ba gsum dang shing kun dang dug mo yungs dang sgog skya dang skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma ba gcin dang ha cang mi sla mi ska tsam du sbyar te
pairs.rgyud_text: btang se 'bru bzhi dang na ga zi ra dang pa tra 'u su la la phud dang sga na le sham dang kar sbyar gsar 'jam dbul bzhi lnga bya rog mig dang ske stong bsreg yib ma gar chang mi btang sha gsar dang gro chang sro los bsings dang gsar 'jam btang mchin rlung mchin sna skams phye'i sman mar la kha ru tshwa dang gur kum btab la btang brag zhun sman

pairs.d4310: btung dang snar blugs bskus pa yis srin po'i gdon ni zlog par byed sha za la ni bu ram chang til tshig til gyi phye ma zho
pairs.d4311: yang na sman de dag nyid mar dang ba gcin mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang lhan cig sbrus te bskol la lhag ma lus pa dang btung ba dang snar blugs pa dang bsku byug byas na srin po'i gdon zlog par byed do sha za'i gdon la ni bu ram chang dang til gyi tshigs ma dang til gyi phye ma dang zho dang la phug dang lan tshwa dang mar dang 'byung po'i zas 'bras dang sran ma sha la sogs pa bsres pa'i chan dang phye las byas pa'i zan dang bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin no
pairs.rgyud_text: zal chu dang lci ba dang 'o ma zho dang mar la sbrang rtsi sbyar ba yi rnam lnga'i sman mar mchin nad rnying tsha ba rlung ldan chu ser skya rbab 'joms a gar tsan dan gu gul snying zho sha rgun 'brum mar la ka ras kha blangs pa zho sha'i sman mar snying gi tshad pa 'joms sro lo a ru'i mar la cu gang dang shing mngar sbrang sbyar sro lo'i sman mar te glo rnag 'byams dang glo yi tshad pa sel tsan dan dkar dmar sle tres dug mo nyung gla sgang kabraspya ka ri kyi lce ba hong len spang spos

pairs.d4310: lag pa rkang pa g.yob pa dang gzugs med par yang mthong ba dang 'khrul zhing sa la 'gyel ba dang
pairs.d4311: las kyi bya ba ci byed kyang smad cing 'jigs su rung ba'i las byed cing so 'khrigs pa dang kha nas lbu ba 'byung ba dang lag pa dang rkang pa 'gul zhing bskyod pa dang gzugs med pa mthong zhing yod pa mi mthong ba dang 'dar zhing sa la 'gyel ba dang mig dang smin ma yo bar gyur pa dang nad stobs dang bral nas bzod zad pa yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: gzugs 'khums kha li rkang brtse dang rkang pa tsha ba zhes bya nyi shur bshad mdor bsdus rengs 'khums skams dang sbos pa dang 'phyes gzer 'phyos dang bog pa brgyad du bsdu gnas ni rang rgyud gnod bya la zhugs pa lpags gram shar rgyas rtsa ru rgyu ba dang rus la zhen dang don babs snod du lhung dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba'o de la dang po lpags la gram pa gcig gnyis pa sha dang

pairs.d4310: 'dus pa las gyur kun gyis bsku na le sham ni dkar po cha gcig dang ldong ros cha bzhi seng phrom cha bcu drug zhib tu btags te ras gtsang phur mas gtums
pairs.d4311: 'dus pa las gyur pa'i mig nad 'dzag pa la ni mig sman de thams cad sbyar ba bsku'o na le sham dkar po cha gcig dang ldong ros cha bzhi dang seng phrom dkar po cha bcu drug dang de rnams zhib tu btags te ras kyi nang du phur mar byas te
pairs.rgyud_text: pa'i ri la se 'bru dang na le sham dang pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka la sogs pa grang ba sel bar byed pa'i sman ro tsha ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa ba dang nus pa tsha ba dang rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal rtsa ba dang sdong po dang yal ga dang lo ma dang me

pairs.d4310: dza ti kha 'bus nag tshur dang rgyam tsha ba gcin btags pa yi lde gus zangs kyi snod bskus la zhag bdun bzhag ste ba gcin dang btags te ri lur byas nas ni de 'og grib ma la bskams te bud med nu zho dang bdar bsku drud snyam byed dang mchi ma 'dzag skrang dang g.ya' ba sel bar byed kanda ka ri'i shun pa dang shing mngar zangs ma'i phye ma ni ra yi 'o mas lde gur byas sha mi skyu ru ra'i lo ma mar gyis bskus pa'i dud pas bdug
pairs.d4311: lcags phye dang stang zil dang sna ma'i me tog dang nag tshur dang rgyam tsha dang de rnams ba gcin dang bdar ba'i 'dag gus zangs ma'i snod la byugs te zhag bdun du bzhag ste de nas yang gcin dang btags pa'i ri lu bya ste grib mar bskams la bud med kyi nu zho dang bdar nas mig tu bskus na mig brud pa snyam byed pa dang mchi ma 'dzag pa dang skrang ba dang g.ya' ba rnam par 'jig go yang na kanda ka ri'i shun pa dang shing mngar dang zangs ma'i phye ma dang de dag ra'i 'o ma dang btags te shya mi dang skyu ru ra'i lo ma mar gyis bsgos pa'i dud pas bdug pa mig la bskus na
pairs.rgyud_text: cha shu dag pi pi ling sga skya ra yi 'o mas gyen du drang nad che dang por skyugs byas rjes la sman khyad par tsha dugs rtsol spyad chu skol mchog dwangs ma ma zhu cha mnyam bzhi thang btang byer na 'o ma lan tshwa btab pas bsdu ma byer 'dus nas dur byid shri' khan ru rta rgyam tshwa shu dag bu ram sbyar chu tshan skyur rtsabs 'bras kyis phyi rjes bcad se 'bru lnga pa chu skol 'phul la btang ma zhu be snabs so cha shu dag sga rgyam tshwa chu skol 'phul ba'i skyugs kyis drang skyugs rjes lto bar dugs bya chu skol btung lcum rtsa so cha bul tog pi pi ling tshwa dang mar sbyar reng bus smad rlung sbyong de steng dur byid phabs sbyar

pairs.d4310: drud snyam byed dang mchi ma 'dzag skrang dang g.ya' ba sel bar byed kanda ka ri'i shun pa dang shing mngar zangs ma'i phye ma ni
pairs.d4311: mig brud pa snyam byed pa dang mchi ma 'dzag pa dang skrang ba dang g.ya' ba rnam par 'jig go yang na kanda ka ri'i shun pa dang shing mngar dang zangs ma'i phye ma dang de dag ra'i 'o ma dang btags te shya mi dang skyu ru ra'i lo ma mar gyis bsgos pa'i dud pas bdug pa mig la bskus na
pairs.rgyud_text: bzhin bad kan 'jig mchi ma 'dzag phyir mig sman skyer khanda rtag tu zhag bdun lon tshe nyin re blug glo bur nad lnga'i dgra la skyel ma bsten rtag tu gcig la ma yin kun snyoms spyad de ltar bdag ni nyin mtshan gnas 'gro zhes rtag tu dran pa nyer 'jog sdug bsngal bsring 'jig rten mi chos spyod pa yon tan kun gyi gzhi 'chad don btsan par bya

pairs.d4310: dri ma tsha dang snad pa la sogs pas de gnod gyur na mig la gnod par 'gyur de bas mig la phan 'dod lham dang ni
pairs.d4311: gal te rkang pa la dri ma dang tsha ba dang snad pa la sogs pas gnod par gyur na ni mig kyang ma rung bar 'gyur ro de lta bas na mig la phan par 'dod pa rnams kyis rkang pa bsku ba dang dril ba dang byug pa dang lham gyon pa la sogs pa rtag tu bsten par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: thal nas gnod pa med tha ma tsha bar sleb nas phan par tshor de dag gsum 'gyur sman gyi man ngag yin bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po gnyis bcos tshul dang po rkun chen phugs su gzhug bar du dud khung rgya skar bye ba dang tha ma me lhag chu yis bsad tshul gsum gnyen po

pairs.d4310: nas tshig 'khus thal skyer pa dang tsi tra ka dang skyer khanda pa ta te dzo ba ti dang
pairs.d4311: 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum dang nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang skyer pa dang tsi tra ka dang skyer khanda dang pa tha dang te dzo pa ti dang nis pa pa dang de rnams tshwa dang ba gcin dang sbyar ba'i ri lur byas pa dang phye mar byas nas gdab pa dang mkhur bar dgang ba la sogs pa ci rigs par bya'o
pairs.rgyud_text: stobs che na rim pa ci rigs bskyar chung na sbyangs rjes phye mas bsad par bya ma 'dus byer ba rang sar bsad pa ni smug po spyi sman bar pa'i mde kha sbyar yang na rgyas pa'i skabs kyi phye ma la mgor byer dom mkhris tig ta mtshe ldum bsnan snying la spos dkar dza ti a gar bsnan glo la cu gang shing mngar mtshal dkar bsnan mchin par brag zhun gur kum

pairs.d4310: lde gus yang dang yang du bsku sle tres nim pa dug mo nyung han sa ba ti ba la gnyis thang shing dang ni pi pi ling
pairs.d4311: yang na e ka shi ka chang ngam rang skyur las btags te bsku'o sle tres dang nim pa dang dug mo yungs dang han sa pa ti dang ba la rnam gnyis dang thang shing dang pi pi ling dang de rnams til mar dang lhan cig sbyar te blud do
pairs.rgyud_text: pa to la 'bras gsum nim pa dug nyung rgun 'brum brgyad pa btang gtso bo rngul mang dbyung zhing chu lcag bya nyin gsum pa la bca' sga tsan dan tig ta sle tres bzhi thang btang bye rug spos dkar yung skyer brag zhun dug nyung bong nga 'bras gsum bcu pa sbrang dang sbyar la byin nyin

pairs.d4310: me dbal rims dang tshad par 'khru lud pa lu dang skom dad che gnyid med pa dang dbugs mi bde
pairs.d4311: yang rma'i steng du rma byung ba dang shu ba chen po'i nad dang rims dang tshad par 'khru ba dang lud pa lu ba dang skom dad che ba dang gnyid med pa dang dbugs mi bde ba dang rma rnags mi shes pa dang klad pa'i srubs bye zhing klad rgyas snang ba dang rgyus pa rul bar byas pa dang rtsa chad pa dang rma phug ring ba dang srin bus zos pa dang rus pa chad pa dang zug rngu dang dug dang bcas pa dang rma brtags pa dang log par bcings pa dang snum shas che ba dang rtsub pa dang rma'i nang du spu la sogs pa zhugs pa dang 'gul bskyod pa dang khong pa ma dag pa dang 'grangs ches pa dang lus rab tu rjud pa dang chang mang du 'thung ba dang nyin par gnyid log pa dang nyal po bsten pa dang mtshan mo gnyid ma log pa dang
pairs.rgyud_text: pa rnams nang gi drod 'bar khong pa dag pa dang lus zungs 'phral brtas stobs dang mdog bzang ldan dbang brtan rgas sra lo brgya thub par bshad sngo ngad sgog btsong la sogs tsha ba dang khur mangs rgya khur la sogs kha ba dang skam dang gsher ba'i gnas su skyes pa dang skam dang rlon pa g.yos byas rjen pa rnams dro yang bsil lci grang ba tshad nad sel btsong sgog gnyid 'phel zas len bad rlung sel sgog skya lci bsil srin nad tshad rlung sel la phug gzhon nu yang dro me drod skyed nar son lci bsil bad kan skyed par byed nyung ma de bzhin dug nad ma lus bsrung ri sgog thams cad 'ju dka' zas len lci lcum dang chu los bad kan dang ga 'byed sngo kun rtsa sgo 'gag cing sman nus 'joms de la g.yos su byas pa'i zas sde la 'bras thug sla dang ska dang gar ba dang 'bras chan rnams ni snga

pairs.d4310: pags pa myur du skyed par byed rgya skyegs ldong ros btsod dang ni ba la dang ni ser po gnyis
pairs.d4311: ka gu ba la sogs pa gong gi shing de rnams kyi phye mas btab na pags pa myur du skye bar 'gyur ro rgya skyegs dang ldong ros dang btsod dang ba bla dang ser po rnam gnyis dang 'di rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i lde gus bskus na
pairs.rgyud_text: sbyar la gtar gtso bo brgyad kyi phye mas tsha ba bsad skabs su bad kan tsha ba rngul du dbyung phye thug ba zho ba sha chu grog btang skyed chung sbyangs rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar ma lhag ma chad rtsa ba thon par bcos zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi

pairs.d4310: nad ni thams cad 'joms par byed gu gul srang lda pi pi ling 'bras bu gsum ni srang re dang shing tsha sug smel zho gnyis gnyis sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu ni zos na mtshan bar rdol ba dang mdze dang skran nad 'joms par byed
pairs.d4311: pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka dang byi dang ga dang dug mo yungs dang de rnams cha snyoms pa'i phyed kyi 'bras bu gsum dang de rnams spyi dang mnyam pa'i gu gul dang de rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba bldags na nad thams cad 'joms par byed do gu gul srang lnga dang pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum srang re re dang shing tsha dang sug smel zho gnyis gnyis kyi phyi ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba zos na mtshan mar rdol ba dang mdze dang skran 'joms par byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: bcu dgu'o smad nad gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol ba dang rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldags dang g.yan pa glang shu za rkong shu ba dang reg pa'i dug dang mdzer pa ngo khab dang nad gzhan lpags la gram dang bcu ru bshad sha yi nad la lba ba rmen bu gnyis nad gzhan sha la rgyas dang rnam pa gsum rtsa yi nad la rtsa dkar rtsa nag gnyis nad gzhan rtsa ru rgyug dang rnam pa gsum rus pa'i nad la dreg dang rkang bam

pairs.d4310: srang re chu bre bzhi nang du bskol te bzhi cha lus ba ru rgya skyegs btsod dang le brgan rtsi shing mngar gur gum zho gnyis gnyis phye ma til mar srang brgyad dang de yi nyis 'gyur 'o ma bskol
pairs.d4311: gur gum dang pu shel tsi dang ka li ya ka dang rgya skyegs dang shing mngar dang tsandan dkar po dang nya gro dha'i rkang pa gzhon nu dang shug pa dang padma ge sar dang utpal dang btsod dang de rnams srang re re chu srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang bskol te bzhi cha lus pa'i nang du rgya skyegs dang le brgan rtsi dang btsod dang shing mngar dang gur gum dang de rnams zho gnyis gnyis btags pa'i phye ma dang til mar srang brgyad dang de'i nyis 'gyur gyi 'o ma dang tshul bzhin bskol te mar lus pa las sna sman goms par byas na ni ling ga dang ngo shig dang skra dkar dang gnyer ma dang sme bas ma rungs par gyur pa rnams 'joms te gdong gi sha mdog skye bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: sel na ga pushpa na ga ge sar dang padma ge sar glo mchin snying tshad sel zi ra dkar pos glo yi tshad pa sel zi ra nag pos mchin pa'i grang ba sel la la phud kyis pho nad grang ba sel so ma ra dzas lpags nad chu ser sel thal ka rdo rje dag kyang de bzhin no gser gyi me tog snod tshad mkhris tshad sel gser gyi phud bus mkhris pa gyen du 'dren dug mo nyung gis mkhris sel tsha 'khru gcod rgun 'brum glo nad sel zhing tshad pa sbyong 'u sus pho ba'i bad kan tsha ba sel star bus glo brko khrag 'ju bad kan gcod bse yab bad kan tsha ba sel bar byed se 'brus pho ba'i nad rnams ma lus sel me drod skyed cing bad kan grang nad 'joms na le sham gyis bad kan grang ba sel

pairs.d4310: 'di yis dbang po'i rdo rjes ni lha min lta bur dug 'joms byed bil ba'i rtsa ba bye'u rug pa'i me tog
pairs.d4311: ci ltar dbang po'i rdo rjes lha ma yin rnams 'joms pa bzhin no bil ba'i rtsa ba dang byi'u rug pa'i me tog dang ka ranydza ba la dang
pairs.rgyud_text: ru ra dang sbrang ril bu mur bas glo skran 'joms pa yin mchin pa'i khrag skran rtsa skran sbyor bas gdul yang na gur kum cu gang usgranal tig ta brag zhun ru rta dom mkhris ba

pairs.d4310: skyon med a ru ra dang skyu ru ra stong dang pi pi ling ni stong dang bcas rgya skyegs shing gzhon thal ba'i chu sbyar ba
pairs.d4311: yid gzhungs pa dang dran pa gsal ba dang stobs dang ldan pa dang tshe yang dpag tu med pa 'tsho bar 'gyur ro a ru ra dang skyu ru ra rdog ma stong dang pi pi ling 'bru stong dang rgya skyegs shing gzhon nu'i thal ba chu dang sbyar te btsags pa'i khu ba snod kyi nang du bcug ste
pairs.rgyud_text: drod bsrung bar gnas gyur na lus kyi stobs dang tshe ni gnas par gyur me drod de yis kha zas 'ju tshul ni zas skom srog gi rlung gis lto bar bcug skom gyis bshig cing snum gyis mnyen par byed me mnyam rlung gis mkhris pa 'ju byed bus pho ba'i gnas su sman ltar bskol bar byed dang por ro drug zas skom gang zos pa bad

pairs.d4310: sman pa'i bdag po dge 'dun gsang ba zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las mdo'i gnas zhes bya ba le'u sum cu pa rdzogs te yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i gnas dang po'o
pairs.rgyud_text: ste 'khyam pa yin rlung khrag rgyu ba'i bu ga phyi nang kun 'brel byas lus ni skyed cing gnas pa dang srog gi rtsa ba yin phyir rtsa zhes bya gnyan pa'i gnad la sha tshil rus pa dang chu rgyus don snod rtsa yi gnad dang bdun sha gnad skrangs shing rus gnad na zug che

pairs.d4310: sman pa'i bdag po dge 'dun gsang ba zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las rgyud phyi ma'i gnas te drug pa'o sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba ji snyed pa rdzogs so
pairs.d4311: sman pa'i bdag po seng ge sbas pa zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po mdzad pa las yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i gnas lnga pa'o sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po las mchog bzhi bcu pa'i cho ga'i le'u brjod par bya ste
pairs.rgyud_text: mgo lta bu srid sor bcu pa tel pa zhes bya ste 'bras dang lhog pa skrangs pa bsreg par bya dbal ldan phra 'jam gug po sha yi khab sha dang pags pa ral ba btsem la sbyar de ltar cha byad nad dang gang mkho spyad ces gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gnyen

pairs.d4310: der ni sngags kyi tshig brjod bya a hi ra si a yu ra si sarba tahpra tishtha si dha twa dha tu
pairs.d4311: de nas khri thog tu phyin nas sngags kyi tshig 'di dag brjod par bya'o a hi ra si a yu ra si sarba ta pra tishtha sid dha twa dha na bi dan tu bra hma ba ra tsa sa bha be ti
pairs.rgyud_text: bya'o yan lag la bslab par bya'o gnas la bslab par bya'o skabs la bslab par bya'o mdo la bslab par bya'o le'u la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis gsol pa kye ston pa lags gso ba rig pa'i man ngag gi rgyud

pairs.d4310: rtsa ba bcu pa ba la dang mur ba ser po rnam gnyis dang pi pi ling ni rnam gnyis dang pa tha a shwa gandha dang a pa marga kha sral phre'u
pairs.d4311: dpal bskyed cing bcud kyis len gyi mchog tu drang srong chen po ri byis bshad pa yin no rtsa ba bcu pa dang ba la dang mur ba dang ser po rnam gnyis dang pi pi ling dang hasti pi pi ling dang pa tha dang a shwa gandha dang a pa marga dang kha sral phre'u dang bong nga dkar po dang sle tres dang ba la dang bil ba dang tri bi ta zhes bya ba shing nye rong dang dan ti dang tsi tra ka'i rtsa ba dang lo mar bcas pa dang pa yas sya zhes bya ba kshi ri ni da ⋯ dang bo ta stha bi ra zhes bya ba'i shing dang go bye dang byi dang ga dang nye'u shing dang bu ta ka ranydza dang sha mya ka zhes bya ba dong ga dang tsandra me kha dang sa ha ra tsa zhes bya ba ba spru dang shi kru dang nim pa'i shun phrags dang bu ram shing gi khu ba dang 'di rnams srang re re dang a ru ra stong chig brgya dang nas srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang sman de rnams kyi brgyad 'gyur chu dang bskol ba gong ma ltar nas tshos pa dang phyung ste
pairs.rgyud_text: snyod thang rus bcud gsum dang sle tres chig thang dang byi tsher ga dur sle tres sga thang btang smin nas bzang drug sle tres big pan thal ka ra'i phye ma rus khus 'phul la btang gtar bshal ga bur 'di la nye mi rung bsil sha gsar pa mar gsar yos thug bsten tsha ba chung na zhag dgu lon pa dang 'dar bu'i ltag khung yer bu'i an stong bsreg ma thub srog rtsar lam don smyo ba na dza ti gu gul ru rta a ga ru sgog thal bur dkar sbyar la rus khus dbul rus bcud khu bar dza ti btab la btang ma thub gzhug chung lnga bdun sbyor ba bya drug bdun an stong ltag pa'i sdud sgo bsreg de ltar bcos pas ma thub srog rlung log rtsa spun rngam pa rtseg na 'chi ba yin sna lon dran pa gsal la rtsa shed rgyas chu dwangs lce rlon rkang pa'i drod rnyed cing snabs skams 'gog sla rna ba gsang na 'tsho mkhris rims dang po tig ta byi tsher thang byi tsher ga dur rtsa mkhris skra bzang dang a ru ga dur tig ta skra bzang btang smin nas ga dur gi wam tsan dan gsum tshad stobs sbyar la bsil gsum li ga dur tig ta

pairs.d4310: bskol ba 'dir ni cu gang ni srang drug khar srang sum cu bcug sbrang rtsi srang ni drug cu gzhug dri sna gsum ni srang re gzhug
pairs.d4311: mar 'ba' zhig lus pa'i nang du cu gang srang drug dang kha ra srang sum cu dang sbrang rtsi srang drug cu rtsa bzhi dang dri sna gsum srang re re dang 'di rnams kha gzar gyis dkrugs te
pairs.rgyud_text: rigs kha gshags tha snyad chos dang 'di mi rje de ltar snod ngan rnams la ma gsangs skyon gdams pa ma thub spel bas mkhas khyad med dug dang 'dres pas kun la phan mi thogs khong du rul bas gdams pa'i mgo mi thon dam tshig

pairs.d4310: nyams brtas khrag mkhris sel bar byed skems dang mdze dang sha bkra dang gci snyi ba yi nad rnams 'joms ma du ka yi me tog ni khu ba bskol ba phyed du ba bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi bzhi cha btab snga ma bzhin du byas pa'i chang phan pa'i zas dang bcas bsten na pho ba'i nad ni thams cad sel
pairs.d4311: sug smel dang padma'i rtsa ba dang a ka ru dang tsandan dang 'di rnams kyi lde gus bum pa snum can gyi nang du gong gi sman bcug la zla ba gcig bzhag ste sman pa'i chang 'thungs na pho ba'i me drod skyed pa dang lus kyi nyams stobs 'phel ba dang khrag mkhris sel ba ste khyad par du skem nad dang mdze dang sha bkra dang gcin snyi ba rnams 'joms so yang na ma du lung ka'i khu ba phyed du bar bskol ba'i nang du sbrang rtsi de'i bzhi cha gcig btab la sbyor ba gong ma bzhin du byas pa'i chang zan phan pa dang lhan cig bsten na pho ba'i nad thams cad zhi ste phan yon gong ma dang 'dra'o
pairs.rgyud_text: mthong snang so sor shar dper na mkha' la zla ba gcig shar na chu yi skyogs rer zla ba re re bzhin gcig tu gsungs kyang so sos du mar go zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyud bzhi'i mjug don bsdus pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags dang po nad shugs ma rdzogs mngon tshul dus gso ba byas kyang lam nas mi zlog cing bar du nad rgyas gnyen pos 'phral mi choms tha mar yan lag bcu gnyis ldan gyur kyang nad las mi grol srog ni zad par snang gzhan dag de las go ldog

pairs.d4310: srang re dan da srang gsum dang bu ram srang ni bcu gnyis dag ri lur byas 'di byin gyur na mdze dang sha bkra dbugs mi bde lud pa dmu rdzing gzhang 'brum dang gcin nad mcher pa rmen bu'i nad
pairs.d4311: byi dang ga'i nang gi snying po dang skyu ru ra dang a ru ra dang de dag srang re re dang da na tri srang gsum dang bu ram srang bcu gnyis dang 'di rnams ri lur byas te byin na mdze dang sha bkra dang dbugs mi bde ba dang lud pa dang gzhang 'brum dang gcin nad dang mcher ba na ba dang thor bu'i nad dang tshigs kyi steng na gnas pa'i 'brum bu'i nad dang skran rnams 'joms te sbyor ba 'di ni gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po zhes bya ba des
pairs.rgyud_text: la nad gzhi sleb pa dang gnad la nye dang thor bu'i rlung skyes gsum dang po gnyis ka lag tshod skabs su bstan khyad par rtsa gnad sbreng dang rab kyis 'ong de yang nad pa nyid la dris pas gsal rlung skyes g.yal dang dngangs 'dar skyug par byed log pa tsha log grang log rnam pa gnyis tsha log zhag gsum gnyis la 'byung ba ste tsha grang 'khrul lam skran nad tsha bar log grang log dpyad byas rjes la 'byung ba ste thor bu'i rlung skyes gsur dang byug pa dang bur chang rus khu bcud bsten rlung gsang mnan thur

pairs.d4310: gdon 'joms sman ni gzhan dag dang bong bu rta dang khyi lug dang rnga mo go da dred dang ni sre mo reg 'jam byi la gung ba lang seng ge stag dang ni rgya mtsho yi ni srog chags kyi pags pa mkhris pa sen mo so
pairs.d4311: arka'i rtsa ba dang spang spos dang a dza lo mi dang go li mi dang 'bam po dang shu dag dang gan dha pri yang ku dang ku ku ti dang sarba gan dha zhes bya ba gan dha ku li dang ka na zhes bya ba ka ka da dang la ba ka dang ra mnye 'o ma can dang badzra kro dha dang sle tres dang kar ka ta shring gi dang mo ha na bal li dang lig bu mig dang yungs kar dang gzhan yang gdon 'joms pa'i sman ji snyed pa dang bong bu dang rta dang khyi dang lug dang rnga mo dang rakshi dang go dha dang sre mo dang reg 'byam dang gung dang byi la dang ba lang dang seng ge dang stag dang rgya mtsho na gnas pa'i srog chags kyi pags pa dang mkhris pa dang so dang sen mo dang de rnams mar rnying pa 'am
pairs.rgyud_text: bad rlung skyed na yang ka da dang sle tres bad rlung sel tsha bas rlung dang bad kan sel byed la sgog skya pi pi ling min mkhris pa skyed ha cang thal drags yang rtsub rlung yang skyed bska bas mkhris sel a ru ba ru ra ma gtogs phal cher bad rlung gnyis la gnod zhu rjes pho ba'i me dang phrad pa'i tshe bad mkhris rlung gis rim par zhu ba las mngar dang lan tshwa'i zhu rjes mngar bar zhu skyur ba ro mtshungs kha tsha bska gsum kha nyes pa gsum po gnyis gnyis re res sel zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las ro dang zhu rjes bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig sman gyi nus pa ro nus ngo bo gnyis spyi dang bye brag

pairs.d4310: rab rib thams cad sel byed yin rgun 'brum padma'i rtsa ba yi khu ba 'o ma chang dang zhag
pairs.d4311: phye ma des mig tu btab na rab rib thams cad sel to rgun 'bru dang padma'i rtsa lag gi rang gi khu ba dang 'o ma dang chang dang zhag dang char pa'i chu de rnams re re'i nang du yang gong ma'i lig bu mig gi gong bu yang gong ma ltar byas te lan bdun bdun bsgos te phye mar byas pa dung gi snod kyi nang du bcug ste mig sman du bsten na mig gsal bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: mchin rtsa tshad sel lig bu mig dang btsag yug rnam la sogs mig nad rus tshad sel zhing chu ser skem cong zhis 'khru gcod bad kan tsha ba sel rdo thal pho ba'i bad kan 'dril ba gcod ha shig rtsa sbyong mo rde rde nad sel sa yi sman gyi nus pa bstan pa ni gser gyi bye mas mkhal nad chu 'gags sel sindhu ra yis rtsa tshad don rma gso rnag khrag skem zhing mes 'tshig rma la phan ze tshwas rdo 'ju rde 'u rdo

pairs.d4310: 'gram so phug pa snyam du sems smin ma'i mtshams dang dpral ba ni ltung ba snyam sems rab tu na rna bar sgra yis gnod par byed mig ni phyung ba snyam du sems
pairs.d4311: de la rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad kyi rtags ni mur 'gram gnyis su zug cing na ba dang so'i phreng ba rnams phug pa snyam sems pa dang smin mtshams dang dpral ba lhung ba snyam sems pa dang rna bas sgra mi thos pa dang mig phyung ba snyam du na ba dang mgo 'dam pa dang tshigs rnams bye ba snyam byed pa dang rtsa'i dra ba rnams 'phar ba dang gnya' ba dang 'gram pa 'byar ba snyam byed pa dang gsal zhing 'tsher ba mthong mi bzod pa dang sna chu 'dzag pa dang glo bur du ldang dub pa dang snum gyis bsku zhing dugs dang mgo bcing ba la sogs pa byas na cung zhig zhi zhing mnyen par 'gyur ba yin no
pairs.rgyud_text: gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor ma sngas ma phyis 'phrang la bsgug pa gces ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong rngam pa bde sna rdog mnyen zhing chu mdog dmar ser dang rtsa rgyud phyi grims khong lhod tha mal grangs lce steng ser la skam khog tha ma dmar sha rnying mar rnying bu ram chang la sogs bstud drags pa dang ha cang tshad las thal zos 'grog tsha ba skye yang zas mi bcad de las thal nas zungs zad rlung gyur na

pairs.d4310: sbu gu'i rma sbyor byed mchog yin rgya shug 'bras bu shun pa dang lan tshwa rgya skyegs bcas pa dang gla gor zho sha'i lo ma dang pri yang ku dang nu zho dang
pairs.d4311: gang yang rma gso ba la bshad pa'i reng bu dang til mar bshad pa de yang rma 'khyims pa la rab tu bsngags te e randa'i 'bras bu btags pa'i phye ma'i lde gus byug pa byas pa na yang rma 'khyims pa gso bar byed pa'i mchog yin no rgya shug gi 'bras bu dang shun pa dang lan tshwa dang rgya skyegs dang gla gor zho sha'i lo ma dang pri yang ku dang 'o ma dang snu hi dang a rga'i lo ma dang de rnams lhan cig sbyar ba'i reng bus rma'i nang du bcug na rma 'khyims pa myur du 'tsho bar byed do
pairs.rgyud_text: mkhris khrag nad sel snying dang mkhal ma gla gor zho sha gsum snying tshad mkhal tshad mcher tshad sel bar byed a 'bras sra 'bras 'jam 'bras mkhal nad sel 'bra gos bad kan smug ser pho nad sel ma nu pa tras rlung khrag tsha ba sel pushkar mu las bad kan tsha ba sel ru rtas rlung khrag pho ba sbos pa sel glo nad gag pa sha ro gcod par byed yung bas dug sel rul gcod gnyan nad 'joms shu dag ma zhu drod skyed gag lhog sel pu shel skyugs gcod bad kan tsha ba sel khyung sder dkar smug dug tshad sel bar byed dpa' bo dkar ser dpa' rgod de

pairs.d4310: rna sman rnon po gtang bar bya dbug nyes pa la a sman ta 'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma ni bskol ba'i khu ba blugs par bya rna shal til mar gyis bsku zhing shing mngar btsod dang stag tsher ba
pairs.d4311: un man tha zhes bya ba'i rna ba'i nad la ni srog chags go dha dang kar ka ta dang de gnyis kyi zhag dang ta la'i lo ma dang a shwa gan dha dang arka dang so ma ra tsa'i sa bon dang rgyam tshwa dang bye'u rug pa dang lang ga li dang til mar rnams lhan cig bskol ba las mar lus pas bsku byug dang sna sman rnon po yang gtang ngo rna shal phug nyes pa'i rna ba'i nad la ni a sman ta dang 'dzam bu dang a mra gsum gyi lo ma bskol ba'i khu ba blugs par bya ste de'i 'og tu til mar gyis bskus la shing mngar dang btsod dang pra punda ri ka dang yung ba dang 'di rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye mas gdab po
pairs.rgyud_text: zhing 'ju ba sla snum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil ro mngar phyi ma lci bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin rgas byis stobs chung sbeg rtsub khu khrag zad sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed brgyal rma 'tsho zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod stobs skyed tshe 'phel snum pa'i mchog ste las stong byed phrum gsar spri dang phyur ba la sogs pa dang ga len zhing rtug skams bad kan sel zo mar bad rlung sel zhing me drod skyed 'bri dang lug mar de bzhin grang rlung sel mdzo snyoms ba ra bsil bas rlung tshad sel til mar tsha rno skem po sha
